title: Scene_74 #1
prompt_text:
🔥 SCENE NOTE 🔥
The end. Three-cut sequence on in heavy BLIZZARD. CUT 1 — wide establishing on <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> on his knees facing camera with SLOW PUSH-IN, <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> and <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> sleeping in the snow with HEADS POINTING TOWARD EACH OTHER in foreground. Roko stares THROUGH/PAST camera into the far distance, hands limp on thighs from exhaustion. CUT 2 — profile wide on <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> from JAX'S SIDE of the tableau, Roko in profile facing screen-LEFT toward where Jax lies, he leans forward and reaches out his hand toward Jax's face. Jax's eyes slightly open but vacant/empty. CUT 3 — extreme close-up insert: Roko's BLOODY PALM sweeps DOWN across Jax's face from forehead to chin in a single slow motion; when the hand finishes the sweep and lifts away, Jax's eyes are FULLY CLOSED.

🔥 SPATIAL LAYOUT 🔥
 — Keyframe reference from uploaded image but in HEAVY BLIZZARD CONDITIONS. Cold snow-covered steppe / tundra plain stretching to a low horizon now mostly obscured by driving snow. Heavy dark grey storm clouds churning in the upper sky. HEAVY DENSE SNOWFALL — thick wind-driven blizzard pouring across the frame, snow flying SIDEWAYS in heavy horizontal streams from the strong cold wind, visible streaks of falling snow reading thick and constant across every depth plane, the air FILLED with flying snowflakes. Patches of dead frozen brush whipping in the gale, tall pale grass blades bending hard in the wind. Bare grey-stone rock outcrops half-buried scattered across the middle distance, partially visible through the driving snow. Far in the deep BG: distant horizon fires barely visible through the blizzard — orange embers and faint smoke pillars heavily obscured by falling snow, reading as dim warm pinpricks through the storm. Visibility shortened by the blizzard. The accumulated snow on the ground reading THICK and FRESH — deep powder building up around everything, the surface drifting and rippling with fresh blown snow.

CUT 1 geometry: camera positioned at chest-height looking forward at the tableau through driving snow. <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> kneels in middle ground center FACING CAMERA. His EYES look THROUGH and PAST the camera into the far distance behind/beyond it. <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> lies SLEEPING in the snow FOREGROUND on screen-LEFT with HEAD CLOSER TO FRAME CENTER and FEET POINTING SCREEN-LEFT. <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> lies SLEEPING in the snow FOREGROUND on screen-RIGHT mirror with HEAD CLOSER TO FRAME CENTER and FEET POINTING SCREEN-RIGHT. Their heads meet in the inner gap directly in front of Roko's kneeling position.

CUT 2 geometry: PROFILE SIDE ANGLE wide on <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> from JAX'S SIDE of the tableau. Camera positioned on Jax's side at chest-height. <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>>'s body lies in profile in the camera-near FOREGROUND extending across the LEFT side of frame, his head closer to Roko (in the inner middle of frame), his body extending screen-LEFT toward camera-near foreground, feet pointing screen-LEFT off-frame, his face in profile readable at lower-middle of frame. <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> kneels in profile in middle ground facing screen-LEFT toward Jax, his right arm extending forward and down across the small gap toward Jax's face. <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> visible in the deeper background of frame in profile behind Roko, head meeting Jax's head in the inner gap, feet pointing into the deeper BG.

CUT 3 geometry: EXTREME CLOSE-UP INSERT on <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>>'s face — frame fills entirely with his face, BARE without glasses. Across the cut <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>>'s BLOODY PALM enters from the top of frame and SWEEPS DOWN across the face from forehead to chin in a single slow motion, the hand passing across the eyes during the descent. As the hand sweeps DOWN past the eyes the lids close beneath it; when the hand finishes the sweep and lifts away off the bottom edge or lower edge of frame, Jax's eyes are FULLY CLOSED. Soft OOF blizzard snow drifting through the BG behind Jax's head.

🔥 LIGHTING 🔥
Cold overcast daylight from the heavy storm-clouded sky — diffused, no hard sun, soft directionless cold light filtered through the blizzard. The light reads even more diffused than clear-day overcast because of the heavy snow density in the air — visibility cut, ambient cold light scattering through the falling snow giving the whole scene a soft milky-grey wash. Faint warm orange flicker from distant horizon fires barely punching through the blizzard as small dim warm pinpricks far in BG. NO hard key light, NO golden hour. Heavy snow-haze softening every depth plane to near-zero visibility past middle ground. NO LUT, NO grading, photoreal Kodak 500T daylight stock pushed cold, light film grain, no oversharpening.

🔥 COLOR 🔥
60:30:10 — cold pale grey-white snow + grey storm-cloud sky dominant, dark stone-grey rock outcrops + black silhouettes of dead brush as secondary, small saturated accents: faint warm orange ember glow from distant horizon fires barely visible through blizzard, the dark grey-charcoal of <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>>'s jacket and <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>>'s tactical armor as secondary tones in the foreground, the dark crimson-red of dried blood on Roko's hand and on Jax's mouth as the small saturated notes in CUT 3, the dark olive-green face-paint stripes on Jax's cheekbones. Frame washed cold and desaturated overall.

🔥 CAMERA — VINTERBERG-STYLE HANDHELD MEASURED 🔥
ALL CUTS in REAL-TIME at 24fps. Cinematographic style of Thomas Vinterberg, handheld doc-style — but here SLOW and MEASURED, almost still. Live presence-of-camera handheld throughout, gentle breathing motion, no aggressive zooms, no whip pans. NO smooth gimbal, NO crane, NO drone glide. Occasional snowflakes drifting across the foreground in motion-blur because of their proximity to lens.

CUT 1 = wide 35mm handheld measured establishing with SLOW PUSH-IN through blizzard.
CUT 2 = wide 35mm handheld measured profile side-angle from Jax's side.
CUT 3 = extreme close-up insert 85mm handheld measured.

Cinematography: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins. 8K IMAX. 180° shutter motion blur. REAL PHYSICS — snow disturbed correctly, characters resting with weight on the snow, contact shadows correct, falling snow respects gravity and wind direction.

🔥 ENVIRONMENT — BLIZZARD 🔥
HEAVY CONSTANT BLIZZARD throughout all three cuts. Strong cold wind blowing sideways across frame at constant force — visible in the way the snow flies horizontally across the frame, in the way Rein's silver-grey hair lifts and drifts, in the way Jax's bleached buzzcut shifts in the wind, in the way Roko's shaggy black hair whips slightly across his face. The accumulated snow on the ground building visibly thick — fresh powder layers piling up on the sleeping figures' shoulders, chests, hair, and faces, the snow accumulating in real-time across the cuts. Distant fires barely crackling through the blizzard. Visibility cut short.

🔥 CONTINUITY 🔥
Same lighting, same blizzard intensity, same snowfall direction, same wind, same dust/smoke/snow-haze, same distant fires barely visible across all three cuts.

🔥 CHARACTERS 🔥

<<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> — lean athletic teenager. Shaggy wet-matted dark black hair hanging into his face, soaked with sweat and snow-melt, individual snowflakes catching in his hair from the blizzard accumulating on top of his head and shoulders, faint mustache on upper lip. Multiple cuts and abrasions across his face from the long fight, dirt and grime smudged across his skin, fresh snowflakes landing and melting on his face. Wears a torn dark short-sleeve t-shirt — fabric SHREDDED and torn open across the chest, shoulders, and ribs, hanging in tattered strips, exposed skin underneath showing scrapes, abrasions, and dark purple-red bruising blooming across his sternum and ribs, dirt and ash ground into the wounds, snowflakes accumulating across his exposed chest and shoulders. Olive-grey-green heavy cargo pants dirty with mud and snow caked. Fingerless dark leather gloves on both hands with the loose RED bandana wraps around the wrists hanging dirty. The fingers and PALM exposed by the fingerless gloves read DIRTY AND BLOODY — dark dried blood caked into the lines of his fingers and across his palm, smeared across his knuckles, dirt under his fingernails, the palm itself bloody and dirty. Small dark teddy-bear keychain hanging from his belt at his back. Dust-caked dark combat boots. He kneels in the trampled snow, weight back on his heels.

POSE — In CUT 1: hands rest LIMP on thighs, exhausted. In CUT 2: he LEANS FORWARD slightly from his kneeling position, his RIGHT ARM extending forward and down across the small gap toward Jax's face. In CUT 3: his RIGHT HAND sweeps DOWN across Jax's face from forehead toward chin in a single slow motion, palm-down, the entire palm passing over the eyes during the descent.

EMOTION — empty, shell-shocked, exhausted from the long battle. Mouth slack and slightly open, jaw hanging loose, breath shallow and ragged through parted lips visible as cold steam puffing into the freezing blizzard air, whipped sideways instantly by the wind. In CUT 1 his eyes WIDE but unfocused looking PAST camera into far distance. In CUT 2 his eyes are LOWERED and FOCUSED on <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>>'s face, the smallest tenderness and grief just barely surfacing as he commits the gesture, lips parting slightly more, brow drawing together a fraction.

<<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> — slim teenager, SLEEPING peacefully in the snow with the blizzard accumulating on her body. Chin-length silver-grey platinum bob with dark navy-blue-black roots/tips, hair fanned out softly around her head against the snow, individual strands lifting slightly in the wind, snowflakes catching in her hair. Thin vertical scar on left forehead/eye visible. EYES CLOSED — completely shut, peaceful in sleep. Face calm, dirt-streaked, fresh snowflakes accumulating on her cheeks, eyelids, and forehead. Body lies on her back resting in the snow, posture loose and relaxed. Wears DARK MATTE TACTICAL EXO-ARMOR — heavy black-charcoal armored panels across torso, shoulders, hips, thighs, dark exoskeleton tubing and component housings. Battle-worn — scuffs and scrapes across the panels, dust and dirt caked into the seams. FRESH SNOW ACCUMULATING THICK across her body. NO BREATHING — chest COMPLETELY STILL. In CUT 1: lies with HEAD POINTING TOWARD CENTER, feet pointing screen-LEFT. In CUT 2: visible in deeper background behind Roko, head meeting Jax's head in the inner gap, feet pointing into the deeper BG.

<<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> — Afro-American teenager, sleeping in the snow with the blizzard accumulating on his body. UPDATED REFERENCE FROM UPLOADED KEYFRAME. Short BLEACHED BRIGHT YELLOW buzzcut visible, snowflakes catching across the top of his head accumulating in the buzzcut. NO SAFETY-GLASSES — face is BARE, eyes visible directly. FACE PAINT: TWO HORIZONTAL DARK OLIVE-GREEN STRIPES ACROSS EACH CHEEKBONE — short bars of dark olive-green tactical face paint, two stripes per cheek. Fresh dark blood streaming from a split lip and from his nostrils running down across his upper lip and chin and dripping down toward his neck, additional dark blood streaks on his temple and cheek from cuts during the fight. Small fresh cut on his forehead/temple weeping red. Face calm and relaxed in rest, dirt-streaked, fresh snowflakes accumulating across his cheekbones and forehead. Body lies on his back resting in the snow, posture loose and relaxed, arms lying at his sides, legs slightly bent. Wears the OUTFIT FROM UPLOADED KEYFRAME: dark grey-charcoal-and-black bomber/utility tactical jacket with charcoal panel inserts and small ORANGE/AMBER zipper pull accents on the chest pockets, hood DOWN. THE JACKET HAS A LARGE CENTERED ABDOMINAL/STERNUM WOUND — massive dark crimson-red blood saturation pattern radiating across the chest and lower abdomen of the jacket, the fabric soaked through dark with thick wet blood, blood streaming DOWN from the wound site in heavy dripping rivulets that run down across the lower jacket hem and continue down the front of his cargo pants in long dark streaks reaching his knees. OLIVE-GREEN heavy cargo pants — soaked dark with blood. Tactical thigh-strap holsters on BOTH thighs holding compact dark sidearm pistols. Fingerless dark leather tactical gloves. Dust-caked dark combat boots. FRESH SNOW ACCUMULATING THICK across his body. Dark blood pooled in the snow under his torso. NO BREATHING — chest COMPLETELY STILL.

EYES — CUT 1 and CUT 2: SLIGHTLY OPEN but EMPTY. Eyelids parted just a sliver — barely cracked open, narrow slits — the gaze completely VACANT, no light in the pupils, eyes glassy and looking at nothing, the slightly-open lids reading as the loose unfocused relaxation of deep stillness, eyes empty of presence. CUT 3 across the cut: at start the eyes are still SLIGHTLY OPEN AND EMPTY (same state). As <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>>'s PALM sweeps DOWN across the face from forehead to chin, the palm passes over the eyes during the descent — and as the palm passes, the eyelids CLOSE under its sweep. When the palm finishes the sweep and lifts away off the bottom of frame, BOTH of Jax's eyes are FULLY CLOSED, lashes settled, face fully peaceful, the small mercy completed by the sweep of the hand.

🔥 SKIN 🔥
Pore-level realism — vellus hair on Roko's exposed forearms and face catching cold light, capillary flush in his cheekbones from cold + adrenaline + held shock, dirt and grime ground into his face creases, sweat-and-snow-melt soaking his hairline. Cold steam puffing visibly from his parted lips with each shallow breath in the freezing air, whipped sideways instantly by the blizzard wind. Snowflakes landing on all exposed skin and melting / accumulating. In CUT 3 his bloody PALM reading detailed pore-level texture — dark dried blood smeared across the palm and fingers and under his nails, the lines of the palm filled with blood and dirt, the palm sweeping across Jax's face skin clearly visible — Jax's bare face skin reading pores and texture, the green face-paint stripes across his cheekbones, blood from his split lip and nostrils across his lower face, his bleached buzzcut.

🔥 ACTING 🔥
Hollywood — micro-pauses, the absence of reaction, exhaustion. CUT 1 he kneels still, eyes wide unfocused looking PAST camera into far distance. CUT 2 he leans forward slowly with measured tender exhaustion, his right arm extending across to reach Jax's face — the movement reads as the smallest mercy from a body almost out of energy. CUT 3 his entire PALM sweeps DOWN across Jax's face from forehead to chin in a single slow reverent motion — the gesture reads as the closing of the eyes by the passage of the hand, the final small ritual.

🔥 STILLNESS LOCK 🔥
<<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> and <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> are STILL across all cuts. Their chests do NOT rise or fall. NO breathing motion visible. The only motion on them is the snow accumulating onto them from the blizzard, the wind faintly moving Rein's silver-grey hair / Jax's bleached buzzcut, and in CUT 3 Jax's eyelids closing under the sweep of Roko's palm.

CUT 1 — Handheld WIDE 35mm measured doc-style with SLOW PUSH-IN on in HEAVY BLIZZARD, frontal angle on <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> kneeling in middle ground center facing camera, <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> and <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> sleeping peacefully in the snow in foreground HEAD-TO-HEAD with their heads meeting in the inner gap below Roko's knees and feet pointing OUTWARD to opposite frame edges (Rein's body on screen-LEFT half, Jax's body on screen-RIGHT half). Roko stares THROUGH/PAST the camera into the far distance, eyes unfocused on the horizon beyond. Hands LIMP on thighs from exhaustion. Heavy blizzard driving snow sideways across frame, snow accumulating thick on the sleeping figures and on Roko, distant fires barely visible through the storm in deep BG. 5s.

Geo: camera at chest-height in the cold snow positioned facing the tableau through the driving blizzard. Heavy snowflakes streaking sideways across the frame in horizontal motion-blur from the wind, occasional flakes drifting close to lens. <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> and <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> lie sleeping horizontal in the foreground with their HEADS MEETING IN THE MIDDLE just below/in-front-of <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>>'s kneeling position — Rein's head on the LEFT side (eyes closed peaceful, snowflakes on her cheeks and silver-grey bob), Jax's head on the RIGHT side (BARE FACE no glasses, eyes SLIGHTLY OPEN as narrow vacant slits empty of presence, green face-paint visible across his cheekbones, dark blood from his split lip and nostrils visible across his lower face, snow on his bleached buzzcut). Their bodies extend outward horizontally — Rein's body extending screen-LEFT, Jax's body extending screen-RIGHT with the centered abdominal wound bleed-pattern visible as deep dark crimson saturation across his torso — both lying loose and relaxed, fresh blizzard snow accumulating thick on their shoulders, chests, faces. <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> kneels in middle ground center directly behind their meeting heads, his face visible, his torn t-shirt and bruised skin visible across his chest with snow accumulating on his shoulders, his hands resting LIMP on his thighs, shoulders slumped, body sagging back on his heels. His eyes WIDE but unfocused, looking through and past the camera lens at a point far beyond on the horizon, his shaggy black hair lifting in the wind. Behind him in deep BG through the blizzard: cold steppe stretching toward obscured horizon, distant horizon fires as small dim warm orange pinpricks barely visible through the snow.

Action: SLOW PUSH-IN across the cut — camera physically moves forward through the blizzard toward <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> at a slow measured pace, framing tightening from wide establishing at start of cut to medium-wide on Roko by end of cut. The blizzard drives snow sideways across frame at constant force throughout the push. <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> kneels still, breath puffing cold steam from his parted lips immediately whipped sideways by the wind, hands limp and heavy on his thighs, body sagging from exhaustion, hair lifting and shifting in the wind. His eyes hold the unfocused thousand-yard stare past the camera into the far distance. <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> and <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> lie completely STILL in the foreground head-to-head, deeply asleep, NO chest rise, NO breathing motion visible — only the wind faintly shifting their hair, only the blizzard snowflakes accumulating heavy and visible on their shoulders and faces in real-time. Cold blizzard wind howling. Camera handheld measured advancing forward, gentle breathing motion in the push.

Audio: heavy blizzard wind HOWLING at constant high note across frame, snow-drift hiss thick and constant, distant fire-crackle from horizon barely audible through the storm wind, Roko's shallow ragged breath puffing cold steam audible (growing slightly more audible as camera pushes in, but partly washed by wind), faint creak of his torn fabric snapping in the wind, no breathing from the sleeping figures, no music.

CUT 2 — Handheld WIDE 35mm measured doc-style PROFILE SIDE ANGLE FROM JAX'S SIDE on <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> kneeling in profile facing screen-LEFT, his right arm extending forward and down across to <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>>'s face. Jax's eyes SLIGHTLY OPEN and EMPTY visible in profile in foreground. <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> visible in deeper background behind Roko in profile. Heavy blizzard driving snow sideways across frame. 5s.

Geo: camera positioned on JAX'S side of the tableau at chest-height, framed wide reading <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> kneeling in profile in middle ground facing screen-LEFT toward <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>>. We see Roko in side-on view from Jax's side — his profile visible facing screen-LEFT, his torn t-shirt and bruised skin visible across his exposed body in profile, his back curved slightly forward as he leans toward Jax, his right arm extending forward and DOWN across the small gap toward Jax's face which lies to the screen-LEFT in the camera-near foreground. <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> lies in profile in the camera-near FOREGROUND extending across the LEFT side of frame — his head closer to Roko's kneeling position (in the inner middle of frame closer to Roko), his body extending screen-LEFT toward camera-near foreground, feet pointing screen-LEFT off-frame, his face in profile readable at lower-middle of frame. His face in profile shows: BARE no glasses, eyes SLIGHTLY OPEN as narrow vacant slits — the eyelids parted just a sliver showing the eyes empty and unfocused beneath, green face-paint visible across his cheekbone, dark blood from his split lip running down his face. The centered abdominal wound bleed-pattern visible across his torso. <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> lies in the DEEPER BACKGROUND of frame in profile, her body extending across the deeper plane behind Roko's kneeling position, head meeting Jax's head in the inner gap, feet pointing screen-RIGHT toward the deeper BG / off-frame in the deep distance. Heavy blizzard snowflakes streaking sideways across the frame in horizontal motion-blur. Behind them in deep BG through the blizzard: cold steppe stretching toward obscured horizon, distant horizon fires as small dim warm orange pinpricks barely visible through the snow.

Action: <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> LEANS FORWARD slowly from his kneeling position toward <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>>, his right arm extending forward and down across the small gap, hand reaching toward Jax's face. The movement reads as exhausted but tender. His left hand still rests on his thigh. His eyes are LOWERED and FOCUSED on Jax's face — fully present in the moment of the gesture. Lips parting slightly more, brow drawing together a fraction. Breath puffing cold steam swept by wind. His bloody hand extending across the gap toward Jax's face from above, palm-down, descending slowly. Throughout the cut Jax's eyes remain SLIGHTLY OPEN and EMPTY — narrow vacant slits with no presence in them, the empty stillness of deep rest, snowflakes landing on his eyelashes and accumulating on his face. The blizzard drives snow sideways across the frame. Camera handheld measured holding the profile composition from Jax's side, gentle breathing motion.

CUT 3 — Handheld EXTREME CLOSE-UP INSERT 85mm measured doc-style on <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>>'s face, <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>>'s BLOODY PALM SWEEPS DOWN across the face from forehead to chin in a single slow motion. Eyes slightly open and empty at start. As palm passes over eyes during the descent, eyelids close beneath. When hand lifts away off bottom of frame, eyes are FULLY CLOSED. 5s.

Geo: extreme close-up on <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>>'s face — frame fills entirely with his face. BARE without glasses, the green face-paint stripes across his cheekbones clearly visible, fresh snowflakes accumulating across his cheekbones and forehead, his bleached yellow buzzcut visible at the top edge of frame with snow caught in it, dark blood from his split lip running down toward his chin, dark blood from his nostrils across his upper lip. Eyes the focal point at start of cut — SLIGHTLY OPEN as narrow vacant slits, eyelids parted just a sliver, the gaze beneath empty and unfocused, snowflakes landing on his eyelashes. <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>>'s RIGHT HAND entering frame from the TOP edge — bloody palm-down (fingerless glove leather strap visible at the wrist with the dirty red bandana wrap, palm exposed, dark dried blood smeared across the palm and fingers, dirt under fingernails, the bloody palm reading detailed). Soft OOF blizzard snow drifting through the BG behind Jax's head, falling snow visible across the frame in soft OOF streaks.

Action: Three beats across the cut.

BEAT 1 (0-1.5s): Jax's eyes SLIGHTLY OPEN and EMPTY at start, narrow vacant slits, snowflakes landing on his eyelashes. <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>>'s bloody PALM enters frame from the TOP edge, palm-down, descending slowly toward the forehead. The hand HOVERS for a micro-pause just above the forehead — the smallest hesitation before commitment.

BEAT 2 (1.5-3.5s): The palm makes CONTACT with the forehead and BEGINS THE SWEEP DOWN — the bloody palm pressing gently against Jax's skin and sliding downward across the face in a single slow reverent motion. As the palm passes over the eyebrows, the heel of the palm reaches the eyes — and as the palm sweeps DOWN over the eyelids, the eyelids CLOSE beneath the descending hand, the slightly-open slits sealing shut under the palm's gentle passage. The palm continues its descent past the closed eyes, sliding down across the bridge of the nose, past the cheeks (the palm briefly covering the green face-paint stripes), past the lips, down to the chin. The sweep reads slow and deliberate, the hand's bloody surface visibly moving down the face in a single continuous gesture.

BEAT 3 (3.5-5s): The palm finishes the sweep at the chin and LIFTS AWAY off the bottom edge of frame, the hand withdrawing from the face. The face is now fully revealed again — and BOTH of Jax's eyes are FULLY CLOSED, lashes settled peaceful, face fully calm. The closure is complete. The framing holds for a beat on Jax's now-closed face, snowflakes continuing to accumulate on his closed eyelids and cheeks. The small mercy completed.

Heavy blizzard snow accumulating visibly throughout, individual flakes landing on Jax's face and on the back of Roko's hand during the sweep. Camera handheld measured slow drift almost imperceptible inward, breathing motion gentle, witnessing the most intimate gesture in the storm.

Audio: heavy blizzard wind HOWLING at constant note continuing, snow-drift hiss close, the smallest sound of Roko's bloody palm sliding against Jax's face skin during the sweep (almost inaudible but present, a soft drag of skin on skin), a faint catch in Roko's breath audible from off-frame as he completes the gesture, no breathing from Jax, no music — the smallest reverent silence within the storm.

Photoreal. NON-IP. 16:9. 15s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.

title: Scene_74 #2
prompt_text:
🔥 SCENE NOTE 🔥
Single cut on — the storm has passed. TOP-DOWN OVERHEAD on the final formation as in @keyframe1: <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> on screen-LEFT and <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> on screen-RIGHT lying with heads connected at the apex meeting point, <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> lying between them with his crown joining theirs at the apex, his body extending out toward the bottom of frame. The cut starts as a CLOSE-UP top-down on Roko's face — his face turned toward SCREEN-LEFT (toward Jax) at start. Across the cut: Roko slowly TURNS HIS GAZE toward camera, his eyes finding the lens, AND simultaneously the camera SLOWLY PULLS STRAIGHT UP across 0-10s opening to a WIDE top-shot revealing the full formation. Across 10-11s the camera SMOOTHLY DECELERATES into a soft natural stop. AT 11 SECONDS THE SHOT BECOMES STATIC — the camera HOLDS COMPLETELY STILL through 11-15s for the closing beat. Light gentle snowfall drifting down throughout.

🔥 SPATIAL LAYOUT 🔥
 — Cold snow-covered steppe / tundra plain stretching to a low horizon. Light snowfall continues. Patches of dead frozen brush, dark red-brown frozen brush patches across the snow surface, tall pale grass blades. Bare grey-stone rock outcrops half-buried scattered across the landscape. The sky still grey but quieter than the blizzard.

CUT geometry — TOP-DOWN OVERHEAD with VERTICAL DOLLY-UP 0-10s, SMOOTH DECEL 10-11s, FULLY STATIC HOLD 11-15s. Camera positioned directly OVERHEAD pointing STRAIGHT DOWN throughout the cut — pure vertical orientation, no tilt or pan. The camera moves vertically straight up across 0-10s — starting LOW and CLOSE on Roko's face from above, rising to HIGH at moderate height (roughly 4-5 meters above the formation). prompt_text:
🔥 SCENE NOTE 🔥
Three-cut SLOW-MOTION sequence on — quiet aftermath but with steady ACTIVE WIND AND DRIFTING SNOW. CUT 1 — <<<b45115de-a4a5-4333-88a0-ec4c8209d302>>> standing, slowly raising his right hand with <<<fdbacf4c-db7d-4715-96b8-b62583316e80>>> (semi-profile/three-quarter back-side, NOT frontal). CUT 2 — close-up on Roko (semi-profile/three-quarter back-side, NOT frontal). CUT 3 — INSERT close-up on the artifact in his hand (three-quarter side angle on the object). All cuts in 100fps capture played at 24fps (~4x slow-motion).
🔥 LOOK PRESET 🔥
Cold post-storm grey daylight, diffused, no hard sun. Photoreal Kodak 500T pushed cold, light film grain. 60:30:10 cold grey-white snow + grey sky / dark stone-grey rock + DARK RED-BROWN frozen brush / saturated accents (dark blood crimson, bronze artifact, RED bandana wrist-wraps, the artifact's bright silvery-white inner glow). Vinterberg-handheld doc-style measured. 100fps→24fps slow-mo. 180° shutter equivalent. Lubezki × Deakins. 8K IMAX. Real physics. NO LUT, no oversharpening.
★ ARTIFACT GLOW — CALIBRATED TO REFERENCE:
The artifact is small (palm-sized, ~5cm tall) — the small crystal interior BRILLIANTLY LUMINESCENT WITH BRIGHT SILVERY-WHITE INNER LIGHT — facets clearly filled with vivid inner light from within, the entire small crystal lit up brightly from inside, reading like a tiny contained inner sun. Inner light gently pulses in slow-stretched rhythm (~5-6s per cycle in slow-mo) — brightness swelling slightly at peaks then easing back, alive and breathing. MINIMAL practical light on surroundings — hand reads normally lit by ambient cold daylight (no obvious warm underlight on gloved fingers/wrist/bandana), bronze claws read DARK PATINATED BRONZE (only the very innermost claw surfaces against the crystal catching faintest warm hint), air around artifact reads NORMAL (no warm halo, no volumetric bloom), snow BG reads normally lit. Bright inside, normal outside.
★ ENVIRONMENT — ACTIVE WIND AND DRIFTING SNOW:

STEADY MODERATE WIND blowing across the steppe — directional wind from screen-LEFT to screen-RIGHT (or with consistent directional flow), the wind a constant active presence in the scene. Not blizzard-violent (the storm has passed), but clearly active and noticeable: the kind of cold steppe wind that cuts through the air and lifts loose snow off the ground.
DRIFTING SNOW — light snow blowing horizontally on the wind across the frame, NOT just drifting straight down. The snow on the ground actively LIFTING off the surface in small streams of fine snow particles being carried on the wind — visible streaming of surface snow blowing across the ground at boot-level and ankle-level (snow-snake patterns of drifting powder skating across the snow surface), driven sideways by the wind.
AIRBORNE SNOW — fine snow and ice crystals carried sideways through the air, visible streaks across the frame moving on the wind (slow-mo making the streaks read as dreamy slow horizontal arcs rather than the sharp horizontal lines of real-time blizzard). Density: moderate — clearly visible drifting snow filling the air with soft texture, but you can still see through to the BG.
WIND ON ROKO'S BODY — his shaggy dark wet hair lifting and shifting in the wind (visible hair movement, the strands lifting on the gusts then settling), the tattered strips of his TORN T-SHIRT FLAPPING in the wind (the shredded fabric across his chest/shoulders/ribs catching the wind and fluttering, the torn ends snapping and shifting as the wind hits him), the LOOSE RED BANDANA WRAPS around his wrists fluttering visibly in the wind (the loose red fabric ends streaming out on the gusts, very visible against the cold scene), small particles of snow/dust caught in the wind catching on his face and torso.
WIND ON THE ARTIFACT — fine drifting snow particles carried on the wind passing past and around the small artifact, occasional snowflake catching briefly on the bronze claws or the crystal surface then being swept off by the next gust.
WIND IN THE WIDER SCENE — the empty steppe BG showing visible drifting snow streams across the snow surface fading into the deeper distance, the cold grey sky with light snow being carried laterally on the wind, the pale grass blades and frozen brush patches in the distance lightly bending and shivering with each stronger gust.
WIND VARIATION — not a perfectly constant wind: small natural variations of intensity (a stronger gust every few seconds making the fabric/hair/airborne snow react more visibly, then easing back to the moderate steady drift). The variation reads alive, not mechanical.

🔥 CHARACTERS 🔥
<<<b45115de-a4a5-4333-88a0-ec4c8209d302>>> — lean teenager, shaggy wet dark-black hair with snow caught in it (hair lifting in the wind), faint upper-lip mustache. Multiple cuts/abrasions on face, dirt and grime, dark dried blood at temple/jawline, fresh blood at nostrils and split lip, tear tracks through grime. TORN DARK SHORT-SLEEVE T-SHIRT shredded across chest/shoulders/ribs hanging in tattered strips that FLAP and FLUTTER VISIBLY IN THE WIND, exposing bruised bloody torso (the wind cutting across his bare bruised skin). Exposed forearms with deep red cuts. Olive-grey-green heavy cargo pants caked with mud/snow. Fingerless dark leather gloves both hands with LOOSE RED BANDANA WRAPS around wrists (the loose red fabric ends streaming out and fluttering vividly in the wind — the most visible reactive element on his body to the wind, the red drawing the eye). Small dark teddy-bear keychain on belt (slightly swinging on the wind). Dust-caked dark combat boots. Holds <<<fdbacf4c-db7d-4715-96b8-b62583316e80>>> in his RIGHT HAND — the small talisman pinched between thumb and forefinger by the bronze claw base, crystal pointed upward, the artifact small enough that the streaming red bandana on his wrist reads larger in the frame than the artifact itself.
EMOTION: exhausted survivor carrying the cost of his dead friends in his hand. Quiet immense grief — the slow weighted raise, the look of immense exhausted grief and held resolve, the cold wind cutting against him as he stands.
<<<fdbacf4c-db7d-4715-96b8-b62583316e80>>> — small palm-sized handheld talisman, roughly 5cm tall (fits comfortably within an open adult palm, sized like the top two knuckles of an adult finger), clear faceted teardrop crystal cradled in dark patinated bronze claw setting (organic curved talons sweeping up around crystal). Compact, dense, the size of a closed fist or smaller. Pinched at the bronze base between thumb and forefinger in his right hand, crystal pointed upward. Crystal interior BRILLIANTLY LUMINESCENT with bright silvery-white inner light pulsing gently — bright contained inner light as described, minimal practical effect on surroundings. Drifting snow particles passing past it on the wind.
 — Cold snow plain swept by ACTIVE STEADY WIND with drifting snow, light to moderate snowfall carried sideways on the wind, visible snow-drift streams skating across the ground surface, low grey sky.
═══════════════════════════════════════
CUT 1 — SEMI-PROFILE / THE RAISE (SLOW-MO 100fps) — 4s
Medium 50mm handheld three-quarter back-side angle (camera positioned slightly behind and to the side of Roko, NOT frontal), lens at chest-level. Framing: back of his right shoulder/arm, side of his torso (bare bruised skin through torn shirt readable, the tattered strips FLUTTERING VISIBLY in the wind), side of his face in three-quarter, back of his shaggy dark wet hair (lifting on the wind). His RIGHT HAND down at his right side at start holding <<<fdbacf4c-db7d-4715-96b8-b62583316e80>>> pinched between thumb and forefinger by the bronze base (the small artifact at his hip reading as a compact 5cm shape between his fingertips — BRIGHT silvery-white inner glow clearly visible inside the small crystal making it readable despite its size, his hand and bandana reading normally in cold daylight; the LOOSE RED BANDANA WRAP on his right wrist STREAMING and FLUTTERING vividly in the wind right next to the small artifact, the bandana fabric reading larger than the artifact itself in the frame). Beyond him in soft OOF: empty cold steppe with visible drifting snow streams on the ground surface and light airborne snow drifting sideways on the wind across the wider frame.
ACTION: Brief held beat (~0.5s) — Roko standing, the wind cutting across his body, his torn shirt strips flapping, his hair lifting, his red bandana wrist-wraps streaming, the wider steppe behind him alive with drifting snow on the wind. Then he SLOWLY RAISES his right hand in slow-motion. Arm lifts weighted from his side — slow-mo dreamlike and immense, every micro-tremor of exhausted muscles readable. The small artifact rises from hip → mid-torso → chest → chin level over the cut. As his arm rises, the red bandana wrap at his wrist TRAILS AND STREAMS in the wind — the loose red fabric ends fluttering and waving as the wrist moves through the air, drawing a vivid red line of fluttering motion as the small artifact rises with it. By end of cut: small artifact held up at chin/lower-face level pinched between thumb and forefinger with crystal pointed up, head slowly TILTING DOWN toward it, eyes finding the artifact. The bright crystal interior reads as the only warm-bright element in the cold wind-swept frame, contained.
★ Wind in the cut: steady moderate flow with one stronger gust around mid-cut — the gust briefly intensifying the flapping of his shirt strips, the lift of his hair, the streaming of the bandana, and pushing more drifting snow through the frame, then easing back to moderate steady drift.

Continuous steady WIND throughout the 5 seconds stirring the torn shirt fabric across his chest, the strips of fabric flapping slowly in slow-mo. Frame washed cold and desaturated overall.

🔥 CAMERA — VINTERBERG-STYLE HANDHELD MEASURED 🔥
REAL-TIME at 24fps. Cinematographic style of Thomas Vinterberg, handheld doc-style — slow and measured. Live presence-of-camera handheld throughout, gentle breathing motion overlaid on the dolly-up and during the held end-beat. Snowflakes drifting close to lens early in cut (large soft-edged blurry snowflakes occasionally crossing the foreground depth at the close framing).

CUT = TOP-DOWN OVERHEAD 35mm handheld measured with SLOW VERTICAL DOLLY-UP across 0-9s, SMOOTH DECEL TO STOP 9-10s, HOLD STILL 10-15s. Camera starts at low height (0.7-1m) above Roko's face in close-up top-down framing, slowly rises straight up to moderate height (4-5m) across 0-9s, the rise SMOOTHLY DECELERATING across 9-10s into a soft natural stop, then HOLDS COMPLETELY STILL through 10-15s for the closing beat. Pure vertical movement only during the rise — no pan, no tilt, no horizontal drift. The lens stays pointed straight down throughout. Gentle handheld breathing motion overlaid on the dolly-up and during the held end-beat.

Cinematography: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins. 8K IMAX. 180° shutter motion blur. REAL PHYSICS — snow disturbed correctly, characters resting with weight on the snow, falling snow respects gravity. The slow dolly-up smooth and weighted, the rise gradual, the deceleration to stop natural and smooth (no abrupt halt — the camera eases into stillness across 9-10s), the held end-beat 10-15s completely still aside from handheld breathing micro-motion.

🔥 ENVIRONMENT 🔥
The blizzard wind has passed. Light gentle snowfall continuing — soft snowflakes drifting down rather than driven sideways by wind. The wind much quieter than during the blizzard, just a soft gentle breeze. The accumulated snow on the ground thick. Quiet aftermath.

🔥 CHARACTERS 🔥

<<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> — lean athletic teenager. Shaggy wet-matted dark black hair, soaked with sweat and snow-melt, snowflakes catching in his hair, faint mustache on upper lip. Multiple cuts and abrasions across his face — visible cuts on his forehead and temple, dirt and grime smudged across his skin, dark dried blood streaks across his temple and jawline, fresh blood at his nostrils, fresh blood at his split lip, fresh snowflakes landing and melting on his face, multiple tear tracks visible through the grime. Wears a TORN DARK SHORT-SLEEVE T-SHIRT — fabric SHREDDED and RIPPED OPEN across the chest, shoulders, and ribs, hanging in tattered strips, exposing most of his bruised bloody torso underneath: dark purple-red bruising blooming across his sternum and ribs, scrapes, abrasions, dirt and ash ground into the wounds. EXPOSED FOREARMS with multiple deep red CUTS AND ABRASIONS crisscrossing the forearms. Olive-grey-green heavy cargo pants dirty with mud and snow caked. Fingerless dark leather gloves on both hands with the loose RED bandana wraps around the wrists. Small dark teddy-bear keychain hanging from his belt. Dust-caked dark combat boots.

POSE: lying flat on his back face-up to the sky in the center of the formation, his crown at the apex meeting point with Jax's crown and Rein's crown, his body extending out from the apex toward the bottom of the top-down frame, arms loose at his sides, legs slightly spread. AT START OF CUT: his head turned toward SCREEN-LEFT (toward Jax's direction in the formation), his EYES OPEN looking at Jax. ACROSS THE CUT (during 0-9s dolly-up): his gaze slowly shifts toward camera, his eyes finding the lens, the smallest accompanying head rotation back toward straight-up so by the time the camera reaches its top position at 10s his face is turned up to camera and his eyes are locked on the overhead lens. AT END HOLD (10-15s after camera stops): his gaze HELD on camera — direct, locked, unbroken — through the closing held beat, snowflakes continuing to land on his face.

EMOTION — quiet exhausted aftermath, the survivor. Start: his eyes open turned toward Jax, looking at his fallen friend. By 10s: his gaze meeting the audience directly through the lens. End-beat 10-15s: gaze held during the closing static beat as the snow falls — the survivor's direct gaze as the world quietly looks back at him.

<<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> — slim teenager, lying on her back. Chin-length silver-grey platinum bob with dark navy-blue-black roots/tips, hair fanned out softly around her head against the snow at the apex, snowflakes catching in her hair. Thin vertical scar on left forehead/eye visible. FACE TURNED UP TOWARD THE SKY. EYES CLOSED — completely shut peaceful. Face calm, dirt-streaked, dark blood streaks from a cut at her temple/forehead. Wears DARK MATTE TACTICAL EXO-ARMOR — heavy black-charcoal armored panels across torso, shoulders, hips, thighs, dark exoskeleton tubing. Battle-worn — scuffs and scrapes, dust and dirt caked into the seams. Dark blood-pool around her head in the snow at the apex meeting point. FRESH SNOW ACCUMULATING across her body. NO BREATHING.

<<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> — Afro-American teenager, lying on his back. Short BLEACHED BRIGHT YELLOW buzzcut. NO SAFETY-GLASSES. FACE PAINT: TWO HORIZONTAL DARK OLIVE-GREEN STRIPES ACROSS EACH CHEEKBONE. Fresh dark blood from split lip and nostrils. FACE TURNED UP TOWARD THE SKY. EYES CLOSED — completely shut peacefully. Wears the dark grey-charcoal-and-black bomber/utility tactical jacket with charcoal panel inserts and small ORANGE/AMBER zipper pull accents on the chest pockets, hood DOWN. THE JACKET HAS A LARGE CENTERED ABDOMINAL/STERNUM WOUND with massive dark crimson-red blood saturation pattern radiating across the chest and lower abdomen. OLIVE-GREEN heavy cargo pants soaked dark with blood. Tactical thigh-strap holster on his thigh holding compact dark sidearm pistol. Fingerless dark leather tactical gloves. Dust-caked dark combat boots. FRESH SNOW ACCUMULATING across his upward-facing body. Dark blood pooled in the snow around his head at the apex meeting point. NO BREATHING.

🔥 SKIN 🔥
At the start of cut at the close framing: pore-level micro-detail on Roko's face from above — every small cut on his temple, every tear track, every snowflake landing on his wet skin and either melting or accumulating, every strand of his shaggy black hair, the wet dark eyes turned toward Jax, the trembling parting lips. Snowflakes drifting close to lens at this height visible as soft-blurred shapes in foreground depth. As the camera dolly-ups the detail level decreases naturally with the increasing distance — Roko's gaze finding the lens readable through the rise, the body forms reading clearly throughout, the formation reading with full clarity by 10s. During the held closing beat 10-15s the wide composition reads as the keyframe.

🔥 ACTING 🔥
Hollywood — quiet exhausted aftermath, the survivor. Roko's face turned toward Jax at start, eyes open looking at his dead friend. Across the cut his gaze shifts to camera — the contained immense grief now meeting the audience directly. The dolly-up reveal slowly opens out from his face to the full formation, contextualizing his grief within the larger tableau of his fallen friends. At 10s the camera stops at the wide and HOLDS — the final composition lingers for 5 seconds as the closing image, his locked gaze on the overhead lens through the held beat.

🔥 STILLNESS LOCK 🔥
<<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> and <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> are STILL throughout the cut. Their chests do NOT rise or fall. NO breathing motion visible. Both have eyes CLOSED — Rein's eyes closed peaceful, Jax's eyes closed peaceful. Their bodies remain limp and unmoving in the snow.

CUT — Handheld TOP-DOWN OVERHEAD 35mm measured doc-style on in QUIET POST-STORM SNOWFALL. Camera starts at LOW height directly above <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>>'s face in close-up top-down framing — Roko's face turned toward SCREEN-LEFT (toward Jax). Across the cut Roko slowly shifts his gaze toward camera, his eyes finding and locking on the overhead lens. SIMULTANEOUSLY the camera SLOWLY DOLLIES STRAIGHT UP across 0-9s, rising vertically until the framing reveals the full top-down formation as in @keyframe1. Across 9-10s the camera SMOOTHLY DECELERATES AND STOPS at the wide top-down position, then HOLDS STILL through 15s for the closing beat with the formation composition matching @keyframe1: <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> on screen-LEFT, <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> on screen-RIGHT, <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> between them with his face now turned up to camera, his eyes locked on the overhead lens during the held end-beat. Snow trampled around the formation, dark blood stains in the white powder, dark red-brown brush patches and grey rock outcrops at edges of frame by end. Light gentle snowfall drifting down throughout. 15s.

Geo: camera positioned directly OVERHEAD pointing STRAIGHT DOWN throughout the cut — pure vertical orientation, no tilt or pan. The camera STARTS at LOW height (roughly 0.7-1 meter above <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>>'s face, in close-up top-down framing on his face). At this start framing: Roko's face fills the frame from above — his shaggy dark wet black hair around his head against the snow, multiple cuts and abrasions across his face visible in pore-level detail, dirt and grime, dark dried blood streaks across temple and jawline, fresh blood at nostril and split lip, tear tracks through the dirt and blood, his EYES OPEN and his FACE TURNED toward SCREEN-LEFT (his head rotated so his eyes look toward Jax's direction in the formation, off the camera-axis at this start framing), wet dark lashes, lips slightly parted with shallow breath. Snowflakes drifting down through the close framing — large soft-edged snowflakes occasionally drifting close to the lens in the foreground depth, snowflakes catching in his hair and melting on his wet face. The snow surface visible right around his head — disturbed snow, the dark crimson blood-pool in the snow under his head at the apex.

ACROSS THE CUT: TWO SIMULTANEOUS ACTIONS UNFOLDING TOGETHER DURING THE 0-9s DOLLY-UP, then DECEL 9-10s, then HOLD STILL 10-15s. SNOWFALL FALLS THROUGHOUT.

(1) ROKO'S GAZE SHIFT: at start his eyes are turned toward Jax (screen-LEFT), looking at his fallen friend. Slowly across the early-mid portion of the cut his eyes begin moving — drifting away from Jax toward the camera/sky. The shift mostly through the eyes themselves, with the smallest accompanying rotation of his head back toward straight-up (his face slowly rotating from screen-LEFT-looking to camera-direct as his gaze finds the overhead lens). By mid-cut his gaze is finding the lens, his eyes locking on. By the time the camera reaches its top position at 10s his face is turned up to camera, his dark eyes locked on the overhead camera — the survivor's direct gaze meeting the audience. The look held — direct, knowing, unbroken — through the closing 10-15s static beat.

(2) VERTICAL DOLLY-UP, THEN DECEL, THEN STOP: SIMULTANEOUSLY the camera SLOWLY DOLLIES STRAIGHT UP — pure vertical rise, no other movement, the lens stays pointed straight down. As the camera rises:

EARLY (0-3s): the framing slowly widens from close-up on Roko's face (face turned screen-LEFT) to a tighter shot showing his head, the apex meeting point starting to come into view at top of frame (Jax's bleached yellow buzzcut and Rein's silver-grey platinum bob beginning to enter the upper edge of frame), Roko's torso beginning to come into the lower frame. Roko's gaze begins shifting during this phase. Snowflakes drifting down through the frame, at this height some flakes still drifting close to lens.

MID (3-6s): the framing widens to show the apex meeting point clearly with three crowns touching at the center of frame, Jax's body beginning to extend out toward upper-LEFT, Rein's body beginning to extend out toward upper-RIGHT, Roko's body extending out toward bottom-CENTER. The bodies' upper torsos and arms readable. Roko's gaze meeting the lens during this phase, the smallest head rotation back toward straight-up.

LATE (6-9s): the framing continues widening as the camera rises higher to moderate height (4-5 meters), the full top-down formation now visible matching @keyframe1: three crowns meeting at the apex meeting point, three bodies fanning out from the apex (Jax extending toward upper-LEFT with one fist thrown up wide and the other arm across body and legs splayed; Rein extending toward upper-RIGHT with arms thrown out and legs splayed; Roko extending toward bottom-CENTER with arms loose at sides and legs slightly spread, his face turned up to camera, eyes locked on lens). The dark crimson blood-pool stains in the snow around the head area at the apex visible spreading.

DECEL (9-10s): the dolly-up SMOOTHLY DECELERATES across this final second of movement — the rise easing into stillness with a natural soft slowing, no abrupt halt. The camera reaches its final wide top-down position by 10s, all vertical motion ending smoothly into the held beat.

END HOLD (10-15s): the camera is STOPPED at the wide top-down position. NO further vertical rise. The composition holds STILL — the full top-down formation matching @keyframe1, the closing image of the film. Only handheld breathing micro-motion remains in the camera. Roko's gaze locked on lens, held. Light gentle snowfall continuing to drift down across the wide frame visibly. The composition lingering as the closing 5-second beat — the still tableau of three bodies in the snow with the survivor looking up at the audience.

AT THE EDGES of the now-wide top-down frame during the END HOLD: dark red-brown frozen brush patches scattered across the snow (cluster at lower-LEFT, smaller patches around middle-LEFT and upper-LEFT, smaller patches at upper-RIGHT), half-buried bare grey rock outcrops on the LEFT side of frame and at the RIGHT edge of frame, tall pale grass blades and brush textures visible. The full landscape context revealed during the closing held beat.

Action: All three bodies lying in the formation throughout. <<<daf0186f-4651-4cf3-a8b4-6524ae16e227>>> and <<<74548308-e6cf-41f1-9cbe-3cc706281a26>>> STILL — no breathing, no movement, faces turned up to camera, lying motionless throughout. <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> ALIVE — at start his EYES OPEN looking toward Jax (screen-LEFT), across the 0-9s rise his gaze shifting toward camera and locking on the overhead lens by the time the camera reaches its top at 10s, his locked gaze HELD through the camera's stopped 10-15s closing beat. His chest rising and falling with shallow breath throughout. The smallest natural movements: his lips parting slightly with each shallow breath, his eyes blinking once slowly during the gaze shift, the faintest twitch of awareness in his face, snowflakes landing on his face and melting on his warm awake skin. Camera handheld measured holding the gentle vertical dolly-up rise across 0-9s, smoothly decelerating to a stop across 9-10s, then holding still for the 10-15s closing beat, gentle handheld breathing motion present throughout.

Audio: quiet post-storm ambient — the wind much softer now, just a gentle breeze, the soft hiss of light snowfall through the air. At start of cut close on Roko's face: his shallow exhausted breath audible close in the mix, the smallest catch in his breath, snowflakes whisper-landing on his face/in his hair audible close. As the camera dollies up the breath sound quieting/distancing slightly with the rising perspective. During the closing held 10-15s beat: the quiet wide ambient holds, his distant breath barely audible, the soft sound of the snow continuing. NO sobbing, NO words. NO music — just the quiet aftermath, the breath, and the falling snow.

Photoreal. NON-IP. 16:9. 15s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.

title: Scene_74 #9
prompt_text:
⚠️ ROKO ANCHOR (HARD LOCK):
BUILD: slim wiry lean — NOT muscular, NOT bulky. Junkie-thin survivor physique.
FACE: pale gaunt angular face, hollow sunken cheeks, sharp jawline, prominent cheekbones, narrow shape. Skin pale ashen wind-burnt.
EYES: deep-set dark brown-black, intense, set in shadowed sockets under heavy brow.
NOSE: subtle aquiline (slight bridge ridge), small horizontal RED MARK across the bridge.
FACIAL HAIR: ONLY a sparse thin dark mustache on upper lip — NOT thick, NOT bushy. NO BEARD. NO STUBBLE — clean-shaven smooth skin.
HAIR: long dark messy black, parted in the middle, hanging down on both sides past his cheeks, often falling into his face / over his eyes, wet damp matted disheveled.
WARDROBE: torn dark short-sleeve t-shirt shredded across chest/shoulders/ribs hanging in strips, exposed bruised bloody chest skin underneath visible at center sternum and collarbone area. RIGHT HAND BARE. LEFT hand wears black tactical fingerless glove with loose RED bandana wrap around left wrist. Olive-grey-green heavy cargo pants. Dark combat boots. Multiple cuts/abrasions on face, dirt and grime, dark dried blood at temple/jawline, fresh blood at split lip, fresh wet tear track on right cheek.

🔥 POSE — ON HIS KNEES (CRITICAL ACROSS ALL CUTS) 🔥
<<<b45115de-a4a5-4333-88a0-ec4c8209d302>>> is KNEELING on the snow-covered ground throughout the entire 15-second sequence. Knees pressed into snow, weight back on heels, shins folded under him. Upper body upright but kneeling. He is NOT standing, NOT lying down. The kneeling pose is maintained across all six cuts. He never stands up.

🔥 LOOK 🔥
Cold pre-storm grey overcast daylight, no hard sun, low light from heavy storm clouds. Photoreal Kodak 500T pushed cold, light film grain. 60:30:10 cold pale grey-white snow-covered ground + dark grey storm sky / dark stone-grey + saturated accents (blood crimson, RED bandana on left wrist, the three vein colors WHITE / RED / GREEN). Vinterberg handheld doc-style measured. 100fps capture played at 24fps (~4x slow-motion). 180° shutter. Lubezki × Deakins. 8K IMAX. Real physics. NO LUT, no oversharpening. NO LENS FLARES. NO anamorphic streaks. NO bursts. NO bloom haze. Clean optics throughout.

🔥 ARTIFACT 🔥
<<<fdbacf4c-db7d-4715-96b8-b62583316e80>>> — small palm-sized handheld talisman ~5cm tall. Clear faceted teardrop crystal cradled in dark patinated bronze claw setting. Crystal core BURNS with STEADY WHITE INNER LIGHT — constant, unwavering, NOT pulsing. Visible only in CUTS 1-2, GONE from CUT 2 onward (fully absorbed). Does not reappear in CUTS 3-6.

🔥 LOCATION 🔥
 — vast bare open snow-covered steppe, the GROUND IS COVERED IN SNOW (accumulated snow layer covering the ground completely, snow under his knees as he kneels, snow extending to horizon), but NO SNOWFALL IN THE AIR — no snowflakes flying, no precipitation falling, snowfall has stopped. The air is CLEAR of snow particles. Patches of dead frozen brown grass and tufts of dry pale-beige grass blades poke through the snow bending hard in the wind, scattered grey-stone rock outcrops half-buried in snow, occasional dark earth-brown patches where snow has been blown thin. Heavy dark grey storm clouds churning low in sky. PRE-STORM DRY WINDSTORM — strong cold wind sweeping continuously across the snow-covered landscape. The wind carries DUST and dry plant debris and grass fragments and dead leaves blowing sideways through the air at constant strong force — these dry windborne particles are visible in the air, NOT snow. The wind also picks up fine dry snow grains from the ground surface and blows them sideways close to the ground (visible ground-level snow drift / spindrift at the lowest portion of frame near the snow surface), but no falling snow from sky. The atmospheric mix: white snow-covered ground + dark grey storm sky above + dust-and-debris-filled windswept air between. Visibility moderate.

🔥 VEIN GLOW SYSTEM (CRITICAL) 🔥
Beginning at moment of artifact absorption in CUT 2 and intensifying through CUTS 4-5-6, <<<b45115de-a4a5-4333-88a0-ec4c8209d302>>>'s body activates with internal luminescence emanating FROM UNDER HIS SKIN through his vascular network on his TORSO AND NECK ONLY. Three distinct colors:

WHITE LIGHT (primary, central, brightest): originates from absorption point at sternum, radiates outward through major central veins. Visible glowing white-gold under skin of chest center, sternum, collarbone area, ascending up throat to suprasternal notch and up FRONT AND SIDES of NECK reaching MAXIMUM at underside of jaw — but NOT crossing onto face. Brightest of three.

RED LIGHT (secondary, near heart): warmer red-crimson glow visible in vein network around heart on left chest, ascending up carotid on LEFT SIDE OF NECK reaching up to but NOT past jawline. Slow heartbeat-like pulse, very subtle.

GREEN LIGHT (tertiary, peripheral): cool emerald-green glow on RIGHT SIDE — starting at sternum near absorption point, branching across right pectoral, up RIGHT SIDE OF NECK in fine emerald tracery, reaching up to but NOT past jawline. Steady cool emerald.

★ CRITICAL CONSTRAINT — VEINS DO NOT REACH HIS FACE ★ Three vein colors stop at JAWLINE / underside of jaw / sides of neck. Do NOT cross onto face. Face skin remains UNILLUMINATED FROM WITHIN — pale, weathered, bloodied, marked with dirt and tears and split lip, but NO vein-glow on cheeks, NO glow at temples, NO glow around eyes, NO glow on forehead. Face stays human, raw, in pain, lit only by ambient cold daylight from above. Vein system contained TORSO AND NECK ONLY, terminating at jawline.

The three colors do not mix — separated by anatomical region: white at center / red at left heart and left neck / green at right chest and right neck.

INTENSITY ARC: CUT 1 no glow. CUT 2 white starts at entry point during absorption. CUT 3 white still spreading at chest only. CUT 4 all three colors igniting on chest. CUT 5 all three reaching up to jawline. CUT 6 full intensity on torso and neck.

NO LENS FLARES from vein glow — light CONTAINED to under-skin luminescence only.

🔥 EMOTIONAL ARC — PAIN, NOT TRANSCENDENCE 🔥
Dominant emotion across all 15 seconds is PAIN. The artifact entering him HURTS — agonizing rite, not transcendence. He suffers as it goes in. Vein activation burns under his skin. He is on his knees because he COULD NOT STAND THROUGH IT. Pain is the through-line.

═══════════════════════════════════════

CUT 1 — HIGH ANGLE FROM BEHIND/ABOVE (THE THRUST) — 2s

35mm handheld HIGH ANGLE shot from BEHIND-ABOVE Roko, camera positioned approximately 1.5m above and 1m behind his kneeling position, looking DOWN AND FORWARD over his right shoulder and the back of his head toward his chest. FRAMING: dramatic high-angle composition with him in lower-center/lower-right of frame in small reading scale, the back of his head and right shoulder visible from above-behind, his right arm visible curving forward and inward across his body toward his own chest holding the artifact, his bare bruised chest visible from this elevated angle. Beyond his kneeling figure: the snow-covered ground around his knees, dust and dry debris streaking past in the air around him carried by the wind, ground-level snow spindrift visible at the lowest portion of frame, dark steppe receding into deep background. SHALLOW DOF f/2.8.

ACTION across 2 seconds: shot OPENS in motion — his right hand with the artifact pinched between thumb and index finger is already moving FAST in tight inward arc toward his bare chest. From this high-angle behind-above perspective we see the trajectory of the strike — the hand crossing from his right side inward to center sternum, bronze and crystal artifact a small bright point traveling inward in slow-motion. Within first 0.5 seconds the hand reaches his chest, crystal tip striking bare bruised skin at center sternum. Hand slamming with force. Artifact's WHITE BURN immediately lighting up impact point, visible from above as small concentrated white-warm point on chest. By 1 second from this angle visible: his back/shoulders TENSING from impact, his head starting to TILT BACK from the pain, hair cascading forward then backward from the motion, start of his chest expanding for inhale before scream. By 1.5 seconds head THROWN BACK fully, exposing throat and face in arched profile. By end of cut his mouth visible from this oblique high angle starting to open wide for the cry. Strong dry wind whips hair backward toward camera, dust and debris streaking in air around him. Camera handheld high-angle holding framing through rapid action.

═══════════════════════════════════════

CUT 2 — DUTCH ANGLE MACRO (THE ABSORPTION) — 2.5s

100mm handheld macro extreme close-up with DUTCH ANGLE TILT 30° camera-right (horizon canted hard, world out of balance), framed front-right of <<<b45115de-a4a5-4333-88a0-ec4c8209d302>>>'s chest at the absorption point. FRAMING: macro detail filling frame with bare bruised chest skin at sternum, artifact pinched between thumb and index finger pressed against skin, bronze claws visible, white-burning crystal facets, fingertips, surrounding bruised skin — entire composition CANTED 30° to camera-right, horizon line of his torn shirt collar slashing diagonally across upper frame, natural lines of body and artifact running diagonally creating visual instability and tension. The dutch tilt makes the moment FEEL WRONG, off-kilter, agony visualized in geometry. SHALLOW DOF f/2.8 macro.

ACTION across 2.5 seconds — absorption with canted geometry:

First 0.8 seconds: artifact pressed hard against sternum skin. Skin around contact point begins to YIELD — texture shifting where artifact touches, becoming soft like warm clay or thick still water, no rupture, no break. Artifact begins to SINK slowly into chest as skin accepts it inward.

Next 1.2 seconds: artifact descends into chest. Bronze claws disappearing first into sinking skin, then lower portion of crystal, then upper crystal facets — artifact moving downward through chest surface as if into thick liquid, skin closing slowly behind each portion. His fingertips pushing artifact deeper, thumb and index finger entering his own chest as artifact descends through the same yielding zone. White burn from crystal still visible at very top of artifact as it sinks, white light increasingly visible UNDER skin around absorption point as artifact buries deeper. Skin around entry zone luminous warm-white from artifact light passing through it from inside.

Final 0.5 seconds: artifact fully GONE — crystal fully descended, fingertips pulling out of absorption zone, skin closing CLEANLY behind withdrawal of fingers, no opening, no wound, no blood, no scar, just intact skin. Artifact GONE. In its place a strong concentrated WHITE GLOW visible UNDER THE SKIN at sternum.

NO BLOOD anywhere. Skin yields and closes like water. Strong dry wind continuous, dust visible in foreground bokeh. Camera handheld at locked dutch tilt holding 30° angle throughout. NO LENS FLARES.

═══════════════════════════════════════

CUT 3 — BIRD'S EYE STRAIGHT DOWN (THE SCREAM) — 2s

24mm handheld BIRD'S EYE shot directly OVERHEAD looking STRAIGHT DOWN at <<<b45115de-a4a5-4333-88a0-ec4c8209d302>>>'s upturned face from above. Camera positioned approximately 2m directly above his head, lens pointing straight down. FRAMING: his face DEAD CENTER of frame, turned upward toward camera (head thrown back from kneeling position so face points straight up at camera/sky), face fills middle of frame. Around face spread out from center: his shaggy long parted-middle dark hair fanned out in all directions on the SNOW-COVERED ground around his head as he kneels with head thrown back, hair splaying outward in slow-motion in wind like a dark halo against the white snow surface beneath, individual strands tossed by windstorm. Beyond hair at edges of frame: snow-covered ground at periphery, patches of dead grass poking through snow, hint of dust streaking across frame from above. Composition is RADIAL — face center, hair spreading out around it on the snow, world receding outward from his cry. SHALLOW DOF f/2.0.

★ HIS FACE FROM DIRECTLY ABOVE — fully visible: pale gaunt features, hollow cheeks, sharp jawline, small red mark on nose, sparse thin mustache, mouth WIDE OPEN in primal scream, jaw stretched, eyes squeezed SHUT hard from agony, brow furrowed deep, tears tracking from squeezed lids back across temples toward hair (from this overhead angle tears run sideways toward ears not down), capillary flush in cheeks from strain, fresh blood at split lip cracked wider, dirt and grime, wet tear track. Face UNILLUMINATED FROM WITHIN — no vein glow on face, only ambient cold daylight from above (camera position).

ACTION across 2 seconds: he is mid-scream from CUT 1 continuing — head thrown straight back so face points up at us, mouth wide open in sustained primal anguished cry of pain. From this overhead angle throat exposed below jaw (with start of white vein-glow visible at suprasternal notch JUST entering frame at lower edge as small warm point at throat, NOT on face). Hair fans on snow surface around head, strands moving slowly in wind in slow-mo creating beautiful radial motion against white snow background. Across cut scream sustains, face contorted in pain, then begins to fail by end as breath runs out. Strong dry wind visible blowing dust streaks across frame at this overhead angle. Camera handheld overhead holding straight-down framing, gentle drift around centered face composition. NO lens flares.

═══════════════════════════════════════

CUT 4 — REFLECTION IN ICE PUDDLE (VEINS IGNITE) — 3s

50mm handheld TILT-DOWN composition framing <<<b45115de-a4a5-4333-88a0-ec4c8209d302>>> AND HIS REFLECTION in a shallow puddle of meltwater on the snow-covered ground beside him (a clear patch where snow has melted into a thin puddle of water on darker exposed earth, rimmed by snow). Camera positioned at ground level approximately 2m to his right side, lens at ground/puddle level looking across the puddle past it toward him kneeling. FRAMING: lower half of frame contains puddle's surface filling lower composition — the dark meltwater with Roko's full UPSIDE-DOWN REFLECTION visible (kneeling figure mirrored, torso reflected, face reflected at top of his reflection appearing at bottom of puddle), faint distortion ripples on water surface from wind, snow rimming the edges of the puddle in the foreground. The framing on Roko stays roughly consistent in size even as the camera rises because the tilt compensates, but the surrounding context grows — more of the steppe visible, the full layout of the scene readable from above, the portal seen in spatial relationship to Roko approaching.

Roko continues walking toward the portal as the camera rises. The crystal armor continues spreading across his body. By the time the camera is approximately 15-20 meters above the snow, Roko is mostly transformed, his crystal armored body visible from above-behind in three-quarter aerial perspective.

Roko reaches the portal. As a fully transformed crystal knight, he takes the final step forward and walks directly into the swirling energy field. The vortex wraps around his armored form. He passes into the dark central void at the heart of the portal.

At the moment Roko enters the portal, the PORTAL COLLAPSES INWARD. The spiraling arms contract rapidly toward the center in slow-motion, the energy implodes from the full vortex form to a single bright point of lavender-white light in approximately 0.7 seconds. The single bright point flashes once and disappears. Roko is gone with the portal. The empty steppe is visible far below from the high camera position.

The camera continues rising — climbing higher above the now-empty landscape. The ground falls farther below, the steppe becoming more distant and abstract. The camera's tilt now transitions — having been looking DOWN at the action below, the camera begins to tilt UPWARD progressively toward the approaching cloud layer above. The horizon line moves down through the frame as the camera rises and tilts up. The dark grey storm clouds grow closer above.

The camera ENTERS THE STORM CLOUD LAYER. The dark grey churning cloud mass surrounds the camera as it passes into the moisture. The ground below disappears from view obscured by the cloud. Visibility reduces as the camera enters the cloud interior. The dark grey cloud mass churns around the camera on all sides — the storm itself the new environment. The lens points upward into the deeper cloud above. The camera is now fully inside the storm cloud layer — no ground visible, no horizon visible, only the dark churning cloud mass filling the frame from all sides, the storm interior the final environment.

The shot ends with the camera inside the cloud layer, surrounded by dark churning storm cloud mass, the lens facing upward into deeper cloud. The image dissolves into the storm.

The camera movement is ONE CONTINUOUS CRANE-UP throughout the 12 seconds — smooth and controlled, NOT handheld, NOT shaky. The rise is steady and graceful at controlled speed. The camera ascends from ground level to inside the cloud layer in one unbroken trajectory. The tilt changes progressively — first tilting DOWN to follow Roko's walk and approach to portal, then tilting UP after the portal collapses to look toward the approaching clouds. The transition between down-tilt and up-tilt is smooth and continuous across the second half of the shot. No stops, no jerks, no acceleration changes that read as cuts. ONE continuous flowing camera movement throughout.

🔥 ENVIRONMENT MOTION 🔥
Wind blows continuously across the steppe in the early portion of shot, visible in the dust streaming through air, snow spindrift drifting at ground level, Roko's hair lifting before transformation. The storm clouds above churn and roll throughout. As camera rises the ground wind effects become more distant. As camera enters the cloud layer the cloud mass churns visibly around the camera — moisture swirling, dark cloud forms moving, the storm interior alive with motion. The portal rotates and churns until collapse.

🔥 AESTHETICS 🔥
Color palette transitions across the shot. Early: cold landscape and bright portal — cold grey-white snow, dark grey storm sky, saturated purple-violet portal energy as focal accent, distant warm orange fire points, lavender-white from growing crystal armor on Roko. Mid: as camera rises the landscape colors become more distant, the portal still saturated until collapse. After collapse: cold landscape colors with no portal accent. Final: as camera enters cloud the palette becomes DOMINATED by DARK GREY churning cloud mass — variations of grey, deep shadow, faint light filtering through dark cloud. The final beats are pure dark grey cloud environment. Optics clean throughout.

🔥 AUDIO 🔥
Continuous strong cold wind howling at constant force in the early portion. Roko's boots crunching on snow with each step audible in seconds 0-4, fading as camera rises. Subtle crystalline chime sounds during transformation, soft glassy tones as each new body region transforms into crystal armor. Deep low-frequency hum from portal sustained until collapse. As Roko steps into portal: a deep resonant whoosh. At portal collapse: a sharp inward implosion sound, then sudden distant quiet. As camera rises past the empty steppe: wind sound shifts in scale — becoming wind of upper atmosphere, more diffuse and distant. As camera enters cloud layer: sound shifts to muffled quality of being inside cloud — wind sounds dampened by moisture, deep low atmospheric pressure sounds of storm interior, distant rumble of storm system. By final beat the sound is the muffled quiet of the storm interior — only the atmospheric presence of being inside the storm. No music throughout — only environment and transformation sounds.

🔥 CONTINUITY 🔥
ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT, no cuts, no scene transitions, no edits. Roko's walk pace stays steady throughout his walk to the portal. Crystal transformation progresses without reversing — once a body region is crystallized it stays crystallized. Portal stays stable until collapse. Camera ascent is continuous throughout the 12 seconds without stopping. Tilt transitions are smooth. The wind direction stays constant on the ground. The cloud cover above stays the same throughout (visible from below in the early portion, entered by camera at end).

🔥 FINAL FRAME 🔥
Final frame inside the storm cloud layer — dark grey churning cloud mass surrounding the camera on all sides, the lens facing upward into the deeper cloud, the world below completely obscured, no ground visible, no horizon visible, only the storm itself filling the frame. The camera dissolves into the cloud as the shot ends.

CUT 1 — GRIEF TURNING TO RAGE — TIGHT CLOSE-UP FRONT-RIGHT — 5 seconds

CUT 2 — VIOLENT THRUST AND COLLAPSE TO KNEES — MEDIUM CLOSE-UP THREE-QUARTERS LOW ANGLE — 4 seconds

The motion is fast and powerful even in slow-motion — the fist driving forward and down across his body, the artifact's white burn streaking through frame as the arm sweeps inward. His right hand which struck still visible at his chest — his fingers touching where the artifact entered, the artifact already absorbed beneath his skin not visible as object anymore, faint warm-white glow appearing at sternum where it entered. His face contorted in pain from what he has done, breath ragged and forceful, the roar/scream sustaining as cry of pain.

The camera reacts to his collapse with a small jolt as if operator flinched. Focus briefly hunts when subject distance changed and he came closer to camera, then snaps sharp.

Strong dry wind continuous, hair lashing, torn shirt strips fluttering, dust and debris streaking past in air. Optics clean.

═══════════════════════════════════════

CUT 3 — TREMBLING HANDS, HEAD RISES FORWARD — MEDIUM CLOSE-UP THREE-QUARTERS LOW ANGLE — 5 seconds

Roko on his knees, anchored at frame center, x=50%. Framed from approximately his lower torso and waist up to the top of his head, his torso and head occupying 70 to 80 percent of frame height. NO feet, NO knees on snow — framing stays on torso and head. Shallow depth of field at f/2.0 with focus pulls occasionally late.

Camera shake: heightened handheld continues from CUT 2 — unsteady, organic instability visible through slow-motion.

Focus pulls: focus occasionally late, hunting briefly during action then snapping sharp.

His right hand still touching his chest where the artifact entered, the faint warm-white afterglow at sternum visible under his bruised skin in soft focus. His face contorted in pain and shock fading, the forceful breath of the strike easing into ragged gasps. Smallest tremble through his torso settling.

Phase 3B, seconds 1 to 3: he slowly LIFTS BOTH HIS HANDS UP in front of his chest, palms toward his face. Both hands now visible in foreground at chest level, his face in middle frame above watching them.

The hands are VISIBLY TREMBLING — fine fast tremor through both hands, vibration of fine shaking. The slow-motion makes the small involuntary shaking visible in detail — fingertips shivering, back of hands trembling, wrists vibrating. Both hands shaking together. The tremor is the body's response to what just happened.

He STARES at his trembling hands — face above visible in three-quarter angle from below, eyes wide and focused on his own shaking palms. His expression complex: bewilderment, residual rage, grief returning, exhaustion. His lips slightly parted with ragged breath, breath fog visible drifting forward and dispersing. His tears still tracking down his cheeks — the grief did not leave when the rage came, both live in him now.

Focus moves between his hands and his face several times in this phase, sometimes catching one sharp and the other soft.

Phase 3C, seconds 3 to 5: his attention shifts. His head SLOWLY RISES — but not upward to sky, not lost in heavens. He raises his head FORWARD, looking ahead, into the distance ahead of him on the steppe — his eyeline crossing the horizon, looking at WHAT COMES NEXT. The motion reads as: rising up from looking-at-self to looking out at the world that still exists.

His hands during this phase fall slowly back down — out of frame at lower edge or resting back below frame. The camera tilts up slightly to follow his rising face, but keeps the medium close-up framing — does NOT pull back to wide.

His expression as his head reaches FORWARD horizon level: eyes focused now, no longer the wide bewilderment, no longer the rage, no longer pure grief — but something composed of all three. RESOLVE. Mouth still slightly parted with breath, tear tracks still wet on his cheeks, gaze AHEAD now, focused on a point in the distance, locked in.

The shot ends on this expression: kneeling man with absorbed artifact under his skin, face raised forward looking at what comes next, the soft-focus storm sky behind him visible only in bokeh, the wind continuing.

Strong dry wind continuous, hair lashing across his face, torn shirt strips fluttering at frame edges, dust and debris streaking through air. Faint warm afterglow visible at sternum under skin in soft focus. Optics clean.
