🔥 CONTINUITY 🔥
Three cuts total 14 seconds. Roko begins standing in CUT 1, drives artifact into chest in CUT 2 collapsing to knees, remains kneeling through CUT 3. His tears flow continuously across all three cuts — the grief never leaves even as rage and resolve enter him. Same location, same windstorm, same distant fires, same dark grey storm sky. Three emotional beats in sequence: grief→rage in CUT 1, rage→action in CUT 2, action→resolve in CUT 3.

ALL THREE CUTS STAY IN CLOSE-UP TO MEDIUM CLOSE-UP FRAMING — NEVER WIDE, NEVER FULL BODY, NEVER LANDSCAPE. CUT 1 is tight close-up on face. CUT 2 is medium close-up showing torso and head only — feet and knees never visible. CUT 3 is medium close-up showing lower torso and head only — feet and knees never visible. The camera maintains intimate framing through every beat including the action and collapse.

🔥 AUDIO 🔥
Continuous strong cold wind howling at constant force throughout, dust hiss, distant fire crackle, smoke drifting audible. In Phases 1B and 1C: building low growl in his throat as rage rises, by end of cut a primal furious low rumble starting. CUT 2: full primal furious ROAR bursting at moment of thrust, the roar continuing into pained scream as artifact enters chest, the impact thud at chest, audible thud of knees hitting snow off-frame at the moment of the collapse, breath forced out from impact. CUT 3: ragged exhausted gasping breath continues, the smallest sounds of his hands moving and clothing creaking, the wind dominant. No music throughout — silence and wind are the score.

The final frame holds on Roko's face raised forward in three-quarter angle from below in medium close-up, eyes focused ahead, the resolve composed of all three emotions, the soft-focus background behind him, the wind continuing. The framing stays close on his face and torso — never pulls back.

🔥 LOOK PRESET 🔥
Cold post-storm grey daylight, diffused, no hard sun. Photoreal Kodak 500T pushed cold, light film grain. 60:30:10 cold grey-white snow + grey sky / dark stone-grey rock + DARK RED-BROWN frozen brush / saturated accents (dark blood crimson, RED bandana wrist-wraps, the residual chest absorption glow, the 's blue-white-violet energy). Vinterberg-handheld doc-style measured. Real-time 24fps. 180° shutter motion blur. Lubezki × Deakins. 8K IMAX. Real physics. NO LUT, no oversharpening.

★ VEIN-GLOW (RECEDED): only faint last shimmer-traces visible on his exposed skin in CUT 1 (a few last bright threads at neck/forearms fading across the cut), gone by CUT 2-3.

★ RESIDUAL ABSORPTION GLOW: at his sternum where the artifact dissolved into him, soft warm-white residual glow pulses gently UNDER the bruised skin — alive across all three cuts.

★ ARTIFACT GONE — dissolved into his chest. NO artifact visible.

★ — COMPACT ENERGY PORTAL (CALIBRATED — take ONLY the swirling energy vortex effect from the prop sheet reference, NOT the floor/ground/BG environment from the reference image):
- SIZE: roughly 3x3 METERS in diameter — compact, passage-sized but not enormous, a contained rift in space (smaller than the reference's massive scale, scaled down to a more intimate door-passage size).
- TAKE FROM REFERENCE: ONLY the visual character of the swirling energy vortex itself — the swirling spiral plasma cloud structure, the dark central void/passage, the blue-white plasma core, the violet-purple cloud edges with sparks/embers, the bright energy core. DO NOT TAKE from reference: the polished floor surface, the massive scale, any background environment, the architectural context. The portal is just the vortex effect itself, transposed into our cold steppe environment.
- COLOR PALETTE (kept cold): pale BLUE-WHITE plasma core swirling around the central dark passage, VIOLET-PURPLE haze/smoke clouds boiling at the outer edges of the vortex, small bright sparks/embers of blue-white-purple energy flicking off the edges. NO orange/warm tones — the portal stays cold blue-white-violet to fit the cold steppe palette.
- STRUCTURE: dark central VOID (the passage — deep dark circular opening, the "through" point), surrounded by swirling cold blue-white-violet plasma vortex, violet-purple smoke/cloud edges boiling outward, sparks/embers flicking at edges as the vortex stabilizes.
- AT THE BASE: a softer/smaller bright vertical energy discharge from the bottom of the portal down to the snow surface — a column of bright blue-white plasma energy connecting the portal to the ground, more contained than the reference (since the portal is smaller), casting bright blue-white practical light onto the snow at its base.
- PORTAL POSITIONED CLOSE TO ROKO — only a few meters behind him (roughly 3-4 meters behind his kneeling position, NOT in the deep distance), so the portal is intimately close in the composition, a tangible physical presence right at his back. The portal's lower edge meeting the snow at this close position behind him.
- PORTAL CASTS PRACTICAL LIGHT — cool blue-white-violet practical illumination casting forward into the scene from the portal's location, lighting the surrounding air with a soft cold violet-blue haze, lighting the snow around the portal location with cool blue-white tones, lighting Roko's body from behind/beside with cool blue-white rim-light. The practical light is COLD-toned (NOT warm).
- AUDIO of the portal: a deep ALIVE LOW THRUM/ROAR — the sound of energy/space/atmosphere being torn open, layered with cracking-electrical sub-tones, a clear powerful resonance.
- DYNAMIC across the cuts:
 - CUT 1: NO portal yet — just empty steppe behind Roko.
 - CUT 2: portal OPENS — first a small bright tear/spark in space close behind Roko, rapidly EXPANDING into the full 3x3m swirling vortex over ~2-3 seconds.
 - CUT 3: portal FULLY FORMED off-frame behind/beside Roko, alive and stable, casting cold practical light into the close framing.

★ ENVIRONMENT — ACTIVE STEADY WIND WITH BLOWING SNOW (continuous):
Steady moderate steppe wind blowing sideways across the frame. Drifting snow streams skating sideways across the snow surface, fine airborne snow carried sideways through the air. Wind on Roko: shaggy dark wet hair lifting, tattered torn shirt strips flapping/fluttering, LOOSE RED BANDANA WRAPS at wrists streaming and fluttering, breath-fog carried sideways. As the portal opens in CUT 2-3 the wind near the portal subtly intensifies/disturbs (portal energy displacing air). <<<455232e3-57fa-4aad-8663-894758df74c5>>> — lean teenager, shaggy wet dark-black hair with snow caught in it (lifting in wind), wet strands plastered around face/temples/neck, faint upper-lip mustache. ═══════════════════════════════════════

CUT 2 — THE PORTAL OPENS CLOSE BEHIND ROKO (OVER-SHOULDER/BEHIND, REAL-TIME) — 5s
Wider 35mm handheld OVER-SHOULDER / BEHIND-ROKO angle, camera positioned a few meters behind Roko looking past him out at the empty steppe ahead. Lens at chest-level. Framing: Roko's BACK / shoulders / head visible as a foreground silhouette in the lower-foreground / lower-mid-frame (he's on his knees, kneeling silhouette readable from behind — the back of his shaggy dark wet hair, the back/sides of his shoulders, torn shirt strips fluttering at his back in the wind, the back of his torso/sides), the rest of the frame opening to the cold empty steppe stretching ahead into the BG (snow plane, cold pale grey sky, drifting blowing snow streaming sideways, low horizon).

THE STEPPE DIRECTLY BEHIND/ABOVE HIM in the MID-DISTANCE (not deep BG — close, only a few meters behind his kneeling position, ~3-4m back from where he kneels) — this is where the COMPACT 3x3m portal will open. His face holds the grim weight, mouth closed firm with hard breath visible as cold fog at his lips (carried sideways by wind). The portal continues swirling off-frame audibly. His shoulders subtly rising and falling with hard breath. The look held — the survivor before the door he killed his friends to open, alone, walking deliberately toward his own death because the mission requires it. The grim resolve carved into his face.

★ NO smile. NO laugh. NO relief. NO upward expression at any point in this cut. The expression is heavy, grim, committed, accepting of death.

title: Scene_74 #41
prompt_text:
Duration: 12 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9. ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT — single unbroken take with continuous TILT UP camera movement throughout, no cuts, no scene transitions, no edits, no crane, no jib.

⚠️ ROKO ANCHOR (HARD LOCK) — TRANSFORMS DURING THE SHOT:
At the start of the shot Roko is a slim wiry man in human form. Pale gaunt face, hollow cheeks, sharp jawline, deep-set dark brown eyes, slight aquiline nose with small red mark, sparse thin dark mustache, long messy black hair parted in the middle. Torn dark short-sleeve t-shirt shredded across chest and shoulders with multiple holes and blood-soaked patches. Bruised bloody chest skin visible underneath with embedded artifact at sternum emitting steady warm-white light. Right hand bare, left hand wears black tactical fingerless glove with red bandana wrap at left wrist. Olive-grey-green heavy cargo pants. Dark combat boots. Battle damage across face and body — cuts, bruises, dried blood, dirt and grime.

By the time Roko reaches the portal he is fully transformed into a crystal armored knight. His entire body covered in faceted translucent crystal armor — angular geometric facets like cut gemstone, clear-and-violet quality with luminous lavender-white energy glowing from within the plates. His silhouette underneath remains the silhouette of a slim wiry man. Crystal helm covers his skull, crystal pauldrons on shoulders, interlocking crystal plates on torso, crystal armor down his arms to crystal gauntlets, crystal greaves down his legs. The red bandana from his left wrist visible encased inside the translucent crystal armor at his left wrist as a saturated crimson note frozen within the lavender-white energy. The transformation grows progressively over his body as he walks forward toward the portal.

🔥 LOOK 🔥
Cold post-battle environment. The portal's purple-violet luminescence is the dominant practical light source in the early portion of shot. Photoreal Kodak 500T pushed cold, light film grain. Cinematic style of Lubezki crossed with Denis Villeneuve cosmic awe. 8K IMAX. 100fps capture played at 24fps for slow-motion. 180-degree shutter. Real physics. No LUT, no oversharpening. Optics clean throughout — no lens flares from portal energy, no rays, no bloom haze.

🔥 PORTAL 🔥
<<<PORTAL_UUID_HERE>>> — a massive swirling vortex of magical energy. Deep purple-violet-magenta luminescence forming spiraling arms curving inward toward dark central void at the heart. Brilliant lavender-white inner core at lower-center. Dark smoke and dust clouds churning at edges. Fine bright magenta sparks scattered across the energy field. Portal diameter approximately 2-3 meters, hovering slightly above the snow. The portal stays stable in size and position until it collapses inward to a single bright point and disappears at the moment Roko enters it.

🔥 LOCATION 🔥
 — vast bare open snow-covered steppe extending to the horizon. Snow-covered ground with patches of dead frozen brown grass. Distant smoldering fires visible at the horizon as small warm orange points. Heavy dark grey storm clouds churning low in the sky — these clouds will fill the frame at the end of the shot when the camera tilt reaches the upward orientation. Strong cold wind blowing across the steppe.

🔥 CAMERA POSITION — FIXED ON GROUND 🔥
The camera is positioned at GROUND LEVEL on the snow surface — approximately 30-40cm above the snow. The camera STAYS AT THIS FIXED POSITION throughout the entire 12 seconds of the shot. The camera does NOT rise, does NOT move in 3D space, does NOT translate forward backward or sideways. The camera position is LOCKED on the snow at this low height for the entire duration.

The ONLY camera movement is TILT — the lens orientation rotates upward progressively across the shot. The camera body stays in one fixed position on the snow while the lens angle tilts upward.

This is a TILT UP movement, not a crane up, not a jib up, not a dolly up. The camera stays planted on the ground throughout.

🔥 CONTINUOUS ACTION AND CAMERA DESCRIPTION 🔥

The shot opens at ground level — the camera positioned on the snow surface approximately 30-40cm above the snow, lens looking forward and slightly upward (about 10 degrees up from horizontal) at Roko's back. Roko is human at this moment, walking forward toward the portal which is visible ahead of him in the deeper distance against the storm sky. The dark grey storm sky visible at the upper portion of the frame above the portal. The camera frames Roko's full body from behind in low-angle perspective with the storm sky as the upper backdrop and the snow ground in lower foreground.

Roko walks forward at a steady measured pace, his combat boots planting in the snow with each step leaving boot prints. He moves toward the portal continuously throughout the shot. He does not look back. His shoulders are squared, head facing forward.

As Roko walks, translucent crystal armor begins growing over his body. The crystal emerges first from his sternum source point spreading across his upper back and shoulders. Then crystal extends down his arms — over his biceps, elbows, forearms, hands forming crystal gauntlets. Then crystal grows up the back of his neck and onto his head, plates forming around his skull encasing his long dark hair in flowing crystal strands. Then crystal extends down his legs, over his thighs and knees and shins, his combat boots becoming crystal greaves. The torn shirt is progressively replaced by interlocking crystal plates across his torso. The red bandana on his left wrist becomes encased in crystal but the red color remains visible inside. The transformation is gradual continuous growth as he walks forward — each body region transforms in sequence, the crystal armor spreading across him plate by plate over the duration of his walk to the portal. By the time he reaches the portal he is fully transformed into a crystal armored knight.

Throughout the first 6-7 seconds, the camera holds its low forward-angle orientation, framing Roko's back as he walks and transforms. The camera position stays fixed on the ground. The lens has only a slight upward tilt to keep Roko in frame as he walks away.

Roko reaches the portal. As a fully transformed crystal knight, he takes the final step forward and walks directly into the swirling energy field. The vortex wraps around his armored form. He passes into the dark central void at the heart of the portal.

At the moment Roko enters the portal, the PORTAL COLLAPSES INWARD. The spiraling arms contract rapidly toward the center in slow-motion, the energy implodes from the full vortex form to a single bright point of lavender-white light in approximately 0.7 seconds. The single bright point flashes once and disappears. Roko is gone with the portal. The empty steppe visible ahead with the snow surface stretching to the horizon, no portal, no Roko, only the dark storm sky above and the cold landscape below — with boot prints in the snow leading to the empty space.

Then the CAMERA TILTS UPWARD. The lens orientation begins rotating upward — the angle increasing from the slight upward forward angle to progressively steeper upward angles. The horizon line moves DOWN through the frame as the camera tilts up. First the snow ground exits the bottom of the frame, then the distant horizon line drops out, then we see only sky.

The tilt continues upward — the lens orientation continues rotating up. The dark grey storm clouds churning overhead come into the center of the frame. The clouds dominate the composition as the camera continues tilting up. We see the full underside of the storm cloud layer from below — the cloud mass churning and rolling, the dark grey texture filling the frame.

The tilt continues to its final orientation — lens pointing nearly straight up at the sky. The dark grey storm clouds fill the entire frame from edge to edge. The ground is completely off-frame below. The camera looks straight up at the storm. The cloud mass churns and rolls above the camera position, the storm visible in its full sky-filling presence from the ground perspective looking up.

The shot ends on this final orientation — camera position still fixed on the snow at ground level, lens pointing straight up at the storm sky, the dark grey churning cloud mass filling the entire frame, the ground left behind in our peripheral awareness as we look skyward.

🔥 TILT UP MOVEMENT DETAILS 🔥
The tilt is ONE CONTINUOUS rotation of the lens orientation throughout the shot. Smooth and controlled, NOT jerky, NOT sudden. The tilt rate is slow early in the shot (just slight upward angle while Roko walks) and accelerates after Roko enters the portal (the dramatic tilt up to sky happens after the portal collapse). The tilt rotation is continuous from forward-slight-up to straight-up across the 12 seconds. NO stops, NO jerks, NO pauses. The camera body stays planted on the ground throughout — only the lens angle rotates upward smoothly. One single continuous tilt-up movement.

🔥 ENVIRONMENT MOTION 🔥
Wind blows continuously across the steppe in the early portion of shot, visible in dust streaming through air, snow spindrift at ground level, Roko's hair lifting before transformation. The storm clouds above churn and roll throughout — early in shot visible at the upper edge of frame, becoming the dominant visual element as the tilt progresses upward. As the camera tilts up the cloud motion becomes the central focus — the clouds churning, rolling, the dark grey mass moving in real-time, the storm visible from underneath in its full atmospheric presence.

🔥 AESTHETICS 🔥
Color palette starts with the cold landscape and bright portal — cold grey-white snow at lower frame, dark grey storm sky at upper frame, saturated purple-violet portal energy as focal accent, distant warm orange fire points, lavender-white from growing crystal armor on Roko. As Roko transforms and approaches portal, the purple-violet portal light becomes more dominant. After Roko enters and portal collapses, the purple is gone — only the cold landscape and dark sky remain. As camera tilts up the landscape disappears from frame, the palette becomes dominated by DARK GREY churning cloud mass — variations of grey, deep shadow, faint light filtering through the storm clouds. The final beats are pure dark grey storm sky environment. Optics clean throughout — no lens flares.

🔥 AUDIO 🔥
Continuous strong cold wind howling at constant force throughout. Roko's boots crunching on snow with each step audible in seconds 0-4, fading slightly as he moves away. Subtle crystalline chime sounds during transformation, soft glassy tones as each new body region transforms into crystal armor. Deep low-frequency hum from portal sustained until collapse. As Roko steps into portal: a deep resonant whoosh. At portal collapse: a sharp inward implosion sound, then sudden quiet on the ground. After collapse: only wind across the empty steppe. As camera tilts upward to sky: the wind sound shifts slightly — the wind of the sky audible, the distant rumble of the storm system overhead, the atmospheric presence of the cloud layer above. By final beat: continuous wind plus distant low rumble of the storm system above the camera. No music throughout — only environment and transformation sounds.

🔥 CONTINUITY 🔥
ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT, no cuts, no scene transitions, no edits. Camera position FIXED at ground level on the snow throughout the entire 12 seconds — the camera body does not move in 3D space at all. ONLY the lens tilt angle changes. Tilt rotation is continuous and smooth from slight forward-up at start to straight-up at end. Roko's walk pace stays steady throughout his walk to portal. Crystal transformation progresses without reversing. Portal stable until collapse. Wind direction stays constant. The cloud cover above stays the same throughout.

🔥 FINAL FRAME 🔥
Final frame holds with camera position still fixed on the ground at the snow surface, lens pointing straight UP at the dark grey storm sky, the cloud mass churning and filling the entire frame from edge to edge. Cinematography: Emmanuel Lubezki x Roger Deakins — only natural light, contre-jour from left wall floor-to-ceiling glass windows, camera on shadow side. UNIVERSAL COMPOSITION RULE: rule-of-thirds, off-center, asymmetric. Subjects NEVER in dead-center; negative space intentionally on opposite side.

UNIVERSAL LIGHTING SOURCE LOCK — CRITICAL: ONLY natural light from the interior left wall floor-to-ceiling glass windows (faint cool-blue night scatter from outside, infiltrating LEFT to RIGHT inside the space). NO artificial light of any kind. NO ceiling lights. NO signage lights. NO orange/amber wash. NO yellow tones. NO Hollywood key/fill. Bulk of every body in DEEP near-black silhouette except cool-blue rim/edge light on left sides.

Reference plan — STRICT ROLE LOCK:
Use as the INTERIOR LOCATION + ENVIRONMENT + LIGHTING reference (abandoned pizzeria interior): LEFT wall = full floor-to-ceiling glass windows with rain pouring as continuous water curtain top-to-bottom on glass; vertical pillars with red trim/paint between window panels; RED LEATHER BOOTH SEATS with red-white checkered tablecloths along the windows (dusty, untouched, abandoned); RIGHT side = wooden service COUNTER, deeply shadowed, runs along the right wall; DEEP back = corridor with closed grey metal kitchen door. Use <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Gandelfina (woman): tall slim build, sharp contours, prominent cheekbones, clear jawline, platinum wavy mid-length hair STYLED IN VOLUMIZED PLATINUM WAVES — DRY, intact (she was protected by <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> outside before). The umbrella tip points FORWARD or sideways (NOT downward, NOT touching the floor at any point, NEVER vertical). prompt_text:

Genre: DRAMA. Mood: lostness, fear, isolation, dramatic tension. Cinematography reference: Emmanuel Lubezki x Roger Deakins language — only natural light, contre-jour from left wall floor-to-ceiling glass windows, camera on shadow side. NOT 3D render, NOT game engine, NOT CGI gloss, NOT game-cutscene aesthetic. 8K IMAX hyper-realism, physical anamorphic cine glass, 180-degree shutter motion blur, fine real photographic film grain, organic edge vignette, natural chromatic edge aberration. 24fps fluid motion.

UNIVERSAL COMPOSITION RULE — both shots: rule-of-thirds, asymmetric, off-center placement. Subjects NEVER in the dead-center of the frame, negative space intentionally on the opposite side.

UNIVERSAL LIGHTING SOURCE LOCK — both shots — CRITICAL: ONLY natural light from the left wall floor-to-ceiling glass windows (faint cool-blue night scatter from outside the windows, infiltrating LEFT to RIGHT inside the space). NO artificial light of any kind inside. NO ceiling lights. NO signage lights. NO orange/amber wash. NO yellow tones inside at any point. NO Hollywood key/fill from invisible sources. Bulk of every face and body remains in DEEP near-black shadow except where the cool-blue window scatter naturally reaches the left side of subjects.

Reference plan — STRICT ROLE LOCK:
Use as the LOCATION + ENVIRONMENT + LIGHTING reference for the INTERIOR of the abandoned corner pizzeria. Entry structure: outermost layer is a metal ROLLER SHUTTER (full-width, closed initially, rusty with wear marks, bottom edge has a horizontal metal handle that can be pushed up by hand from outside, rolls into the upper recess when raised — STAYS UP when fully raised). Inside the shutter at approximately 50 centimeters depth is a HEAVY DIRTY GLASS DOOR (transparent glass but visibly dirty with smudges, fingerprints, water marks, layered grime — the glass acts as a foreground texture and slight visual blur). The glass door opens INWARD with metal handles on both sides, requires effort to open (heavy hinges, low-pitched friction), and auto-closes slowly when released. Interior layout: LEFT wall = floor-to-ceiling glass windows (rain pours down the entire window surface as a continuous water curtain — not raindrops hitting, full unbroken water flow from top to bottom of glass); along the windows are RED LEATHER BOOTH SEATS with red-white checkered tablecloths (dusty, abandoned, untouched in place); RIGHT side = wooden service counter in deep shadow; DEEP back of the interior = corridor toward kitchen with a closed HEAVY GREY METAL KITCHEN DOOR at the far end (plain metal face, no decoration). The entrance sits in the mid-back of the interior depth.

Use <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Gandelfina (woman): tall slim build, sharp contours, prominent cheekbones and clear jawline, platinum wavy shoulder-to-collar-length mid-length hair STYLED IN VOLUMIZED PLATINUM WAVES — DRY, NOT WET, NOT clinging to cheeks (her umbrella protected her outside; her hair remains styled and intact going into the interior), ice-gray eyes with cool intelligent gaze, wears an extra-long black structured stiff coat past the knee (rain-darkened on shoulders only), inside a black leather bustier vest with deep V-neck, dark olive wide-leg pants, black laced leather heeled ankle boots. Right hand holds a black decorative cane with carved head and slim shaft. Left hand holds <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> (the FOLDED WET black umbrella from the previous scene). Her face is LIVING and PRESENT — natural blinks, micro-eye-movements, faint visible breath, throat micro-swallow.

Use <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Roko (man): compact strong build, olive-dark skin, very short upper-lip mustache, mid-length wet black messy hair clinging to face, bright red horizontal bandage strip across nose bridge, light gray sleeveless vest (wet, clinging to skin), black tactical crossbody bag, red cotton wrist wraps on BOTH wrists, dark crimson super-loose distressed jeans (wet), white-gray low-top sneakers.

Use <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Rain (woman): slim build, light silver-gray chin-length bob (wet, clinging to cheeks), fair skin with freckles, a single thin scar on the LEFT cheek only, purple cardigan hoodie (wet, heavy drape), dark print T-shirt, black slim flare pants (wet), white canvas sneakers (soaked), black single-shoulder tactical bag.

Use <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> as the UMBRELLA appearance reference: full-canopy black umbrella with slim shaft and a prominent CURVED HOOK HANDLE (J-shape, hook-style handle at one end of the umbrella). Action (Shot 1): At approximately 0.4 seconds, <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s LEFT boot LANDS into a deep puddle on the wet asphalt — water erupts outward in a real-physics hydrodynamic splash, droplets ejected up and out in a 360-degree radial pattern with visible weight and mass (NOT CGI particle scatter, NOT stylized fountain — real-water hydrodynamics with droplet trails). AT THE EXACT SAME INSTANT her right-hand black cane tip strikes the asphalt approximately 30 centimeters to the side of the boot, producing a secondary smaller but distinct splash. The two splashes form a synchronized double-point impact within the same frame. The puddle around the boot reflects the red "PIZZA SOUL" neon as a dark crimson light-halation in the water surface. Rain continues hammering the puddle surface throughout the 3.5 seconds, producing continuous small concentric ripples between the two main splashes. The two splash events settle into rippling water by approximately 2.5s, the rain continuing to strike the surface for the remaining time.
Audio (Shot 1): sharp boot-splash impact + simultaneous cane-tip ground-strike at 0.4s + continuous rain hammer + distant streetlamp electrical hum.

SHOT 2 — 3.5 to 7.5 seconds — Locked low-angle MCU, Gandelfina opens umbrella + sky flash sync
==========================

Camera (Shot 2): LOCKED, LOW ANGLE LOOKING UP at <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> from below — camera lens positioned at approximately 0.4 meters above wet asphalt in the alley street (NOT in the narrow gap, but on the alley side past the van), tilted upward toward <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s face and the storm sky above her. Platinum waves clinging to both cheeks. Her right hand holds the cane vertically beside her body for support (cane tip on wet asphalt, the carved cane head at hip height). SHOT 3 — 7.5 to 12.0 seconds — Handheld documentary coverage, Roko then Jax then Rain emerge naturally (NOT posing)
==========================

Camera (Shot 3): HANDHELD documentary-style coverage. The camera is held by an UNSEEN operator standing close to the open side door at chest height, breathing micro-shake plus deliberate operator pivots between subjects. The shake is observational and methodical, NOT chaotic — operator finds each face, lingers on the reaction, drifts naturally from one character to the next. The operator, on hand, methodically catches each one's reaction as they appear, drifting between them with documentary observation, NOT theatrical staging. NO theatrical pause-for-the-camera. Subject choreography (Shot 3) — verb-driven naturalistic acting, three distinct emotional registers:

[7.5–9.0s] <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> emerges first from the side door into the narrow gap between van and facade. He steps DOWN HARD and flat-footed onto the wet asphalt — no caution, no hesitation, no body-weight transfer ritual. He keeps moving forward immediately, walking through the gap toward camera direction at a steady moderate pace. He does NOT look up. He does NOT scan the alley. He does NOT pause for the camera. His eyes stay locked low and forward — a man processing inward, refusing to acknowledge the environment around him. Jaw set tight, wet black hair clinging to forehead, the bright red bandage strip on his nose bridge clearly visible. Once on the alley side, he keeps walking. One small unconscious gesture mid-stride: he brings the back of his right hand briefly across his nose and eye area to wipe off rainwater, then drops the hand — a fast involuntary swipe, NOT a deliberate gesture. He moves through frame at this steady moderate pace, body in tight controlled forward motion. Hands hang slightly fisted at his sides. He exits frame to camera-left by approximately 9.0s. Camera operator pivots to follow his profile briefly as he passes, then drifts back toward the door.

[9.0–11.0s] <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> follows. He steps down differently — one hand briefly touches the 's doorframe for support as he transfers his body weight out — exhausted, body weight forward. Once on the asphalt of the gap, he STAYS at the door for a half-beat, just standing, breathing. His chest rises slowly, visibly, under the wet beige work jacket. Then he takes two slow steps forward and STOPS — not staged, just because his body needed to stop. He opens his right hand and turns the palm up to catch the rain — looks at the water collecting in his palm for a full beat, watching the drops hit his open skin as if seeing them for the first time. His face is slack, exhausted — neither sad nor angry, just emptied of energy. The bright yellow buzz cut is wet flat to his scalp. After watching the rain on his palm he lets the hand drop, then keeps walking past camera at the same slow pace. Camera operator lingers on the upturned palm as the rain hits it (this is a 1-2 second held detail), then drifts back to his face as he resumes walking, exits frame to camera-left around 11.0s.

[11.0–12.0s] <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> emerges last. She does NOT step down immediately. She STOPS at the side door — one hand gripping the doorframe edge, knuckles tight on the wet metal. She turns her head slightly BACK INTO the van for one beat (looking back at the dark interior — for someone? for something?), but the van interior reveals nothing: total black void, no light, no figure visible, the privacy tint and the night exposure absolute. She turns her head forward again. Visible hard swallow at her throat. Steps down on a slightly shaking leg onto the asphalt of the gap. Once down, she does NOT walk forward. She stands at the door. Brings her right hand up to her face — wipes wet hair away from her left cheek with trembling fingers (the LEFT scar briefly visible as her hair clears). Then she TILTS her head UP and looks up at the rain falling on her face, closing her eyes for one full beat, letting the rain hit her closed eyelids. Eyes open again. She looks toward where the leftmost roller shutters of are (off-screen, toward where the group is gathering). She takes one small breath. She stays at the door — does not walk past camera. She is the last out and arrives at the group last, still beside the by the end of Shot 3 at 12.0s. Camera operator lingers tight on her face throughout these beats, naturally tracking the hand to her cheek, the head tilt upward, the eyes closing and opening.

Performance LOCK Shot 3: NO 45-degree pose-hold. NO theatrical center-of-frame pause. NO marking the frame. NO eyeline to lens. Each slowdown is driven by physical or psychological cause, NOT by staging. <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> has pre-existing redness around the eyes from earlier crying (NOT crying in this take, NO new tears generated, NO sobbing) but no explicit visible tear lines required — her vulnerability reads through hesitation, hand-to-cheek gestures, the back-into-van look, the rain-on-face moment. <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>'s emotional register is contained anger withdrawal — forward only, no look around. <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>'s register is exhausted wonder — present in body but emptied, the palm-out-to-rain detail is his beat. <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s register is hesitant trauma — door-grip, look back, hair-wipe, rain-on-face, breath, hesitate.

HARD CUT at 12.0s.

==========================
SHOT 4 — 12.0 to 15.0 seconds — Handheld surveillance wide profile from behind a parked civilian car
==========================

Camera (Shot 4): HANDHELD, ALIVE, NERVOUS POV — this is the EYE of a hidden observer crouched behind a parked civilian car (sedan or compact hatchback) on the camera-near side of the alley street. The camera does NOT smoothly zoom, does NOT smoothly pan, does NOT do a steady track, does NOT do a smooth slide-out reveal. Instead the motion is jerky, jittery, twitchy — small unsteady handheld micro-corrections, small head/body shifts as the hidden observer adjusts their hiding angle, one or two quick involuntary "duck" or "look-up" micro-movements (as if the spy is keeping low). The shake is observational and HUMAN-OBSERVER, NOT smooth gimbal-stable, NOT chaotic chaos — alive and twitchy. Throughout the entire 3 seconds the FRONT END of the parked civilian car (hood, headlight, front A-pillar visible) cuts into the LOWER-LEFT FOREGROUND of the frame — the spy is peeking PAST the car's hood/A-pillar at the scene further down the alley to the right. Anamorphic, focal length medium-wide for the profile composition.

Spatial blocking (Shot 4) — composition LEFT to RIGHT across the frame:
LEFT FOREGROUND: the front end of the parked civilian car (hood, headlight, A-pillar) cuts into the frame as the hiding-spot obscurement.
MID-LEFT to CENTER (mid-distance): the three characters <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>, <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> and <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> stand in a loose unstaged grouping in profile — their LEFT sides facing the camera, their FRONT facing the storefront off to the right of frame. They have arrived at the group and are standing in front of 's leftmost roller shutters area.
CENTER-RIGHT to MID-RIGHT (mid-distance): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> stands further along to the right in the formation — closer to the. Profile to camera, holding the open <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> above her head.

Action (Shot 4):
<<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>: stands still in the FRONT-RIGHT position of the formation (closest to the pizzeria), umbrella up, water sheeting off the canopy edges in continuous streams. <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>: stands tight at the rear-left of the three-character group. Profile to camera. Eyes locked on the leftmost shutters. Jaw set hard. Mid-shot (around 13.0s) he brings one hand briefly up to wipe rain off his nose bandage with a quick back-of-hand swipe, then drops the hand back to his side. Body otherwise still, controlled, tight.

<<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>: stands slightly slumped beside <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>. Profile to camera. Head not as low as in Shot 3 — he has lifted his gaze to look at the shutters too, but his eyes are dull and lidded, present but not focused. Slow visible breathing, chest rising. Hands hang. Wet yellow buzz cut clinging to scalp. Occasionally his head sways slightly with breath.

<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>: stands at the back-most position of the three, slightly behind <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> and <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>. Profile to camera but turned slightly toward the shutters. Hands clutched around her own arms in a self-comforting body wrap. Eyes wet, scanning the shutters then up at the corner awning then back down — small involuntary head movements driven by where her eyes go. The LEFT-cheek scar is briefly visible when she tilts her head slightly. Visibly the most distressed of the four, but quieter now — past the immediate scan of Shot 3, into a softer apprehension.

NONE of the three react to the camera. NONE look across the alley toward the camera position. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> also does not look toward the camera — her gaze stays forward at the pizzeria. The hidden observer is unseen by the group.

Performance LOCK Shot 4: alive nervous handheld POV. NO smooth zoom. NO smooth pan. NO steady slide-out. NO clean Hollywood profile-line framing. The parked car front end cuts into lower-left foreground throughout. The four characters in profile face right toward the. NO fourth-wall break. The 3 characters continue their distinct emotional registers from Shot 3 in quieter sustained form; <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> stays composed and assessing.

==========================
SHARED LOCKS — all 4 shots
==========================

Performance lock (all shots): Hollywood-level — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line precision, wet living eyes with practical-light catchlights and micro-saccades, visible breathing with chest rise and fall, micro-swallow before any vocal beat (no dialogue is present in this take but the autonomic micro-swallow is naturalistic), involuntary micro-expressions between emotional beats. NO performing TO the camera. NO fourth-wall break. NO direct look at lens. Each character's identity match to <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> / <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> / <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> / <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> locked through all four shots — no clothing change, no hair change (all hair stays wet-clung to face/scalp throughout), no detail drift (red nose bandage on <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>, red wrist wraps on <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>, yellow buzz cut on <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>, silver bob + LEFT scar on <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>).

Physics lock (all shots): Real gravity, inertia and motion follow-through. Mass with real weight. Correct contact shadows. NO floating props. The two splash events in Shot 1 are real hydrodynamic with weighted droplets, NOT CGI particle scatter. The umbrella canopy in Shot 2 unfurls with real fabric physics, NOT stiff CG geometry. Rain-on-canopy and water-sheeting-off-edges are physical fluid behavior. Low ground steam plumes are volumetric atmospheric, NOT particle effect. Wet-asphalt halations are diffuse light reflections, NOT mirror puddle imaging.

Continuity locks (across all 15 seconds):
Night state PITCH-BLACK held. Torrential rain density held. 3-layer fog density held (mid-atmosphere ambient haze + rain vapor suspension + streetlamp practical-cone scatter halos — all held throughout). Streetlamp orange-amber contre-jour + red neon secondary sidelight + cool-white building-eaves point pinpricks held throughout. storefront identity held throughout: leftmost (corner) roller shutters with FOR RENT placards, red-and-white checkered awning, "PIZZA SOUL" red neon, sloped tile roof at corner, overpass overhead with hanging cables. parked position held throughout: PARALLEL to left facade, REAR-END longitudinally aligned with leftmost (corner) roller shutters, side sliding door on the FACADE side of the van OPEN throughout (interior fully black-tinted and invisible at every frame, no light through tinted windows). Character identities held throughout: same clothes, same wet hair states, same accessory details, same emotional state continuum (<<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> stone-mask anger-after-crying / <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> shutdown / <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> desperation-after-crying / <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> authoritative-restraint). <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> present in <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s hand from 4.0s onward and held through Shots 2, 3 and 4 — open canopy from 4.0s. The civilian parked car across the alley exists from the beginning but only becomes visible in Shot 4. NO crying ACTION on <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> (red eyes and tear tracks are pre-existing throughout, never generated within the take). NO van interior light leak through tinted glass at any point. NO mirror reflections doubling characters in puddles. NO age labels.

Audio (SFX only, present throughout the full 15 seconds):
Torrential rain hammering the metal closed roller shutters of and the matte-black roof at high intensity (continuous through all 4 shots, including across the hard cuts — the rain audio bed is the glue between shots). At 0.4s: synchronized boot-splash impact + cane-tip ground-strike. From 4.0s onward: umbrella canopy snap-open click followed by rain-on-canopy thudding sound + continuous water-sheeting-off-canopy-edges. Distant low thunder rumble approximately 2 seconds after the 4.0s lightning flash (very soft, never sharp, never close). From 7.5s onward through Shot 3: faint footsteps of <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> / <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> / <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> on wet asphalt, fabric rustle of wet clothes, occasional tactical-bag strap creak, micro-wet breathing audible at the documentary handheld proximity. Throughout: rain dripping from 's sloped tile roof, streetlamp electrical low-frequency hum, side-sliding-door metal-track creak. NO music. NO score. NO subtitles. NO dialogue. NO CGI particle hiss — water splashes are physical fluid, steam is atmospheric.

Final frame (at 15.0s):
The handheld alive POV holds the same jerky position behind the civilian parked car — the parked-car front end (hood, headlight, A-pillar) still cuts into the lower-left foreground. Across the alley in mid-distance, the four characters remain arranged LEFT-to-RIGHT in the frame: <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>, <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> and <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> in profile facing right (toward the ), and to their right <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> also in profile facing right, umbrella up, water sheeting off the canopy. parked parallel to the facade in the deeper right background, rear-end aligned with the leftmost shutters, side door still open with interior fully black. The leftmost roller shutters and corner awning at the right edge of frame. Torrential rain continues across the entire frame. The frame ends in surveillance-hold tension — something has arrived, the four characters are there facing the storefront, but the hidden alive eye behind the parked car continues to observe, unrevealed.

[REFERENCES + IDENTITY ANCHORS]
 — abandoned commercial kitchen at night: stainless prep counter, large rectangular order-window cut into one wall (chest-to-head height, faintly back-lit from beyond — the ONLY light source in the room), a heavy plain matte industrial metal door (single flat leaf, dark grey-black, NO signage, NO visible handle, flush flat surface) on the wall opposite to the order-window, white tile floor with grout lines. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> — woman ~50s, silver-platinum wavy bob, pale-grey eyes, deep-red matte lips, small chin mole. Long open black wool overcoat over fitted dark leather vest with central zip, deep-green palazzo trousers, dark heeled ankle boots, tall ornate dark twisted-iron cane in screen-LEFT hand. <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> — man ~30s, mid-length wet-disheveled black hair across forehead, faint mustache, slim wiry build. Multiple small bloodied cuts and red blood streaks on face/shoulders/arms. Small horizontal RED medical nose-tape across bridge of nose. Grey ribbed tank-top with blood spatter, deep-red distressed wide-leg jeans, dark sling-bag diagonal across torso with small red plush-bear keychain. Lock: face + wounds + nose-tape + outfit.
<<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> — Black man ~20s, very short bleached-yellow buzzcut, faint blood scratches on screen-LEFT temple/cheek. Beige-yellow weathered military bomber jacket with tactical patches, sand-grey heavy cargo pants, black tactical gloves, beige sneakers, large khaki sling utility bag diagonal across torso. <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> — woman ~20s, sharp grey-and-black bob (silver-grey on top, near-black underneath), pale skin, faint red scratch on screen-RIGHT cheekbone, soft pale-blue eyes. Oversized purple zip-hoodie open over cropped dirty-grey tank, dark slim flared jeans, dark canvas sneakers, dark utility sling-bag diagonal across torso (right hip). Lock: face + bob + purple hoodie + sling-bag.

[SPATIAL LAYOUT]
Abandoned commercial kitchen at night, near-pitch-black ambient. The ONLY light source is the order-window in one kitchen wall — faintly back-lit from beyond, providing soft cool ~5500-6000K grey-white directional light that catches edges of subjects only. Heavy plain matte metal industrial door set into the wall on the OPPOSITE side of the room from the order-window. The metal door is CLOSED throughout the entire scene — it does NOT open, NO mechanical movement, NO light gap.

CUT 1 layout (single-file column in profile, all facing screen-RIGHT toward the metal door, screen-LEFT to screen-RIGHT in frame):
- <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> at x=18% (back of column, furthest from door)
- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> at x=32%
- <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> at x=46%
- <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> at x=62% (closest to door, standing right against it)
- Metal door fills x=78-95% of frame as a flat dark matte slab.

CUT 2 layout (camera repositioned 90° to be between the trio and the door, looking back at the trio's faces; <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> and the closed metal door are now BEHIND camera, off-frame):
- Trio side-by-side row, frontal to camera at chest-height: <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> x=22%, <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> x=42%, <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> x=62%.
- Order-window: visible in deep BG behind the trio at screen-LEFT-CENTER, faintly glowing as a cool-grey horizontal slot, slightly out of focus.

[SCENE CONTEXT]
A dark-mystic-thriller beat. Four figures wait in a near-pitch-black abandoned kitchen at a closed metal door. The door does not open in this scene — they wait, and we watch them wait. The dramatic engine is the silent unraveling of the trio: each holds a different version of the same dread, and as we cut from the cold profile tableau to the intimate frontal medium, each begins to break in their own way and leaves the formation one by one — Roko first with hard intent, Jax next with hesitation, Rain last with quiet fear.

[STRICT / WORLD LOCK]

All performance: micro-pauses, natural blinks, faint visible breath in cold dark air. NO performing TO camera. NO direct-to-lens look. NO theatrical posing. NO mannequin stillness.

Composition lock — both shots: off-center, rule-of-thirds, asymmetric. NEVER dead-center.

Physics lock — both shots: real gravity, inertia, motion follow-through. Cane strikes on tile with real wooden/tile resonance. Damp clothing clings realistically. Breath visible in cold dark air as faint silhouette puff. The webbing strap of <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s bag deforms naturally under her tight grip — the strap visibly compresses where her fingers clench. NO floating props. NO CGI particle effects. NO door action of any kind — there is no door being opened, no hinge motion, no door swinging in this scene.

Continuity locks across all 10 seconds:
 environment held throughout: near-pure-black darkness with only two faint sources (pass-through service window cool-white scatter on the left wall behind characters + red point indicator light near the closed elevator). NO exterior scene visible through the pass-through window — only soft cool-white scatter, no readable scene. NO orange/amber/yellow tones. NO frontal/side fill anywhere.

The CLOSED ELEVATOR DOOR on screen-RIGHT stays CLOSED throughout — it does NOT open at any point. The trio does NOT enter.

The PASS-THROUGH SERVICE WINDOW on the LEFT WALL is the ONLY light source in the kitchen — its cool-white scatter is locked throughout. There is NO metal entry door anywhere in this scene. There is NO door-opening action by any character. Characters simply appear from off-frame screen-LEFT already walking.

The WALKING DIRECTION is LATERAL LEFT-TO-RIGHT IN PROFILE — characters walk parallel to the camera image plane, NOT toward camera, NOT away from camera, NOT diagonally into deep background.

<<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> HAIR DRY+STYLED throughout. RIGHT hand cane, LEFT hand empty (no door action, no item).

Trio (<<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>/<<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>/<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>) damp hair clinging throughout. Identities held per refs.

<<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> spine ABSOLUTELY VERTICAL throughout — NO forward-lean, NO back-lean, NO slouch. Chin subtly UP in Shot 2.

<<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> head BOWED LOW throughout — does NOT lift at any point. Eyes-up-under-bowed-brow stare in Shot 2 only.

<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> right hand on bag strap throughout Shot 2 — grip locked from ~7.5s onward, tightens at ~9.8s. Tears pre-existing trails only — NO new crying generated.

NO age labels. NO mirror reflections doubling characters. NO theatrical staging.

Audio (SFX only, all 10 seconds):
Shot 1 (0–7s): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s cane CLINKS on dirty tile floor with rhythmic CLINK-CLINK at each step (clear tile-metal reverberation in the empty kitchen acoustic). Footsteps of the four on the dirty tile during the lateral profile walk. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s micro-swallow before speaking (~2.8s). <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s DIALOGUE at 3.0–6.0s in low steady tone: "Long before humans walked the Earth, there was a war between angels and demons." After dialogue: silence settling. Final cane CLINK at the stopping moment ~6.5s. Then deep kitchen silence.

Shot 2 (7–10s): kitchen silence. <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s sharp audible nasal INHALE at ~7.1s. <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>'s slow controlled nasal inhale + lip exhale through the take. Faint webbing-strap creak as <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s hand grips it tightly. Faint coat fabric creak from <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> at edge. Silent gaze exchange between <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> and <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> (no audio, just silence).

NO music. NO score. NO subtitles. NO additional dialogue. NO CGI particle hiss. NO rain. NO storm. NO exterior weather sound. NO door hinge creak. NO door action.

==========================
FINAL FRAME (at 10.0s)
==========================
The LOCKED STATIC medium-close 45° on trio holds. <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> at frame edge in silhouette, spine vertical, chin subtly UP, breath cycle complete. <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> mid-frame with head BOWED LOW and eyes UP-UNDER-BOWED-BROW staring at <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> off-frame in stunned surprise. <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> mid-frame with her right hand GRIPPING THE BAG STRAP across her chest, knuckles white, faint body tremor in her shoulders. Deep kitchen darkness fills negative space. The pass-through service window cool-white smudge sits in the deep background-left. The CLOSED elevator door is off-frame at screen-right (the trio has not entered, the door has not opened). The shot ends on the trio's silent reaction — the revelation has landed, no one is moving, the room is sealed in near-pure-black silence.

title: Scene_15-16 #13
prompt_text:
[REFERENCES + IDENTITY ANCHORS]
 — abandoned commercial kitchen at night: stainless prep counter, large rectangular order-window cut into one wall (chest-to-head height, faintly back-lit from beyond — the ONLY light source in the room), heavy plain matte industrial metal door (single flat leaf, dark grey-black, NO signage, NO visible handle, flush flat surface) on the wall opposite to the order-window, white tile floor with grout lines. Lock: room geometry + order-window position + metal-door position.
<<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> — woman ~50s, silver-platinum wavy bob, pale-grey eyes, deep-red matte lips, small chin mole. Long open black wool overcoat over fitted dark leather vest with central zip, deep-green palazzo trousers, dark heeled ankle boots, tall ornate dark twisted-iron cane in screen-LEFT hand. Lock: face + hair + outfit + cane.
<<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> — man ~30s, mid-length wet-disheveled black hair across forehead, faint mustache, slim wiry build. Multiple small bloodied cuts and red blood streaks on face/shoulders/arms. Small horizontal RED medical nose-tape across bridge of nose. Grey ribbed tank-top with blood spatter, deep-red distressed wide-leg jeans, dark sling-bag diagonal across torso with small red plush-bear keychain. Lock: face + wounds + nose-tape + outfit.
<<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> — Black man ~20s, very short bleached-yellow buzzcut, faint blood scratches on screen-LEFT temple/cheek. Beige-yellow weathered military bomber jacket with tactical patches, sand-grey heavy cargo pants, black tactical gloves, beige sneakers, large khaki sling utility bag diagonal across torso. Lock: face + bleached buzzcut + jacket color + bag.
<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> — woman ~20s, sharp grey-and-black bob (silver-grey on top, near-black underneath), pale skin, faint red scratch on screen-RIGHT cheekbone, soft pale-blue eyes. Oversized purple zip-hoodie open over cropped dirty-grey tank, dark slim flared jeans, dark canvas sneakers, dark utility sling-bag with strap going diagonally OVER HER ANATOMICAL-LEFT SHOULDER (screen-RIGHT shoulder in frontal-camera view) DOWN to her anatomical-right hip; bag itself rests at her right hip. Lock: face + bob + purple hoodie + sling-bag-orientation.

[SPATIAL LAYOUT]
Abandoned commercial kitchen at night, near-pitch-black ambient. The ONLY light source is the order-window in one kitchen wall — faintly back-lit from beyond, providing soft cool ~5500-6000K grey-white directional light catching edges of subjects only. Heavy plain matte metal industrial door set into the opposite wall — CLOSED throughout the entire scene, NEVER opens.

CUT 1 layout (single-file column in profile, all facing screen-RIGHT toward the metal door, screen-LEFT to screen-RIGHT in frame): <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> x=18% (back of column) — <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> x=32% — <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> x=46% — <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> x=62% (closest to door, against it) — metal door fills x=78-95% as flat dark matte slab. Order-window: off-screen-LEFT-back, providing rim from screen-LEFT-back direction.

CUT 2 layout (camera repositioned to be between trio and door, slightly off-axis, looking back at trio's faces frontally; <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> and metal door now BEHIND camera, OFF-FRAME): trio side-by-side row, frontal to camera at chest-height: <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> x=22%, <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> x=42%, <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> x=62%. Order-window visible in deep BG BEHIND the trio at screen-RIGHT-CENTER, faintly glowing as a cool-grey horizontal slot, slightly out of focus. Light rim from order-window now arrives from SCREEN-RIGHT-BACK direction onto the trio's right-side edges.

[SCENE CONTEXT]
A dark-mystic-thriller beat at HOLLYWOOD-NATURALIST PRESTIGE-DRAMA acting level — sincere, lived-in, internal-first performances of the kind seen in prestige feature drama (Villeneuve / Chazelle / A24 register). The emotional truth of three young people choosing to step into unknown danger — one at a time, each driven by a different dominant emotion — is THE central engine of the scene from frame zero. Each is a connected witness to the others; each reacts in real time to the others' choices. The acting must feel observed, not performed; restrained-yet-deeply-felt; NOT theatrical, NOT melodramatic, NOT performed-to-camera.

[STRICT / WORLD LOCK]

⚠️ ACTING DIRECTIVE (HARD LOCK):
Performance level: Hollywood-naturalist prestige-drama. Each trio member carries one DOMINANT EMOTION:
- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> = ANGER + READINESS + CONFIDENCE. Contained barely-suppressed fury directed at the situation. He goes first because anger gives him forward momentum. His commit-to-step beat is marked by a HEAVY DEEP INHALE — the "alright, let's fucking go" breath.
- <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> = SHOCK / SURPRISE / INCOMPREHENSION → SYMPATHETIC RELUCTANCE. First reaction to Roko leaving is genuine shock-disbelief ("wait, he actually went?"). After a brief stunned pause he turns to <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> with a friendly, slightly sad, regretful gaze — the "I'm sorry darling, but we have to go" register. Apologetic, sympathetic, gently pleading.
- <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> = LIGHT FRIGHT BEFORE THE UNKNOWN + PURE ANXIETY. She is the most afraid. Her face shows visible mild fright (eye-glints wider, defensive posture, jaw tension) throughout her solo phase. Anxiety EXTERNALIZES through the strap-rubbing tic. Her back-glance at the order-window carries the internal thought "maybe I should run instead."

All emotion reads through SILHOUETTE language since faces are in heavy shadow — body posture, head turns, breath cadence (chest/shoulder rise visible), eye-glint micro-movement, hand action.

⚠️ CONTINUOUS LIFE + CROSS-CHARACTER REACTIONS (HARD LOCK on CUT 2):
EVERY character at EVERY second is alive — visible breathing (chest/shoulder rise on each inhale), natural blinking (~1 blink per 2-4s for <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> / <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>, faster ~1 per 1.5s for <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> due to fear), micro eye-glint shifts (gaze tracks something every 1-2s), small natural body micro-shifts (weight transfers, micro head-tilts). NO frozen static poses at any point. The trio is alive throughout the entire 12s.

Additionally, characters REACT to each other's actions in real time — they are three connected witnesses, NOT three isolated performers:
- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>'s head-snap (~1.5s) → <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> eye-glints flick toward <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>, <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> visible micro-flinch + breath catch
- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>'s heavy inhale + first step (~2.5s) → <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s near hand REACHES UP smoothly to grip the bag strap (the anxiety tic activates HERE, not before), <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>'s eye-glints track <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>
- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>'s exit past camera (~3.5s) → <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> shock beat triggers (eye-glint widening, breath catch), <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> breath catch + grip on strap visibly tightens
- <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>'s gaze-at-<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> (~4.5s) → <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s eye-glints meet his briefly, micro acknowledgment (tiny inhale, barely-perceptible head-shake)
- <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>'s exit (~7.0s) → <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> visible distress escalation (faster breath, head tilt down, shoulders raise faintly in defensive micro-shift)

⚠️ LIGHTING (HARD LOCK across both cuts):
- Kitchen ambient: near pitch-black. ONLY light is cool-grey directional rim/back-glow from order-window. NO ambient fill, NO bounce, NO overhead, NO practicals, NO light from metal door (sealed and DARK), NO warm tones.
- CUT 1: rim from order-window off-screen-LEFT-back catches back-edges of subjects facing screen-RIGHT.
- CUT 2: rim from order-window in screen-RIGHT-CENTER deep BG catches the screen-RIGHT-side edges of the trio (right-side cheek edge, right-side shoulder, right-side hair edge).
- Faces in CUT 2 are SEMI-SILHOUETTE: contour edges of cheek/nose/jaw catch faint cool back-rim from screen-RIGHT-back, eye-wet catches faint glints. Brow shape, mouth detail, skin texture NOT clearly visible. Brightness LEVEL of faces is CONSTANT throughout the entire 12s — NO progressive brightening.

⚠️ MOTION HIERARCHY (HARD LOCK):
- NORMAL SPEED THROUGHOUT both cuts. NO slow-motion, NO speed ramps.
- CUT 1: all 4 STATIONARY, only barely-perceptible breathing micro-motion. Held tableau.
- Metal door is CLOSED throughout BOTH cuts, NEVER opens, NO movement, NO mechanical sound, NO light gap.

⚠️ HARD-CUT TRANSITION (HARD LOCK):
- CUT 1 → CUT 2: hard cut at end of CUT 1. NO dissolve, NO match-cut. CUT 2 begins immediately at 90° camera reposition. Trio re-forms from column to side-by-side row across the cut (off-screen, instantaneous via the cut).

⚠️ CAMERA PASSAGE on CUT 2 EXITS (HARD LOCK):
Each trio member walks TOWARD camera and PASSES BY CAMERA on its screen-RIGHT side AT FULL UPRIGHT POSTURE, exiting through the screen-RIGHT EDGE of the frame at chest-height.
- They do NOT duck.
- They do NOT bend.
- They do NOT crouch.
- They do NOT walk under the camera.
- They do NOT exit through the bottom of the frame.
- Camera at chest-height; characters' heads remain ABOVE camera level as they approach lens. As each gets within ~0.5m of camera they angle slightly screen-RIGHT and walk past lens at full standing height, exiting through the screen-RIGHT edge of frame.

[CUT 1 — WIDE PROFILE STATIC ESTABLISHING, ~3s]

WIDE 24-35mm pure side-profile shot. Camera completely locked-off, NO push / NO pull / NO pan / NO tilt / NO zoom / NO rotation / NO shake. Eye-height, perpendicular to the line of characters.

Frame composition (screen-LEFT to screen-RIGHT): <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> (x=18%), <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> (x=32%), <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> (x=46%), <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> (x=62%, against the metal door, cane vertical in her near hand tip resting on tile), metal door (x=78-95%, flat dark matte slab). All four in pure profile facing screen-RIGHT.

Lighting: faint cool-grey rim from order-window off-screen-LEFT-back catches back-of-hair / shoulder-back / silhouette edges of all four. Faces facing screen-RIGHT in deep shadow.

ALL FOUR STAND COMPLETELY STILL. Only barely-perceptible breathing micro-motion (chest-rise on side-profile silhouettes ~once per second). NO walking, NO head turns, NO gestures, NO talking. Held tableau.

NO DIALOGUE.

Audio: deep room silence. Faint distant low-frequency hum from inactive kitchen equipment. Very faint shallow breaths from all four. NO music, NO subtitles.

[CUT 2 — MEDIUM FRONTAL HANDHELD ON TRIO, ~12s]

MEDIUM 35-50mm frontal-on-trio. Camera positioned between trio and (closed, off-frame-back) metal door, slightly off-axis, at chest-height, looking at trio's faces straight-on. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> and metal door BEHIND camera, OFF-FRAME entirely.

Camera HANDHELD with moderate organic shake (~4-6 Hz, breath-driven, no large drift). Camera HOLDS its position — NO tracking, NO push, NO pan, NO orbit, NO tilt. Position stays put through the entire 12s.

Frame composition: <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> x=22%, <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> x=42%, <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> x=62% — chest-up framing of all three side-by-side. Order-window in deep BG BEHIND trio at screen-RIGHT-CENTER, faintly glowing cool-grey slot, slightly out of focus.

⚠️ ACTING REGISTERS + EXIT BEATS + CROSS-REACTIONS (HARD LOCK, sequential — Hollywood-naturalist, silhouette-readable, continuous micro-life throughout):

<<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> PRIMARY beat (~0-3.5s): register ANGER-CONTAINED-RESOLUTE.
- Phase 1 (~0-1.5s): head dropped chin-toward-chest in barely-contained fury (NOT submission — controlled rage). Jaw clenched hard, visible angular jawline silhouette. Shoulders rigid and squared with anger-tension. Hands at sides curled into half-fists. Breath measured-controlled through nose. Eye-glints faintly visible directed downward at floor. Natural blink ~once per 2s.
- Phase 2 (~1.5-2.5s): head SNAPS UP — sharp determined motion, decision made. Eye-glints lock straight forward toward off-frame metal door (behind camera). Brief chest-expansion.
- Phase 3 (~2.5-3.5s): pivots forward and TAKES A HEAVY DEEP INHALE simultaneous with his first step toward camera (~2.5-2.9s) — visible significant chest expansion, shoulders rise then settle, audible long breath in, the "alright, let's fucking go" beat. Then walks STRAIGHT TOWARD camera at confident measured stride. Silhouette grows larger as he approaches lens. At ~3.3s angles slightly toward screen-RIGHT and walks PAST camera at FULL UPRIGHT POSTURE on lens's screen-RIGHT side, exiting through screen-RIGHT edge at ~3.5s. He does NOT duck, NO bending. Does NOT look at <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> or <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> at any point.

<<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> BACKGROUND (~0-3.5s, while <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> is the primary beat): standing alive, blinks ~once per 3s, breath visible. At ~1.5s eye-glints flick screen-LEFT toward <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> (~10° micro head-shift) registering Roko's head-snap. At ~2.5s breath catches subtly as Roko begins to move. Eye-glints track Roko's silhouette as he walks past camera (~2.5-3.5s).

<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> BACKGROUND (~0-3.5s): standing alive, hands at sides initially (NOT yet on the bag strap). Anxious blinks faster ~once per 1.5s, shallow breaths visible. At ~1.5s small visible flinch + breath catch as Roko snaps his head up. At ~2.5s as Roko begins to walk, her HAND (the one on her screen-RIGHT side of body — near her LEFT shoulder anatomical, where the strap is anchored) REACHES UP smoothly to grip the diagonal sling-bag strap at her sternum (visible silhouette of arm bending up to chest). Hand reaches strap ~2.5-2.7s, fingers settle on strap webbing. Strap-rubbing tic begins immediately — thumb and index finger CONTINUOUSLY rub the webbing back-and-forth in fast micro-friction motion. Eye-glints track Roko's exit with growing fear.

<<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> PRIMARY beat (~3.5-7.0s): register SHOCK-DISBELIEF → SYMPATHETIC-APOLOGETIC.
- Phase 1 (~3.5-4.3s): SHOCK reaction to Roko's exit — eye-glints widen visibly, brief head-jerk back ~5°, breath catch, momentary frozen disbelief. Internal: "wait — he actually went?" Holds shocked stillness for a brief beat ~0.8s.
- Phase 2 (~4.3-5.5s): head PIVOTS sharply toward screen-RIGHT toward <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> (sharp clean rotation ~45°). Eye-glints lock on <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s silhouette. The look — read through silhouette posture + eye-glints + slight forward lean of head + soft brow-area (no harsh angles): friendly, slightly sad, regretful, gently pleading. Internal: "I'm sorry darling, but we have to go." Apologetic-sympathetic-grief register. Holds gaze ~1.0s. (NOT panicked, NOT angry, NOT cold.)
- Phase 3 (~5.5-6.0s): head pivots back forward. Visible chest-rise — breath of resignation. Half-step forward then PAUSE for ~0.4s — incomprehension turning into reluctant acceptance.
- Phase 4 (~6.0-7.0s): commits, walks toward camera with full steps at slower pace than Roko's (uncertainty in stride). At ~6.7s angles toward screen-RIGHT and walks PAST camera at FULL UPRIGHT POSTURE on lens's screen-RIGHT side, exiting through screen-RIGHT edge at ~7.0s. NO ducking, NO bending.

<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> BACKGROUND (~3.5-7.0s): hand still gripping bag strap at sternum, fingers continuously rubbing webbing. At ~3.5s breath catch + visible grip tightening on strap (fingers visibly press harder into webbing) as Roko exits past camera. During Jax's shock phase (~3.5-4.3s) — Rain holds still, eye-glints jitter, fast shallow breath. During Jax's gaze-at-her (~4.3-5.5s) — her eye-glints meet his briefly, tiny inhale + barely-perceptible head-shake (acknowledging his sympathy without affirming the decision). Strap-rubbing continues throughout, micro-friction speed increases slightly. During Jax's exit (~5.5-7.0s) — visible escalating distress: head tilts slightly down, shoulders raise faintly in defensive micro-shift, breaths get faster.

<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> PRIMARY beat (~7.0-12.0s): register LIGHT-FRIGHT + ANXIETY + LAST-LOOK-FAREWELL.
- Phase 1 (~7.0-8.5s): now alone in frame. Light FRIGHT visible in silhouette and face — eye-glints wider than before catching faint back-rim, head slightly tilted down (defensive micro-posture), shoulders raised faintly in fear-tension, jaw soft and slightly trembling (visible micro-tremor on jaw silhouette). Breathing fast and shallow (visible chest rises ~once per 1s — fear-breathing). Hand still gripping strap at sternum, fingers continuously rubbing webbing. Eye-glints unfocused but visible, gaze drifts.
- Phase 2 (~8.5-10.5s): she tries to gather courage. Two slow blinks (eye-glints extinguish ~0.5s each) — moments of shutting her eyes against the fear. Deep slow inhale-exhale cycle (chest rises slow, falls slow) — attempt to steady herself. Then breath returns to fast cadence. Eye-glints flick down to floor briefly then back up. Strap-rubbing CONTINUES. Visible internal struggle — fright vs obligation.
- Phase 3 (~10.5-12.0s): she finally takes a small hesitant step forward toward camera at ~10.8s (slow, fear-overruled-by-obligation, not courage). At ~11.0s as she begins moving, her HEAD AND UPPER TORSO ROTATE TOGETHER toward SCREEN-RIGHT in a single fluid backward look-OVER-SHOULDER motion — head pivots ~75° to screen-RIGHT, AND her upper torso (shoulders + chest) ROTATES partially ~30° to screen-RIGHT. prompt_text:
Duration: 15 seconds total. Aspect ratio: 16:9. FOUR timed shots joined by THREE hard montage cuts (no dissolves, no morphs, no wipes). Mode: R2V.

Genre: DRAMA. Mood: loneliness, lostness, fear, dramatic tension. Cinematography reference: Emmanuel Lubezki x Roger Deakins language — only natural light and on-set practicals, contre-jour from streetlamps, camera on shadow side, full atmospheric haze. NOT 3D render, NOT game engine, NOT CGI gloss, NOT game-cutscene aesthetic. 8K IMAX hyper-realism, shot on physical cinema cameras with physical anamorphic cine glass, 180-degree shutter motion blur, fine real photographic film grain, organic edge vignette, natural chromatic edge aberration. 24fps fluid motion.

UNIVERSAL COMPOSITION RULE — all 4 shots:
Avoid central/symmetric framing in every shot. Use rule-of-thirds and asymmetric placement. Subjects are off-center, never aligned to the dead-center vertical or horizontal axis of the frame. Negative space is intentional, placed on the opposite side of the subject. NO Hollywood symmetric centered framing.

Reference plan — STRICT ROLE LOCK:
Use as the LOCATION + ENVIRONMENT + LIGHTING reference: corner pizzeria with red-and-white checkered "PIZZA SOUL" awning wrapping the corner, sloped tile roof at corner, closed rusted leftmost (corner) roller shutters with FOR RENT placards across the storefront facade, large concrete overpass crossing directly above the corner with dense overhead electric cables hanging from the piers. Streetlamp orange-amber practical above, red "PIZZA SOUL" neon as red secondary sidelight, low cool-white building-eaves point lights. The reference image does NOT control camera angle, framing, composition, lens, shot size or camera height.
Use <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Gandelfina (woman): tall slim build, sharp contours, prominent cheekbones and clear jawline, platinum wavy shoulder-to-collar-length mid-length hair (wet from rain, clinging to cheeks), ice-gray eyes with cold knife-like gaze, wears an extra-long black structured stiff coat past the knee (color darker when wet, fabric heavy under rain pressure), inside a black leather bustier vest with deep V-neck, dark olive wide-leg pants, black laced leather heeled ankle boots, right hand holds a black decorative cane with carved head and slim shaft.
Use <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Roko (man): compact strong build, olive-dark skin, very short upper-lip mustache, mid-length wet black messy hair clinging to face, bright red horizontal bandage strip across nose bridge, light gray sleeveless vest (wet, clinging to skin), black tactical crossbody bag, red cotton wrist wraps on BOTH wrists, dark crimson super-loose distressed jeans (wet), white-gray low-top sneakers.
Use <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Jax (man): dark skin, lean build, BRIGHT YELLOW very-short buzz cut (wet, clinging to scalp), beige/khaki patterned work jacket (wet), black gloves, single-shoulder tactical backpack, loose light-gray work pants (wet), gray-white sneakers.

Use as the VEHICLE appearance reference: large matte-black cargo van, fully dark privacy-tint film on ALL windows (interior completely invisible at any point), slim red light-strip tail lights, side sliding door — the side sliding door is OPEN throughout the entire take, opening toward the facade direction (the door is on the FACADE-FACING side of the van, NOT toward the alley street).
Use <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> as the UMBRELLA appearance reference for Gandelfina's umbrella: full-canopy black umbrella with slim shaft and curved handle, used by <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> from Shot 2 onward.

Spatial scene anchor (consistent across all 4 shots):
Location is a back-alley street corner of a 2050 Asian working-class megacity. The corner storefront occupies one corner of the alley. The is parked on the alley street approximately 3 to 5 meters from the leftmost (corner) roller shutters, with its REAR ORIENTED TOWARD the leftmost shutters. The trio <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> / <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> / <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> remain INSIDE the van (invisible behind tinted windows) through Shots 1 and 2 — they only emerge in Shot 3.

THREE-LAYER atmospheric cinematic fog stack: (1) mid-atmosphere ambient haze blanketing the alley at high density, (2) rain vapor suspension layer, (3) streetlamp practical-cone scatter halo layer. Main light is streetlamp ORANGE-AMBER CONTRE-JOUR from above (streetlamp positioned behind/above the characters, throwing them into orange rim-light silhouette). The red "PIZZA SOUL" neon provides RED SECONDARY SIDELIGHT on faces and the platinum/yellow/silver hair tones. Low building-eaves COOL-WHITE point practicals add cold pinpricks. EXPOSURE: only practical-lit faces, body parts and reflective wet surfaces read above near-black; the background, sky, walls without direct practical light read as near-pure-black silhouette. Color palette (60-30-10) across all 4 shots:
60% NEAR-BLACK dominates: wet asphalt outside practical pools, dark closed roller shutters, unlit alley walls, matte-black body, dark overpass underside, building walls without direct practical hit. 30% streetlamp orange-amber contre-jour + rain vapor halos + red signage secondary light. 10% distant cool-blue neon smudges in the deeper alley background.

Action (Shot 1) — slower dramatic timing:
At 0.5s, <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s LEFT boot enters the frame from above. The boot HOVERS in the air for approximately 0.3 seconds — visible mid-air pause, body weight transferring slowly — building dramatic tension. At approximately 0.9s the boot LANDS into a deep puddle on the wet asphalt — water erupts outward in a real-physics hydrodynamic splash with weighted droplets, NOT CGI particle scatter. Approximately 0.15 seconds AFTER the boot impact (at approximately 1.05s), her right-hand cane tip strikes the asphalt approximately 30 centimeters to the side of the boot, producing a secondary smaller distinct splash — DOUBLE IMPACT with audible/visible lag between the two events (NOT perfectly synchronized — the rhythm is rhythm-asymmetric). The puddle around the boot reflects the red "PIZZA SOUL" neon as a dark crimson light-halation in the water surface. Rain continues hammering the puddle surface throughout. The boot leather reflects faint streetlamp orange contre-jour. The remaining time (1.05s to 3.5s) holds on the rippling water settling, the boot stationary, rain continuing to strike — building lonely atmospheric weight.

Audio (Shot 1): muffled boot-splash impact at 0.9s + cane-tip ground-strike at 1.05s with audible lag + continuous heavy rain hammer + distant streetlamp electrical hum + faint alley reverberation.

HARD CUT at 3.5s.

==========================

Camera (Shot 2): LOCKED, LOW-ANGLE LOOKING UP at <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> from below — camera lens positioned at approximately 0.4 meters above wet asphalt, in front of <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> (between her and the facade), tilted upward toward her face and the storm sky above.
