Composition is ASYMMETRIC and OFF-CENTER — <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> is NOT in the dead-center of the frame; she sits along a rule-of-thirds vertical line (offset to one side), with negative space (the storm sky and cityscape silhouettes) balancing the other side.

Spatial blocking (Shot 2): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> stands with HER BACK TO — the is BEHIND her (out of frame or partially visible as dark mass behind her shoulders). She faces the camera direction (toward the, since the camera is between her and the pizzeria). Her body fills the vertical middle of the frame off-center to one side, head and face in the upper-middle portion, her gaze level forward or slightly upward toward the storm sky. The storm-night CITYSCAPE visible BEHIND her as the dominant background — distant overpass with warm sodium streetlamp pinpricks, hyperdense building silhouettes far in the deep alley, near-black storm sky with heavy cloud cover. She reads as near-silhouette against the urban storm-night background, rim-lit by warm sodium streetlamps and side-lit faintly by red neon spilling from off-screen.

Action (Shot 2): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> stands at the open van side door (her back to the open door behind her), long black structured coat heavy and rain-soaked. Platinum waves clinging to both cheeks. Her right hand holds the cane vertically beside her body for support. AT THE EXACT INSTANT the <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> canopy fully opens (at 4.0s), a SHEET LIGHTNING FLASH pulses in the sky behind/above <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>. The lightning NEVER appears as a drawn line, NEVER as a fork, NEVER as a branch, NEVER as a zigzag, NEVER as a stick, NEVER as a streak, NEVER as a stylized graphic, NEVER as a traced shape, NEVER as a visible bolt of any kind, NEVER as any pointed or linear graphical element. UNIVERSAL COMPOSITION RULE — all 4 shots:
Avoid central/symmetric framing in every shot. Use rule-of-thirds and asymmetric placement. Subjects are off-center, never aligned to the dead-center vertical or horizontal axis of the frame. Negative space is intentional, placed on the opposite side of the subject. NO Hollywood symmetric centered framing.

==========================

==========================

- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>: ANGER + DISTRUST dominant. Stone jaw, bloodshot conjunctiva. Shot 2: gaze locks on <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s back with anger.
- <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>: SADNESS + WORRY/CONCERN dominant. Head UP, present, lucid. Shot 3: gaze on <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>'s back with worry.
- <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>: FEAR + active grief (visible in Shot 1, off-frame in close-ups).

All characters: micro-pauses, natural blinks, wet living eyes with cool-blue scatter catchlights, visible breathing, micro-swallow, involuntary micro-expressions. NO performing TO the camera. NO direct-to-lens. NO theatrical posing. NO mannequin stillness.

Composition lock — all 4 shots: off-center, rule-of-thirds, asymmetric. NO dead-center placement.

Physics lock — all 4 shots: real gravity, inertia, motion follow-through. Wet umbrella drips real water with weight. Metal-on-metal contact at coat rack hook is real physical interaction (curved umbrella hook engages curved rack hook). Wet clothing clings realistically. NO floating props. NO CGI particle scatter.

Continuity locks across all 15 seconds:
PITCH-BLACK night outside throughout. Cool-blue faint window scatter ONLY light source inside (in Shot 1; in Shot 4 the rack is at the back wall, only minimal cool-blue ambient reaches indirectly). NO artificial light. NO orange/amber/yellow tones. interior identity held: glass windows with water curtain (visible in Shot 1), booth seats with checkered tablecloths (visible in Shot 1), wooden counter shadow (in Shot 1), deep back-left corridor with grey metal kitchen door (visible partially in Shot 4), tall dusty standing coat rack adjacent to the kitchen door (in Shot 4). Character identities held throughout. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s HAIR DRY+STYLED throughout. Trio WET HAIR throughout. <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> is CLOSED/FOLDED+WET throughout (HORIZONTAL in <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s left hand during walking; HUNG on the standing coat rack hook from ~14s in Shot 4 via its curved hook handle). NO mirror reflections. NO age labels. NO vehicles in frame at any point.

Audio (SFX only, across all 15 seconds):
Continuous rain bed muffled through walls + water curtain on left wall windows (heard in Shot 1, fainter in close-ups). Shot 1 (0–4s): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s cane strikes wood floor rhythmically + four characters' footsteps + water curtain on windows. Shot 2 (4–8s): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s cane strikes off-frame ahead + <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>'s footsteps + faint breath. title: Scene_15-16 #21
prompt_text:
Duration: 11 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9. THREE timed shots joined by TWO hard montage cuts. Mode: R2V.

Genre: DRAMA · dark mystic thriller. Mood: dread, mystery, revelation, decision beat. Cinematography reference: Emmanuel Lubezki x Roger Deakins — natural light only, severely restricted to absence of light until the elevator door opens. NOT 3D render, NOT game engine, NOT CGI gloss, NOT game-cutscene aesthetic. 8K IMAX hyper-realism, physical anamorphic cine glass, 180-degree shutter motion blur, fine real photographic film grain, organic edge vignette. 24fps.

UNIVERSAL COMPOSITION RULE — all 3 shots: rule-of-thirds, off-center, asymmetric. NEVER dead-center.

==========================
UNIVERSAL LIGHTING SOURCE LOCK — DARKNESS UNTIL ELEVATOR OPENS
==========================
 interior is in NEAR-ABSOLUTE DARKNESS from 0.0s to ~7.0s. ZERO active artificial lighting fixtures in the kitchen. NO red light cast on any character at any frame.

Three light sources only across the whole take:
(1) PASS-THROUGH SERVICE WINDOW on the LEFT WALL of the kitchen — provides cool-white BACK-RIM light along the back-of-heads/hair-tops/back-shoulders as characters walk past it (Shot 1) and as the trio stands with backs toward it (Shot 3). The window itself reads as a soft cool-white rectangular glow visible in the deep background. No scene readable through it.
(2) ELEVATOR CALL BUTTON — a single SMALL ROUND PUSH-BUTTON (~2cm diameter) mounted directly on the kitchen wall at hip-height immediately adjacent to the closed elevator door. Simple flat circular face glowing soft red continuously (like a power-LED on an appliance). NO arrow symbol, NO inscription, NO surrounding panel, NO decorative housing, NO display, NO numbers — just a single small round red glowing dot on the bare dark wall. The red glow is contained to the button surface itself — a small local pinpoint, visible up close (Shot 2), invisible/irrelevant from a few meters away.
(3) ELEVATOR INTERIOR COOL-WHITE LED — appears ONLY in Shot 3 starting ~7.0s when the elevator door begins to open. The cabin interior has two square matte-white LED panel lights on the ceiling directing cool-white light downward. As the doors slide apart, this cool-white light spills outward from the cabin INTO the kitchen darkness. THIS IS THE FIRST AND ONLY FRONTAL LIGHT on the trio's faces in the entire take.

FAIL CHECK:
- Shots 1 and 2: characters' fronts/faces remain in DEEP NEAR-PURE-BLACK SHADOW. Only cool-white BACK-RIM from the pass-through service window catches the back contours (Shot 1).
- The red call-button is a tiny LOCAL pinpoint on the button itself — irrelevant to character lighting. Only visible up close in Shot 2.
- Shot 3 prior to ~7.0s: trio in PURE DARK SILHOUETTE — fronts and faces in deep black shadow, only thin cool-white back-rim from the distant pass-through window readable along their back-of-heads/hair-tops/back-shoulders. Their faces are NOT VISIBLE in detail.
- From ~7.0s in Shot 3: the cool-white LED light from the opening elevator GRADUALLY sweeps across the trio in a gradient from screen-right to screen-left — <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> first (screen-right, closest to elevator), then <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> (center), then <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> (screen-left). After ~7.8s the trio's faces are clearly visible in cool-white light. THIS IS THE FIRST FRONTAL LIGHT IN THE ENTIRE TAKE.
- NO orange/amber/yellow tones anywhere. NO warm color anywhere.

==========================
REFERENCE PLAN — STRICT ROLE LOCK
==========================

Use as the LOCATION reference. Abandoned commercial kitchen interior:
- PASS-THROUGH SERVICE WINDOW set into the LEFT WALL — horizontal rectangular aperture cut into the wall at counter-height with a small interior sill, faint cool-white residual light spilling through from the abandoned dining area beyond (no scene readable). Stainless-steel preparation counters along the wall below the window.
- CLOSED ELEVATOR DOOR on the RIGHT side of the kitchen — heavy dark metal door, plain brushed-metal surface, NO mirror reflection, NO decoration. Doors slide apart at ~7.0s in Shot 3 (the only door-opening event in the entire take).
- ELEVATOR CALL BUTTON: a single SMALL ROUND PUSH-BUTTON (~2cm diameter) mounted directly on the kitchen wall at hip-height immediately adjacent to the elevator door. Just a simple round circular face glowing soft red. NO arrow, NO panel, NO inscription, NO display — only a single small round red glowing dot on the bare dark wall.
- Commercial oven (off, dark, no flame), stainless-steel prep tables, dark dormant kitchen equipment in mid-depth. Stainless-steel refrigerator/freezer (dark, off) in background-center. Ventilation ducts on ceiling as dark silhouettes. White square ceramic tile floor heavily dirty with grime and food stains, multiple cracks.
- Kitchen in absolute night-time abandonment darkness, no active overhead lighting, no shop fixtures running.

Use as the ELEVATOR INTERIOR reference (visible only in Shot 3 from ~7.0s onward when doors open): compact modern elevator cabin. PANELS: dark gunmetal brushed stainless steel walls with vertical seam lines and horizontal brushed texture (soft diffuse arc highlights from the LED ceiling, NOT mirror reflections, NO mirror-imaged characters). CEILING: two square matte-white LED panel lights directing cool-white light downward — uniform cool-white cabin illumination. FLOOR: deep black marble-pattern square tiles, near-pure-black. Right wall upper corner: a small display panel showing floor number digits. The cabin is brightly cool-white lit inside.

Use <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> as the IDENTITY reference for Gandelfina (woman): tall slim, sharp contours, platinum wavy mid-length hair STYLED IN VOLUMIZED PLATINUM WAVES — DRY, intact. Ice-gray eyes. Extra-long black structured stiff coat past the knee (slightly darkened on shoulders only). Black leather bustier vest with deep V-neck, dark olive wide-leg pants, black laced heeled ankle boots. RIGHT hand holds her BLACK DECORATIVE CANE. LEFT hand empty. In Shot 1 she LEADS the procession (tight close-up profile, lateral walk). In Shot 2 her LEFT INDEX FINGER (right hand holds cane off-frame) enters frame from screen-LEFT, presses the call button, exits. In Shot 3 she is OFF-FRAME at the elevator threshold (either at the doorway or already inside the open cabin) — her presence is implied by the cool-white light spilling from the elevator direction and her cane sound off-frame.

Use <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> as the IDENTITY reference for Roko (man): compact strong build, olive-dark skin, very short upper-lip mustache, mid-length black messy damp hair clinging to face, bright red horizontal bandage strip across nose bridge, light gray sleeveless damp vest (clinging to skin), black tactical crossbody bag, red wrist wraps on both wrists, dark crimson super-loose distressed damp jeans, white-gray low-top sneakers. Bloodshot conjunctiva (sustained). CRITICAL POSTURE: spine ALWAYS VERTICAL — NEVER leans, NEVER slouches. In Shot 3 specifically: he stands center-frame in the trio. INITIAL STATE (6.5–8.0s): head SLIGHTLY TILTED DOWN, brow LOWERED in stern angry under-brow scowl, GAZE LOCKED ON THE TILE FLOOR in front of him (he stares down at the floor with controlled rage — not at <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>, not at the elevator, not at <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> or <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>). When the cool-white light from the opening elevator arrives on his face at ~7.7s, he REGISTERS it and at ~8.0s his head LIFTS — gaze travels from the floor UP toward the elevator direction (screen-right). The under-brow scowl eases into focused resolve. At ~8.5s he CONFIDENTLY STEPS FORWARD FIRST — sure decisive step toward screen-right (toward elevator off-frame), no hesitation. Spine stays VERTICAL through the step. He exits frame to screen-right.

Use <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> as the IDENTITY reference for Jax (man): dark skin, lean build, BRIGHT YELLOW very-short buzz cut (damp, clinging to scalp), beige/khaki patterned damp work jacket, black gloves, single-shoulder tactical backpack, loose light-gray damp work pants, gray-white sneakers. Head at NATURAL CARRIAGE. In Shot 3 specifically: he stands on the LEFT of the trio (screen-left). When the cool-white light arrives on his face at ~7.8s (he is illuminated LAST since he is farthest from the elevator), his expression shows SURPRISE / BEWILDERMENT — eyebrows raised, mouth slightly parted, wide bewildered eyes. At ~9.0s he TURNS HIS HEAD toward screen-right to look at <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>, holds the look for ~0.5s reading her face (searching her for response). At ~9.5s he SHIFTS gaze toward the elevator direction (further screen-right past <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>) — decision registering on his face: eyebrows still slightly raised, mouth firms. At ~9.7s he STEPS FORWARD toward screen-right (after <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>) — his step is slightly less confident than <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>'s, a brief moment of hesitation in his first foot placement before steady forward motion. He walks past <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> and exits frame to screen-right.

Use <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> as the IDENTITY reference for Rain (woman): slim build, light silver-gray chin-length damp bob (clinging to cheeks), fair skin with freckles, single thin scar on LEFT cheek only, purple cardigan damp hoodie (heavy drape), dark print T-shirt, black slim flare damp pants, white canvas damp sneakers, BLACK SINGLE-SHOULDER TACTICAL BAG with WEBBING STRAP running DIAGONALLY ACROSS HER CHEST from her right shoulder down to her left hip. Red-rimmed eyes, pre-existing tear tracks on cheeks. In Shot 3 specifically: she stands on the RIGHT of the trio (screen-right), closest to the elevator off-frame. When the cool-white light arrives on her face at ~7.5s (she is illuminated FIRST since she is closest to the elevator), her expression shows DEEP PENSIVE THOUGHT — eyes slightly downcast/unfocused, gaze approximately forward but turned inward (internal contemplation), brow softly tense, mouth closed. Her RIGHT HAND is on her bag strap across her chest — thumb and fingers (with visible silver rings) CONTINUOUSLY RUB AND STROKE the webbing strap in slow nervous tic-like motions throughout the shot: small thumb-rubbing back-and-forth across the webbing surface + fingers occasionally gliding up and down the strap length. Not gripping tight — actively RUBBING in a soft slow rhythm, self-soothing under her anxiety. A SLOW BLINK at ~8.7s. Visible BREATH in the cold air leaves her parted lips faintly through the shot. She is THINKING whether to follow. She does NOT step. When <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> steps past her at ~9.7s toward the elevator, her eyes TRACK his movement — gaze follows him across the frame from screen-left through center toward screen-right where he exits past her. Her fingers keep rubbing the strap. After <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> exits frame, her gaze HOLDS on the elevator direction off-frame screen-right; her fingers still rubbing the strap. Pre-existing tear tracks visible. NO new crying generated.

==========================
SPATIAL SCENE ANCHOR
==========================

Shot 1 setup — TIGHT PURE-PROFILE LATERAL WALK, TIGHT PROCESSION:
- Camera handheld at EXACTLY 90° to <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s walking direction (lens-axis perpendicular to her direction of travel). Camera height at her face level (~1.65m). Lateral-tracks at matched speed beside her.
- CAMERA POSITION RELATIVE TO <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>: camera is positioned at her SIDE, perpendicular to her walking line. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s body and head are in PURE 90° SIDE PROFILE to the camera. WE SEE ONE SIDE OF HER FACE ONLY: her forehead silhouette, brow, eyelash edge, NOSE PROFILE (the bridge and tip in side silhouette), upper lip, lower lip, chin, jawline — all readable as a clean SIDE-VIEW silhouette. WE DO NOT see her face from the front. WE DO NOT see her face at 3/4 angle. We see her as a CLASSIC PROFILE PORTRAIT — the silhouette of one side of her head against the deep background.
- Her FACING direction (the direction her nose points) is SCREEN-RIGHT (direction of travel, toward off-frame elevator). Her BACK-OF-HEAD points SCREEN-LEFT (direction she came from, toward the pass-through window). The camera lens-axis is PERPENDICULAR to this facing direction.
- Pass-through service window on LEFT WALL of kitchen, appearing in deep background of frame on the screen-LEFT side as a soft cool-white rectangular glow.
- Closed elevator door at screen-RIGHT side of kitchen (off-frame ahead of <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> in walking direction).
- Walking direction: LATERAL LEFT-TO-RIGHT IN PROFILE, parallel to camera image plane.
- PROCESSION TIGHT BEHIND <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>: <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> leads in foreground of frame; <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> walks immediately behind her (~0.4m gap), then <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> (~0.4m gap), then <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> (~0.4m gap). Single-file column with small tight gaps, NOT stretched. The trio keeps pace with <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> and stays close to her — they are NOT waiting somewhere else, NOT walking far behind. They walk RIGHT BEHIND her in tight formation. All four read in profile from the camera POV.
- FAIL CHECK for Shot 1 framing: WE MUST see <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s PROFILE — the side-silhouette of her head with her nose-line, lips, chin as edge contour. WE MUST NOT see her at 3/4 angle. WE MUST NOT see her face frontally. Camera is at 90° to her walking direction throughout.

Shot 2 setup — TIGHT BUTTON CLOSE-UP:
- Tight close-up framing of the SMALL ROUND RED PUSH-BUTTON mounted directly on the kitchen wall. The single round button (~2cm diameter) fills a portion of the mid-frame at off-center placement (rule of thirds). Its simple flat circular face glows soft red. NO arrow symbol, NO surrounding panel, NO inscription, NO display — just the bare round red button on the dark wall. A small area of the surrounding dark wall (rough textured paint or dirty plaster) is visible around the button in deep shadow.
- <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s LEFT INDEX FINGER enters the frame from the SCREEN-LEFT edge (her right hand holds the cane off-frame). The finger approaches the button, presses it, lifts off, exits to screen-left.
- No character faces in this shot — only <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s hand + the small round red button + immediate wall.
- Camera locked or near-locked (very subtle handheld micro-shake only).

Shot 3 setup — HANDHELD SHAKY MEDIUM-CLOSE ON TRIO (CAMERA FACES THEM FROM IN FRONT) + ELEVATOR LIGHT:
- HANDHELD camera with NATURAL ORGANIC SHAKE — slightly more pronounced than the subtle handheld of Shot 1: breathing wobble plus faint operator drift, small organic shifts in framing. NO large camera moves, NO dolly, NO zoom, NO pan beyond the natural shake.
- CAMERA POSITION — CRITICAL: the camera is positioned IN FRONT OF THE TRIO, facing them. Camera lens points AT the trio. WE SEE THE TRIO'S FACES at 3/4 angle in medium-close framing — their faces, eyes, mouths, expressions are readable in the frame. WE DO NOT see the trio from behind. WE DO NOT see their backs. We see them from THE FRONT.
- The trio's BODIES are turned approximately 3/4 toward camera (not full frontal — slight off-axis turn so they read at 3/4 angle, more of one side of each face visible). Their HEADS are turned slightly toward the elevator off-frame at screen-RIGHT (their gazes initially angled in that direction).
- Camera height at chest-to-face level (~1.55m). Camera positioned at the front side of the trio (between the trio and the camera-side of the room) — looking at them from in front, with the elevator off-frame past their right side.
- Trio composition LEFT-TO-RIGHT in the camera frame (locked arrangement seen from camera-front):
 - <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> on SCREEN-LEFT (farthest from elevator)
 - <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> in CENTER
 - <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> on SCREEN-RIGHT (closest to elevator)
- The closed elevator door is OFF-FRAME at SCREEN-RIGHT past <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s right side, behind the trio's facing-angle direction. When the doors slide apart at ~7.0s, the cool-white LED light from the cabin interior spills from off-frame screen-right INTO the frame, hitting the trio's right-facing side first.
- Pass-through service window in DEEP BACKGROUND, behind the trio in depth (off-frame past their backs which face away from camera). Provides faint cool-white BACK-RIM along the back-tops of hair (visible as faint edge highlights on hair-edges and shoulder-tops from camera POV).
- <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> is OFF-FRAME at the elevator threshold past the trio's right side. Her presence is implied by where the cool-white light spills from.
- Anamorphic, T2.8. Medium-close framing — the trio's faces and upper torsos fill the frame.
- FAIL CHECK for Shot 3 framing: WE MUST SEE THE TRIO'S FACES — their facial expressions, eyes, micro-expressions are the dramatic subject of the shot. WE MUST NOT see them from behind. WE MUST NOT see their backs. Camera is IN FRONT of them facing them throughout. Trio is FRONT-FACING (3/4) to camera.

==========================
TIMING — 11 seconds across 3 shots
==========================

[0.0–5.0s] SHOT 1 — TIGHT 90° SIDE-PROFILE <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> walking lateral LEFT→RIGHT, dialogue beat, four arrive at closed elevator
Handheld lateral-track ⊥ to her walking axis. WE SEE <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> IN PURE SIDE PROFILE — ONE side of her face only, her nose-line/lips/chin readable as a classic profile silhouette against the deep background. Her face oriented screen-RIGHT (direction of travel), back-of-head oriented screen-LEFT. Back of her platinum waves and back-of-shoulders catching faint cool-white back-rim from the pass-through window in deep background-LEFT. The window itself visible as a soft cool-white smudge on the left side of frame. Procession TIGHT behind her in receding depth-left as profile silhouettes with thin back-rim on their hair-tops/back-shoulders.

[0.0–1.5s] <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> and tight procession walking lateral L→R at calm controlled steady pace. Her cane CLINKS rhythmically on the dirty tile floor with each step. The trio's footsteps follow tight at small gaps. Her face stays in deep shadow with only platinum-waves back-rim luminous.

[1.5–4.5s] DIALOGUE — <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> in steady low controlled voice (NOT a declamation, NOT a stage voice — quiet measured fact-statement): "Long before humans walked the Earth, there was a war between angels and demons." Delivered evenly across ~3 seconds. Her lips articulate the words from the side in subtle silhouette/shadow movement. Procession continues walking tight behind her. Cane CLINKS continue.

[4.5–5.0s] <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> and the tight procession SLOW and STOP — they have arrived at the closed elevator door at screen-right. Cane gives ONE FINAL CLINK on the tile as <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> plants it stopping. The kitchen acoustic dies into stillness. Her profile still in deep shadow with only back-rim.

HARD CUT at 5.0s.

[5.0–6.5s] SHOT 2 — TIGHT CLOSE-UP ON ELEVATOR CALL BUTTON
Locked or near-locked tight close-up framing of the SMALL ROUND RED PUSH-BUTTON on the kitchen wall. The single round button (~2cm diameter) sits at off-center placement (rule of thirds). Its simple flat circular face glows soft red. NO arrow, NO surrounding panel, NO inscription, NO display — only this single round red dot on the rough dark wall texture around it. The rest of the wall in deep shadow.

[5.0–5.6s] Frame holds on the small round red button — a soft red glowing circle on the dark wall, the rest of the wall in deep shadow. Faint mechanical silence.

[SHOT 2] [深夜·暴雨·四层浓雾·<<<image_5>>>超长黑色大衣+铂金波浪发贴脸颊+手杖延续·<<<image_6>>>占画面右侧背景] 硬切到 低角度仰拍中景（low angle MCU）——摄影机极低，位于<<<image_5>>>正前方偏低处，仰视角度。<<<image_6>>>黑色面包车侧滑门在画面右侧，<<<image_5>>>从车门踏出，站定于门口：超长黑色大衣垂感极重（雨水打透），铂金色波浪中发在雨中贴脸颊两侧，右手手杖在身侧稳定支撑。仰拍角度使她的轮廓在路灯橙黄逆光中显得尤为高大——光从她身后绕过，勾出大衣肩线与发际线。她不低头，眼神水平前视（从仰拍视角看，她的目光越过镜头直视前方），下颌微收，喉结轻微滑动。暴雨击打大衣肩部，面料受雨压轻微沉坠。<<<image_1>>>红色招牌副光从侧面打在她铂金发色上形成冷暖混合光晕。 shake），镜头在上下左右方向均有可见的位移，像是有人紧张地端着摄影机。构图下边缘卡在角色颈部——画面包含面部全貌+下颌+颈部，不低于锁骨。与角色行走方向成45°朝向其面部。镜头焦距极长，背景（<<<image_6>>>车门框、雨幕、雾气）极度虚化散焦，手持强震使虚化背景形成持续的动态流动感。面部表情、肌肉运动、眼神、毛孔、每颗雨滴打在皮肤上的细节在ECU下完全暴露。每个角色出场节奏：正常步速入画→在画面中央停留一拍→正常步速退出画面。连续三个出场节拍： 节拍①——<<<image_2>>>从<<<image_6>>>车内以正常步速踏步入画，面部以45°角朝向摄影机从画面右侧移动至画面中央：停留，摄影机以45°角锁定其面部——面部情绪解析——眼睛：结膜重度充血，整个眼白已变成深红色，红血丝如密网覆盖全部可见巩膜，眼眶周围皮肤因剧烈哭泣后高度充血呈暗红色（不是淡粉，是浓烈的暗红），眼眶下方明显肿胀隆起，上下眼皮边缘均有充血红线——这双眼睛刚刚经历过极为剧烈的哭泣，红得无法掩盖；面部肌肉：咬肌双侧达到最高强度收缩，下颌两侧骨骼轮廓因肌肉极度张力而清晰突出如石头，颧骨两侧皮肤被咬肌张力向外拉紧，颧骨轮廓立体可见；颞肌将太阳穴区域皮肤向内深深凹陷；眉间皱肌将双眉以最大力量向内下方压拢，两眉之间形成四到五道深陷的竖纹，皱纹已深到像刻进去的；口轮匝肌将嘴唇压成一条极度绷紧的水平硬线，嘴角两侧皮肤被向后绷直；颈部胸锁乳突肌如粗绳般清晰可见，颈部皮肤随咬肌张力产生细纹；整张面孔是一块高度绷紧的石头——愤怒和悲痛同时铸进去。关键细节：头部始终保持正前方水平朝向，完全不转动——但眼球在内部做两到三次快速的横向扫视（左→右→归位），以最小幅度的眼球运动扫描两侧空间，随即回到正前方锁定。眼睛是唯一移动的部分，面部所有其他肌肉在扫视期间保持绝对不变，如同一个石铸面具里有两颗充血的眼球在独立运作。鲜红色鼻梁绷带被暴雨打湿，双腕红色绑带可见，颈部可见。停留后——<<<image_2>>>继续向左走出画面。 节拍②——<<<image_3>>>从<<<image_6>>>车内紧接以正常步速入画，面部以45°角朝向摄影机从画面右侧以正常步速移动至画面中央：停留，摄影机以45°角锁定其面部——额肌完全放松，眼轮匝肌无力上提眼皮（沉重半覆），颧大肌失活，嘴角被自身重力无声下坠，颏肌有间歇性不自主微抽搐（0.3秒节律）。他的头部在行进时保持向下——不是刻意低头，是放弃了对重力的抵抗。进入画面中央停留时：他的眼睛从下方位置轻轻滑动向左、向右做一次极慢的小幅扫视——不是好奇，是残存的一点自动化本能（「我该去哪」的最微弱信号），眼皮依然沉重，黄色buzz cut被雨打透贴头皮，额头太阳镜显得格外不合时宜。停留后——<<<image_3>>>继续向左走出画面。 节拍③——<<<image_4>>>从<<<image_6>>>车内紧接以正常步速入画，面部以45°角朝向摄影机从画面右侧移动至画面中央：她一入画立即停住——身体在画面中央完全停止移动。面部情绪解析——眼睛：结膜重度充血，整个眼白大面积变红，红血丝粗重密集覆盖巩膜；泪液已不再是积聚——已经溢出并正在沿脸颊双侧流淌，在ECU下可见清晰的泪痕轨迹从下睑向下延伸，泪液粘稠在脸颊皮肤上留下慢而清晰的痕迹；同时新的泪液从泪腺持续分泌，下睑边缘不断积聚新弧——「一边流，一边继续积」的持续状态；眼眶周围皮肤高度充血呈暗红色，眼眶下方明显肿胀；提上睑肌最大强度上提——上眼皮完全上提，眼白在虹膜上下左右三面近乎完全暴露，眼球几乎要从眼眶中突出；皱眉肌与额肌同时以最大力量激活——额头深横纹，内侧眉头向内上方极度聚拢，形成「绝望恐惧眉」角度；鼻翼深度充血暗红，鼻头轻微红润；颏肌剧烈不自主间歇性抽搐，下颌有明显的0.2秒节律细微颤动；嘴唇完全分开，上唇颤抖明显，呼吸急促，胸腔起伏可见。头部环视：头部开始做完整高速环视扫描——先向右（<<<image_6>>>车门方向），停一拍；快速转向左（<<<image_1>>>卷帘门），停一拍；向前，再向上（<<<image_1>>>高架桥），每次转向都带着急迫感，每次停顿都是「这是哪里？」的绝望询问，泪水随每次头部转动甩出细小水珠。她的环视完成后，头部停在正前方，恐惧和迷失叠加，没有答案。停留后——<<<image_4>>>继续向左走出画面。 title: Scene_15-16 #23
prompt_text:
Duration: 15 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9. THREE timed shots joined by TWO hard montage cuts. Mode: R2V.

Genre: DRAMA · dark mystic thriller. Mood: dread, mystery, revelation, the weight of unspeakable information being delivered in absolute darkness. Cinematography reference: Emmanuel Lubezki x Roger Deakins — natural light only, severely restricted in this scene to mostly absence of light. NOT 3D render, NOT game engine, NOT CGI gloss, NOT game-cutscene aesthetic. 8K IMAX hyper-realism, physical anamorphic cine glass, 180-degree shutter motion blur, fine real photographic film grain, organic edge vignette. 24fps.

UNIVERSAL COMPOSITION RULE — all 3 shots: rule-of-thirds, off-center, asymmetric. NEVER dead-center.

==========================
UNIVERSAL LIGHTING SOURCE LOCK — CRITICAL · KITCHEN SEGMENT IS NEAR-PURE-BLACK
==========================
The interior is in NEAR-ABSOLUTE DARKNESS throughout Shots 1 and 2. ZERO artificial light fixtures are active. ZERO ambient fill. ZERO streetlamps. ZERO front lighting. ZERO side lighting. ZERO orange/amber/yellow tones.

Only TWO faint light sources exist in the kitchen segment:
(1) From the LEFT side of the kitchen: extremely faint cool-white RESIDUAL SCATTER coming through the pass-through service window (the window that opens to the abandoned dining area where the prior scenes happened). This faint cool-white light source is positioned BEHIND the characters as they walk diagonally toward the elevator — it provides ONLY a thin cool-white RIM/CONTOUR LIGHT on their BACKS (the back edges of their bodies, the back of their heads). This light does NOT illuminate their fronts, NOT their sides, NOT their faces — ONLY the back contour outline. NOTHING is visible through this pass-through window — NO outside scene, NO rain, NO sky, NO dining area detail.
(2) From the RIGHT side near the elevator door: extremely faint sliver of light bleeding through the closed elevator door seam + a SMALL RED INDICATOR LIGHT on the kitchen wall adjacent to the elevator door (point red light, like a power-on status LED — just a small red dot in the darkness, providing ONLY pinpoint red local accent, not illuminating anyone).

Light source (3) appears ONLY in Shot 3 when the elevator opens: cool-white LED light from inside the elevator spills outward — this is the FIRST FRONTAL LIGHT in the kitchen segment, creating a strong light boundary at the elevator threshold.

FAIL CHECK: in Shots 1 and 2, characters' FACES must remain in DEEP NEAR-PURE-BLACK SHADOW — features ENTIRELY UNREADABLE. Only back rim contour from the pass-through-window scatter. If any face is visible with detail, if any frontal/side fill appears, if any streetlamp glow or warm color enters — the exposure is WRONG. Only when elevator opens (Shot 3) does the cool-white LED suddenly carve faces from the dark.

==========================
REFERENCE PLAN — STRICT ROLE LOCK
==========================

Use as the LOCATION + ENVIRONMENT + LIGHTING reference for this scene. is an abandoned commercial kitchen interior:
- Layout: a rectangular kitchen extending in depth, characters enter from the LOWER-LEFT corner of frame (the kitchen entrance from the dining area), walk diagonally toward the UPPER-RIGHT (the elevator door).
- LEFT side (along the left wall): stainless-steel preparation counters running along the wall. A PASS-THROUGH SERVICE WINDOW cut into the left wall (the window connecting kitchen to the dining area beyond) — this is the source of the faint cool-white rim-light. Nothing visible through this window.
- LEFT mid-distance: an old large COMMERCIAL OVEN (off, dark, no flame, no glow) — just a dark dormant metal box.
- BACKGROUND CENTER: a large stainless-steel refrigerator/freezer unit (dark, off).
- CEILING: ventilation ducts hanging visible across the upper frame (dark silhouettes).
- FLOOR: white square ceramic floor tiles, heavily dirty with grime and old food stains, multiple cracks running across the tiles.
- RIGHT side (depth right): a HEAVY DARK METAL ELEVATOR DOOR (modern design, plain brushed-metal surface, NO mirror reflection, NO decoration). The elevator door is CLOSED at the start of the scene; it opens in Shot 3.
- Right of the elevator door on the kitchen wall: a SMALL RED INDICATOR LIGHT (small button or LED status light, glowing faint red) — point light, just a small red dot in the deep dark.
- The kitchen is in absolute night-time abandonment darkness. No windows to outside. No active lighting fixtures. The space is mostly perceived through audio (echo, footsteps, breathing) and silhouette rim-edges.

Use <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> as the IDENTITY reference for Gandelfina (woman): tall slim, sharp contours, platinum wavy mid-length hair STYLED IN VOLUMIZED PLATINUM WAVES — DRY, intact. Ice-gray eyes. Extra-long black structured stiff coat past the knee (rain-darkened on shoulders only). Black leather bustier vest with deep V-neck, dark olive wide-leg pants, black laced heeled ankle boots. RIGHT hand holds her BLACK DECORATIVE CANE (slim shaft, carved head). Her LEFT hand is empty (hangs at her side or moves naturally as she walks — she carries no other item). Her face is LIVING — natural blinks, faint visible breath, throat micro-swallow. NOTE: in Shots 1 and 2 her face is in deep shadow with only back rim-light on her hair contour; only when elevator opens in Shot 3 does any frontal light reach her.

Use <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> as the IDENTITY reference for Roko (man): compact strong build, olive-dark skin, very short upper-lip mustache, mid-length WET black messy hair clinging to face, bright red horizontal bandage strip across nose bridge, light gray sleeveless vest (wet, clinging to skin), black tactical crossbody bag, red wrist wraps on BOTH wrists, dark crimson super-loose distressed jeans (wet), white-gray low-top sneakers. EMOTION: bloodshot conjunctiva (sustained), tight controlled face, eyeballs scan independently while head does not turn. CRITICAL POSTURE LOCK: his SPINE IS ALWAYS VERTICAL — he NEVER leans forward, NEVER leans back, NEVER slouches. He stands upright with arms hanging straight at his sides, controlling himself through breath and posture.

Use <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> as the IDENTITY reference for Jax (man): dark skin, lean build, BRIGHT YELLOW very-short buzz cut (wet, clinging to scalp), beige/khaki patterned work jacket (wet), black gloves, single-shoulder tactical backpack, loose light-gray work pants (wet), gray-white sneakers. EMOTION: head bowed low, heavy eyelids, guilty hollow gaze, occasionally a very slow disoriented scan.

Use <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> as the IDENTITY reference for Rain (woman): slim build, light silver-gray chin-length bob (wet, clinging to cheeks), fair skin with freckles, single thin scar on LEFT cheek only, purple cardigan hoodie (wet, heavy drape), dark print T-shirt, black slim flare pants (wet), white canvas sneakers (soaked), black single-shoulder tactical bag. EMOTION: red-rimmed eyes, pre-existing tear tracks on cheeks, fearful wide eyes, hyper-vigilant. NO new crying action — tears are pre-existing trails.

Use as the ELEVATOR INTERIOR reference: compact modern elevator cabin (small space, four people standing fill it almost completely). PANELS: dark gunmetal brushed stainless steel walls (vertical seam lines between panels, horizontal brushed-metal texture across surfaces — the brushing creates soft diffuse arc highlights from the ceiling LED light, NOT sharp mirror reflections, NOT mirror-imaged subjects). CEILING: two square matte-white LED panel lights (uniform cool-white light directed downward) — these are the FRONTAL LIGHT SOURCE that activates in Shot 3 when the elevator door opens and spills outward into the kitchen darkness. FLOOR: deep black marble-pattern square tiles, near-pure-black. RIGHT WALL upper corner: a small display panel showing a DOWN ARROW and floor number digits. The space is precise, tight, compact — in sharp contrast with the abandoned kitchen darkness outside.

==========================
SPATIAL SCENE ANCHOR
==========================
The kitchen interior layout: characters' path runs diagonally from the LOWER-LEFT (the kitchen entrance from the previously-visited dining area) toward the UPPER-RIGHT (the closed elevator door). The walking direction crosses left-to-right through the kitchen depth.

Procession order (front-to-back): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> → <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> → <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> → <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>. They walk in a vertical column rather than spread out.

The pass-through service window (light source #1) sits on the LEFT wall behind them as they walk — so the faint cool-white rim catches their backs/back-of-heads.

The elevator door (closed initially) sits at the upper-right of frame. Beside it, the small red indicator point-light glows on the wall.

==========================
WEATHER + LIGHTING — locked for 15 seconds
==========================
Outside (sealed off): pitch-black night, torrential rain — heard ONLY as muffled bed through walls (the kitchen has no direct external windows). Inside: NEAR-ABSOLUTE BLACK. The faint cool-white rim from the pass-through window behind characters + the small red point-light by the elevator door are the ONLY light sources in Shots 1 and 2. Cool-white LED from inside the elevator appears in Shot 3 when the door opens.

==========================
COLOR PALETTE — scene-specific (overrides the standard 60-30-10 for this scene)
==========================
Dominant: deep near-pure BLACK across 90%+ of frame in Shots 1 and 2 (kitchen darkness). The only color/luminance present: thin cool-white RIM contour on characters' back outlines (5-7% of frame), a small point of red glow from the wall indicator (1-2% of frame), and in Shot 3 only — the cool-white LED panel light from the open elevator (filling a strong rectangular patch in mid-right of frame). NO orange/amber/yellow tones. NO warm light anywhere.

==========================
SHOT 1 — 0.0 to 8.0 seconds — Handheld ECU follow, Gandelfina leads, dialogue beat, four stop at elevator door
==========================

Camera (Shot 1): HANDHELD camera positioned IN FRONT of <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> at her face level (~1.65m), facing her FACE in tight ECU framing (chin/neck up). The camera SLOWLY RETREATS BACKWARD at the same pace <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> walks forward — she walks toward camera, camera retreats backward at the same speed so she stays in tight ECU framing throughout. Operator handheld micro-shake natural. Focal length: medium-close (tight ECU). Anamorphic, T2.8.

Spatial blocking (Shot 1):
- FOREGROUND / MAIN SUBJECT: <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s face/head in tight ECU (chin to top of head visible), centered along a rule-of-thirds line (NOT dead-center). Her platinum waves catch the faint cool-white rim along their back/top contour as she walks forward into the camera. Her FACE itself is in DEEP NEAR-PURE-BLACK SHADOW — features (eyes, mouth, nose) are mostly UNREADABLE in the darkness. Only the contour of her platinum hair and the edge of her cheek catches the faintest cool-white rim from behind.

Genre: DRAMA. Mood: lostness, fear, isolation, dramatic tension. Cinematography reference: Emmanuel Lubezki x Roger Deakins language — only natural light, contre-jour from left wall floor-to-ceiling glass windows, camera on shadow side. NOT 3D render, NOT game engine, NOT CGI gloss, NOT game-cutscene aesthetic. 8K IMAX hyper-realism, physical anamorphic cine glass, 180-degree shutter motion blur, fine real photographic film grain, organic edge vignette, natural chromatic edge aberration. 24fps fluid motion.

UNIVERSAL COMPOSITION RULE — both shots: rule-of-thirds, asymmetric, off-center placement. Subjects NEVER in the dead-center of the frame, negative space intentionally on the opposite side.

UNIVERSAL LIGHTING SOURCE LOCK — both shots — CRITICAL: ONLY natural light from the left wall floor-to-ceiling glass windows (faint cool-blue night scatter from outside the windows, infiltrating LEFT to RIGHT inside the space). NO artificial light of any kind inside. NO ceiling lights. NO signage lights. NO orange/amber wash. NO yellow tones inside at any point. NO Hollywood key/fill from invisible sources. NO interior ambient fill. NO illuminated faces. FAIL CHECK: characters MUST read as DARK SILHOUETTES with ONLY a thin cool-blue RIM/CONTOUR light tracing their LEFT edges (the side facing the windows in Shot 2 of this take). The bulk of every body — torso, face, right side — sits in DEEP NEAR-BLACK SHADOW where individual features (eye color, skin tone, clothing color, facial details) are MOSTLY UNREADABLE. If characters appear with visible detail across their faces, with cinematic key fill, with readable interior detail on their bodies — the exposure is WRONG. The correct render: characters are walking BACKLIT SILHOUETTES against the cool-blue window curtain, with only a thin contour-rim line of cool-blue light on their left-side outlines. Faces remain in deep shadow throughout.

Reference plan — STRICT ROLE LOCK:
Use as the LOCATION + ENVIRONMENT + LIGHTING reference for the INTERIOR of the abandoned corner pizzeria. Entry structure: outermost layer is a metal ROLLER SHUTTER (full-width, closed initially, rusty with wear marks, bottom edge has a horizontal metal handle that can be pushed up by hand from outside, rolls into the upper recess when raised — STAYS UP when fully raised). Inside the shutter at approximately 50 centimeters depth is a HEAVY DIRTY DUSTY GLASS DOOR (transparent glass but visibly DRY-DUSTY-DIRTY with thick layered DUST, fingerprint smudges, old streaks of dried dirt, accumulated grime — NO water drops, NO wet rain marks on the glass; the glass surface is DRY but covered with DUST and DIRT layers built up over years of abandonment). The dust, dirt, fingerprints and streaks on the glass act as a foreground texture and slight visual blur. The glass doors are DRY because they have been protected from rain by the closed roller shutter (the rain outside is on the alley asphalt and on the now-raised roller shutter, but NOT on the glass door surface itself). The glass door opens INWARD with metal handles on both sides, requires effort to open (heavy hinges, low-pitched friction), and auto-closes slowly when released. Interior layout: LEFT wall = floor-to-ceiling glass windows (rain pours down the entire window surface as a continuous water curtain — not raindrops hitting, full unbroken water flow from top to bottom of glass); along the windows are RED LEATHER BOOTH SEATS with red-white checkered tablecloths (dusty, abandoned, untouched in place); RIGHT side = wooden service counter in deep shadow; DEEP back of the interior = corridor toward kitchen with a closed HEAVY GREY METAL KITCHEN DOOR at the far end (plain metal face, no decoration). The entrance sits in the mid-back of the interior depth.

Use <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Gandelfina (woman): tall slim build, sharp contours, prominent cheekbones and clear jawline, platinum wavy shoulder-to-collar-length mid-length hair STYLED IN VOLUMIZED PLATINUM WAVES — DRY, NOT WET, NOT clinging to cheeks (her umbrella protected her outside; her hair remains styled and intact going into the interior), ice-gray eyes with cool intelligent gaze, wears an extra-long black structured stiff coat past the knee (rain-darkened on shoulders only), inside a black leather bustier vest with deep V-neck, dark olive wide-leg pants, black laced leather heeled ankle boots. Right hand holds a black decorative cane with carved head and slim shaft. Left hand holds <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> (the FOLDED WET black umbrella from the previous scene). Her face is LIVING and PRESENT — natural blinks, micro-eye-movements, faint visible breath, throat micro-swallow.

In THIS scene the umbrella is FOLDED/CLOSED and WET — still dripping water from its canopy and shaft, held by <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> in her LEFT hand. In Shot 1 the curved HOOK HANDLE of <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> is used as a TOOL to engage the roller shutter — Gandelfina lifts the shutter using the umbrella hook as a hook-extension, then once inside she switches to carrying it horizontally. In Shot 2 (the rail dolly walk-through) the closed folded wet <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> is held HORIZONTALLY in <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s LEFT hand parallel to the floor across her body (NOT vertical, NOT tapped as a cane, NEVER opened). <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> remains folded and wet through the entire 15 seconds.

Spatial scene anchor (consistent across both shots):
The interior as described above. Outside is the same back-alley street from previous scenes. NO vehicles visible in frame at any point — no civilian cars, no traffic, no parked vehicles of any kind visible through the glass door or through the left wall windows. The exterior is the empty rain-soaked alley itself. Indoor air carries faint dust haze drifting in the cool-blue light, plus faint visible breath from characters (their warm exhales meeting the cold abandoned-interior air). Torrential rain outside is heard primarily through walls and AS the continuous water-curtain flowing on the left wall glass windows in Shot 2.

Weather and lighting anchor — LOCKED for all 15 seconds:
PITCH-BLACK DEAD OF NIGHT outside, true 3 AM exposure. Inside: NO artificial light, only the cool-blue faint scatter from the left wall floor-to-ceiling glass windows. Rain on the glass diffuses what little outdoor city ambient remains into a soft cool-blue wash entering from LEFT to RIGHT inside the space. The interior illumination is EXTREMELY LOW — characters read mostly as silhouettes with faint cool-blue edge-lights on their LEFT sides as they cross the space. The RIGHT side of every face and body is in DEEP NEAR-BLACK shadow. EXPOSURE: only faces and body parts directly catching the cool-blue window scatter read above near-pure-black. NO orange, NO yellow, NO amber, NO warm tones inside at any moment.

Color palette (60-30-10) across both shots:
60% NEAR-BLACK / deep cold-tone dominates: the unlit interior space, wooden counter in shadow, deep kitchen corridor, right side of every figure, the dark recesses between booth seats. 30% faint cool-blue window-scatter accents on tablecloth checker patterns, on booth seat outlines, on characters' left silhouettes and left half-faces, on dust haze in the air. 10% diffused cool-blue glints on the dirty glass door surface (smudges and water marks catching the light), faint highlights on metal handles and the cane shaft and the wet umbrella canopy.

==========================
SHOT 1 — 0.0 to 10.0 seconds — Continuous static interior POV through dirty glass door + roller shutter; Gandelfina raises shutter, enters; trio pauses then follows
==========================

Camera (Shot 1): LOCKED, no movement, no shake, no pan, no tilt, NO cuts — single uninterrupted take through the entire 10 seconds. Camera positioned INSIDE, lens axis perpendicular to the entrance, framing MEDIUM-PLAN (tight medium-close) on the two-layer obstacle: the dirty dusty glass DOUBLE-DOORS (two glass door panels side-by-side with vertical metal pull-handles visible in the LOWER-MIDDLE portion of the frame, both door panels filling most of the frame width) PLUS the roller shutter behind them (visible across the upper two-thirds of the frame through the glass while still closed; visible as the dark outside alley with the formation once the shutter is raised). The framing is a MEDIUM PLAN — the double-doors occupy approximately 80-90% of the frame width, both door panels fully visible side by side, the door handles at roughly the lower-middle horizontal third of frame. When the characters appear outside (after shutter raises), they are visible from CHEST/TORSO UP through the upper portion of the glass, framed by the dark area above the door handles. Narrow dark interior margins remain at the left and right edges of frame (faint hints of the right-side wooden counter at one edge, the left wall booth area at the other). The frame is a TIGHT MEDIUM-PLAN inward composition on the entrance, NOT a wide angle of the interior. Anamorphic, T2.8.

Composition is ASYMMETRIC, OFF-CENTER — the entrance two-layer obstacle is NOT centered in the frame; it sits off-center, with interior shadow space (wooden counter and dark corridor) on the opposite side.

Spatial blocking (Shot 1) — depth layers from camera to background:
1. Camera (inside, deep shadow margin of right-side wooden counter area visible at one frame edge)
2. DIRTY GLASS DOUBLE-DOOR (two glass panels filling most of the frame; closed initially, ~1 meter from camera, foreground texture — smudges, fingerprints, water marks, layered grime; vertical metal pull-handles visible in the LOWER portion of frame; the glass acts as a slight visual blur on what is behind it)
3. ROLLER SHUTTER (closed initially, ~50cm behind the glass doors, rusty, visible through the glass across the upper two-thirds of the frame)
4. EXTERIOR DARKNESS (deep night beyond the shutter — visible only after shutter is raised; the rain-soaked empty alley with cool-blue ambient)
5. OUTSIDE FORMATION (visible after shutter rises, framed by the open shutter and seen through the dirty glass): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> center-front, <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> left-back of <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>, <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> right-back of <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>, <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> further right-back of <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>. The empty rain-soaked alley behind/around them — NO vehicles visible.

Continuous action timeline (Shot 1) — 10 seconds, single take:

[0.0–1.5s] Silent opening. Interior pitch-dark. Two-layer obstacle blocks any view of the outside. Torrential rain sound penetrates through walls. Everything still. Faint cool-blue scatter from the off-frame left wall windows lights the dirty glass door foreground texture in extremely low key.

[1.5–3.5s] Roller shutter raises with the UMBRELLA HOOK HANDLE. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> grips the folded wet <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> by its shaft in her left hand (folded canopy at the lower end of her grip, curved HOOK HANDLE pointing UP as she raises her arm). She raises the umbrella vertically above her head with steady controlled motion and engages the curved HOOK HANDLE of <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> with the bottom lifting handle of the roller shutter from outside. The umbrella functions as a HOOK-EXTENSION TOOL — the curved handle catches under the shutter's lifting handle, and she pushes UP on the umbrella shaft (or pulls down) with controlled steady force — using the umbrella as a hook lever to raise the shutter. The roller shutter rolls upward into the upper recess at a natural unhurried pace: high-pitched metal rolling friction sound, the umbrella hook scraping audibly against the metal as it engages, rust crumbs falling, cold wet outdoor air drifting in. Throughout, her hand never directly touches the shutter — only the umbrella hook handle engages. The shutter reaches its fully-raised position and STAYS UP. The middle obstacle is gone — through the dirty glass doors, the exterior formation becomes visible AS PURE DARK SILHOUETTES: <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> center, <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> left-back of her, <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> right-back of her, <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> further right-back of <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>. CRITICAL LIGHTING SPEC for the formation visible through the glass — there are NO LIGHT SOURCES outside that face the characters from the front. The alley behind them is in PITCH-BLACK shadow. The characters seen through the glass read as NEAR-PURE-BLACK SILHOUETTES with ONLY a thin cool-blue rim/contour line tracing their LEFT-side edges (from faint distant night ambient scatter). Their faces, fronts, bodies remain in DEEP NEAR-BLACK SHADOW — facial features like eye color, skin tone, clothing details, the red nose bandage, the bloodshot eyes, the platinum hair color are ALL UNREADABLE through the deep shadow at this exposure. We see only the SHAPES of the four figures against the dark alley, with the faintest cool-blue line outlining their left sides. NO front lighting on faces. NO key/fill from any imagined light source. The dirty/dusty glass adds visual distortion on top of these silhouettes (smudges and streaks layer over the dark shapes), but the glass itself does NOT add illumination to the characters. BEHIND AND AROUND THE FORMATION: the empty rain-soaked alley with PITCH-BLACK depth — NO vehicles, NO traffic. Just the four near-black silhouettes against the pitch-black alley.

[3.5–5.0s] <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> approaches the glass door. She steps forward toward the dirty glass door at a calm steady pace, neither hurried nor slow. As she nears, her silhouette GROWS LARGER in the frame through the dirty/dusty glass — DIRT, DUST, FINGERPRINTS and OLD STREAKS on the glass create slight visual distortion and texture overlay on her dark silhouette, but her body shape remains readable as silhouette. The folded wet <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> in her left hand visibly drips water; cane in her right hand visible at her side as silhouette shapes.

[5.0–6.5s] <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> pushes open the glass door. Her hands appear on the glass door's metal handles (umbrella still gripped in left hand alongside the handle). She pushes the door INWARD — the door is HEAVY (low-pitched hinge friction sound, requires sustained controlled force, no struggle). The door opens at a natural pace toward the camera/interior under her steady push. She steps inside at a calm controlled pace, passing through the threshold past the camera position. She does NOT hold the door for the others. Drops of water fall from the folded umbrella onto the entry floor.

[6.5–7.0s] <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> continues forward INTO the interior past the camera at her steady walking pace. As she passes the camera, the foreground briefly fills with her dark silhouette. Once she has passed, the camera frame opens back up onto the glass door (now half-closed mid-swing) with the trio still outside visible through the dirty glass as dark silhouettes.

[7.0–8.5s] Trio pauses outside — collective silent hesitation ~1.5 seconds. The three remaining outside (visible through the half-closing glass door) do NOT immediately follow. Unspoken collective moment of "do we really trust this woman?". Body languages:
- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>: face tense, eyeballs sharply track <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s path through the dirty glass. He scans the entrance with ANGER — the bright red nose bandage clearly visible, jaw set hard. Anger is his dominant emotion; hostile scanning, not curious. He makes his decision FAST.
- <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>: head UP and eyes OBSERVING (NOT head-low, NOT dissociated). He is in upset/sad feelings but LUCID and PRESENT. He looks calmly at the entrance and dark interior beyond. Sadness reads in eye softness, but he is fully aware. Registering the place honestly.
- <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>: AFRAID. Her eyes scan with visible FEAR — wide eyes, small fearful head movements, taking in the unknown space with apprehension. Fresh tears still on her cheeks.

[8.5–9.5s] Trio enters in sequence (Roko → Jax → Rain).
<<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> makes the first move. He pushes the glass door open again, walks through into the interior. AS HE CROSSES THE THRESHOLD, his eyes ANGRILY SCAN the new dark unfamiliar space — sharp aggressive look around the entry area, hostile assessment with menace. He doesn't slow. Passes the camera position.
<<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> follows immediately. As he crosses the threshold, his head is UP and his eyes calmly OBSERVE the interior — he takes in booth seats on the left, wooden counter on the right, deep corridor ahead. Calm registering observation, in his upset state but present and intentional. NOT head-low, NOT dissociated.
<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> enters last. She steps to the threshold with fear — wide eyes, lips slightly parted with rapid shallow breath. As she enters, she scans the interior with VISIBLE FEAR — head turns slightly left then right, taking in the dark unknown space with apprehension. Fresh tears continuing.

[9.5–10.0s] Glass door slowly auto-closes behind <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> (final ~0.5s of slow swing back). Low soft thump-click as it shuts. Rain sound outside dampens noticeably. Roller shutter REMAINS in raised open position above (does NOT fall). All four characters now inside; cut to Shot 2.

HARD CUT at 10.0s.

==========================
SHOT 2 — 10.0 to 15.0 seconds — Wide rail dolly tracking, four cross abandoned interior in profile toward kitchen door
==========================

Camera (Shot 2): WIDE rail dolly tracking, with the WOODEN SERVICE COUNTER as perspective anchor. Camera mounted on a horizontal rail BEHIND the wooden service counter on the RIGHT side of the interior, in deep shadow. The frame reads as the POV FROM BEHIND THE WOODEN COUNTER — staff side, looking OUT across the counter top at the line of walking characters. Rail runs PARALLEL to characters' direction. Camera moves at UNIFORM CONSTANT SPEED LEFTWARD throughout the 5 seconds, maintaining STRICT 90-DEGREE PROFILE ANGLE (camera lens axis perpendicular to the walking line — characters seen in pure SIDE-PROFILE SILHOUETTE throughout, never 3/4, never frontal). This is a LATERAL SIDE-TRACKING SHOT — lateral motion of dolly matches lateral motion of procession at the same speed so each character stays in roughly the same horizontal slot of frame as the camera tracks (minor parallax only). The TOP EDGE OF THE WOODEN COUNTER crosses the LOWER portion of the frame as a foreground horizontal occluder/depth marker. NO speed change. NO ramp. NO acceleration. Anamorphic, T2.8. Focal length: medium-wide.

Composition is ASYMMETRIC, OFF-CENTER throughout — procession sits along a rule-of-thirds horizontal band, with negative space on the opposite side.

Spatial blocking (Shot 2):
- LEFT side (deep behind characters): floor-to-ceiling GLASS WINDOWS of visible throughout. Rain CONTINUOUSLY FLOWS down the entire window surface as a sheet water curtain. Outside scene through the water curtain reads as distorted blurry cool-blue ambient with NO vehicles visible — no cars of any kind, just empty alley distortion. Cool-blue scattered window light infiltrates LEFT to RIGHT.
- MIDDLE: four characters in procession, profile, moving from frame-RIGHT (entrance) toward frame-LEFT (kitchen door).
- RIGHT side (foreground / near camera): wooden service counter in deep shadow.
- Characters' LEFT SIDES face the windows (rim-lit cool-blue); RIGHT SIDES face camera/counter (deep shadow).

Procession STRICT ORDER (front-to-back as they walk leftward, this order MUST be maintained): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> is FIRST → <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> is SECOND → <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> is THIRD → <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> is LAST. DO NOT swap any character positions throughout the take.

Step speed difference creates gaps:
- <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>: QUICK DECISIVE FAST step — brisk big strides, no hesitation, walks NOTICEABLY FASTER than the trio. Her cane (right hand) strikes RHYTHMICALLY on the wood floor at each step at a FAST tempo (wooden resonance). Folded wet <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> in her left hand still dripping water. Never slows. The gap between her and <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> visibly STRETCHES through the shot.
- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> / <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> / <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>: slower cautious pace behind her.

Each character's scanning behavior:

<<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>: leads procession, looks FORWARD toward kitchen metal door, does NOT scan side-to-side. Composed face.

<<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>: behind <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>. Wide shoulder outline catches cool-blue light edge. Scans with ANGER — sharp aggressive scanning. He turns his head SHARPLY once or twice — left toward booth seats along windows (sharp turn, brief hold, hostile assessment), then sharp right toward dark counter area (sharp turn, brief hold). Red nose bandage visible briefly in profile. Hostile to new environment.

<<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>: third in procession. HEAD UP and ALERT — NOT low, NOT dissociated. He is in upset/sad feelings but LUCID and observing. Around the MIDDLE of his walk through the frame (approximately when he is centered laterally in the frame), he TURNS HIS HEAD LEFT — toward the camera direction (toward the wooden counter side, our POV side, opposite to the windows). This is a deliberate slow head-turn LEFT toward the camera/counter side — he is registering this side of the abandoned space too, glancing at the dark counter shadows. He holds the head-turn for a beat (~1 second), eyes scanning the counter side off-screen, then turns his head back forward to continue walking. The turn is calm and sad-lucid, not fearful. (NOTE: he does NOT look AT the camera lens — he looks PAST it toward the counter shadows behind it.) Sadness reads in eye softness and slow deliberate head movement.

<<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>: last in procession. Slightly closer to windows side (cool-blue light on her side profile, wet bloodshot eyes and tear tracks visible). Scanning QUICK and FEAR-DRIVEN:
- Quick LEFT head turn toward big glass windows and rain curtain, brief pause, lips slightly part for shallow rapid inhale
- Quick RIGHT head turn toward dark counter area, brief pause, brows furrow visibly
- Turns back forward
Each head turn shows VISIBLE FEAR. Fresh tears continuing.

The four reach the kitchen metal door:
- <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> arrives first. STOPS facing the closed grey metal kitchen door (back to camera). Cane vertical right side. Folded wet <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> still vertical in left hand, dripping.
- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> stops behind her. Sharp left-right eye scan, jaw tight.
- <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> stops behind <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>. Head up, calmly observing.
- <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> stops last. One QUICK BACKWARD GLANCE — looks back at restaurant space they crossed — then turns back forward.

==========================
SHARED LOCKS — both shots
==========================

Performance lock — Hollywood-level naturalistic drama:
- <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>: composed, authoritative, in control. Calm forward gaze. Knows where they go. Ice-gray eyes neutral. Natural blinks, faint visible breath, throat micro-swallow, micro-eye-movements. NEVER doll-like.
- <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>: ANGER + DISTRUST dominant. Hostile sharp scanning. Eyes hard and stabbing. Stone jaw, masseter tight. Bloodshot conjunctiva.
- <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>: SAD + LUCID. NOT head-low, NOT dissociated. Head UP, eyes present and observing. In upset feelings but registers the space honestly. Calm head turns, eye softness.
- <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>: FEAR dominant. Quick fear-driven head scans, wide eyes, rapid shallow breath, fresh tears continuing.

All: micro-pauses, natural blinks, wet living eyes with practical-light catchlights (cool-blue window scatter), visible breathing, micro-swallow, involuntary micro-expressions. NO performing TO the camera. NO direct-to-lens look. NO theatrical posing.

Composition lock — both shots: off-center, rule-of-thirds, asymmetric. NO dead-center subject. NO symmetric framing.

Physics lock — both shots: real gravity, inertia, motion follow-through. Roller shutter motion physical. Glass door motion physical with heavy hinges + slow auto-close. Cane strikes with real wooden resonance. Wet clothing clings realistically. Folded umbrella dripping real water. Rust crumbs falling with physical gravity. NO floating props.

Continuity locks across all 15 seconds:
PITCH-BLACK night outside throughout; cool-blue faint window scatter ONLY light source inside. Torrential rain density held outside. NO artificial light inside. NO orange / amber / yellow tones inside. interior identity held: dirty glass door, roller shutter raised position (does NOT fall), red leather booth seats with red-white checkered tablecloths, wooden counter in shadow, deep kitchen corridor with grey metal kitchen door. Character identities held. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s HAIR DRY AND STYLED throughout. Trio (<<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> / <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> / <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>) WET HAIR clinging throughout. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> carries FOLDED WET <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> in left hand throughout (dripping water visible). <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> carries cane in right hand throughout. NO vehicles visible at any point through the glass door, through the windows, or anywhere in frame — no cars, no traffic, no parked vehicles of any kind. NO fresh crying ACTION from <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> (only sustained pre-existing tears). NO mirror reflections. NO age labels.

Audio (SFX only, all 15 seconds):
Torrential rain outside (muffled by walls). At ~1.5–3.5s: umbrella hook handle scraping/clinking against the metal shutter as it engages with the lifting handle + steady high-pitched metal-rolling friction of roller shutter raising at natural pace + rust crumbs falling. At ~5.0–6.5s: low-pitched hinge friction of heavy glass door + <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s heeled boot footsteps crossing threshold + drip of water from folded umbrella. At ~6.5–7.0s: <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s heeled footsteps continuing into the interior past camera. At ~7.0s onward: glass door slow auto-close swing. From ~8.0s onward: <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>>'s footsteps on wood floor as he enters, then <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>>'s, then <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s. At ~9.5s: glass door closes with low soft thump-click — rain outside dampens. From ~10.0s onward (Shot 2): <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>>'s CANE STRIKES on wood floor with rhythmic wooden resonance (every step), footsteps on wood floor, continuous water-flow sound on left wall glass windows. <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>>'s faint trembling breath throughout. NO music. NO score. NO subtitles. NO dialogue. NO CGI particle hiss.

Final frame (at 15.0s):
Rail dolly camera holds at end position on left side of interior. Four characters standing in front of closed grey metal kitchen door at back-left of. <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> at front (back to camera), folded wet <<<7cb38e5d-7d4d-4ff4-8d09-440cf1f05f57>>> vertical in left hand still dripping, cane vertical in right hand. Trio behind — <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> tense hostile, <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> sad lucid (head UP), <<<38f44d5c-e373-405d-8dd7-882c4349fa4f>>> just completed her fearful backward glance. Cool-blue window light catches left sides; right sides in deep near-black shadow. Rain continues flowing on left wall windows as water curtain. Frame ends on this image — four people stopped at threshold of next unknown.

prompt_text:
<<<image_1>>> — 废弃披萨连锁店（PIZZA CHAIN）入口与室内，深夜。入口结构：最外层为金属卷帘门（全宽封闭，铁锈磨损，底端有金属把手，可从外侧单手上推）；卷帘门内侧（室内侧）为一扇厚重玻璃门（脏污磨损，玻璃表面有水渍、指纹、污垢积层，向内开启，门体有明显重量，松手后缓慢自动关闭）。室内布局：左侧沿墙落地大玻璃窗（雨水沿玻璃整面倾流，窗外深夜，极微弱城市冷蓝散射光漫入）；沿窗排列红色皮质软包卡座（红白格子图案桌布，积灰，原位）；右侧木质服务台（最暗处）；纵深通向厨房过道，过道尽头有一扇厚重金属门（通向厨房，关闭状态，深灰金属面，无装饰）。空间动线：入口在室内纵深方向的中后段，人物从入口进入后向左前方穿越餐厅，朝左侧纵深厨房金属门方向行进，左侧落地大玻璃窗始终在行进方向的背景侧（人物背后或侧后）。光线：无任何人工光源，唯一光源=左侧落地大玻璃窗极微弱冷蓝夜间散射，自左向右渗透。环境与照明参考。<<<image_5>>> (甘德尔菲娜) — 女性，身形高挑修长，铂金色波浪中发（雨水打湿贴脸颊），冰灰色眼睛，超长黑色结构感硬挺大衣（雨水打透），黑色皮革束胸马甲（V领），深墨绿色阔腿长裤，黑色高跟踝靴，右手黑色装饰性手杖。外观仅作参考。<<<image_2>>> (罗科) — 男性，橄榄深色肤色，黑色乱发（贴脸），鲜红色鼻梁绷带，浅灰色无袖背心（湿透），黑色战术包，双腕红色绑带，深暗红色破洞牛仔裤（湿透），白灰运动鞋。情绪延续SC.15：结膜暗红充血，面孔如石，眼球独立横向扫视，头部不转。外观仅作参考。<<<image_3>>> (贾克斯) — 男性，深色肤色，亮黄色极短buzz cut（湿透贴头皮），米黄/卡其色工装夹克（湿透），黑色手套，单肩战术包，宽松浅灰色工装裤（湿透），灰白运动鞋。情绪延续SC.15：头部低垂，眼皮沉重，空洞，颏肌间歇抽搐。外观仅作参考。<<<image_4>>> (雷恩) — 女性，体型纤长，浅银灰色短bob（湿透贴脸颊），雀斑，左脸单道疤痕。紫色开衫连帽卫衣（湿透），深色印花T恤，黑色修身喇叭裤（湿透），白色帆布鞋（浸透），黑色单肩战术包。情绪延续SC.15：眼眶泛红充血，泪痕脸颊，恐惧性大眼，呼吸急促。外观仅作参考。@image_7 [仅位置参考——禁止将此图像视觉风格应用于视频，仅提取物体位置关系] —
SHOT1：空间层次（由近及远）：摄影机→脏污玻璃门（室内侧，关闭）→金属卷帘门（外侧，关闭）→<<<image_5>>>（最外侧，街上）。镜头在室内，透过两层障碍拍摄。SHOT1为不间断连续镜头：卷帘门被<<<image_5>>>从外侧推起并保持开启→<<<image_5>>>推开玻璃门进入→其余三人在门口短暂停顿后由<<<image_2>>>率先入内→<<<image_3>>>→<<<image_4>>>依次进入。
SHOT2：摄影机在<<<image_1>>>室内右侧（木质服务台区域），人物从画面右侧（入口方向）向左侧（厨房金属门方向）以profile方向行进，左侧落地大玻璃窗在人物背后可见，暴雨水流连续倾泻。<<<image_5>>>步速明显快于其余三人。天气与光线锚点（整段15秒绝对不变）：室外深夜，暴雨极强，无任何人工光源。室内：无人工照明，唯一光源=左侧落地大玻璃窗极微弱冷蓝夜间散射。四人服装雨水打湿贴身。禁止任何人工光源，禁止橙黄路灯，禁止光线改变，禁止雨声停止。风格：8K IMAX。超写实——禁3D渲染，禁游戏引擎，禁游戏CG过场质感。摄影：Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins。灯光：仅自然光——contre-jour逆光，摄影机在阴影侧，全程大气薄雾haze。主光源仅天光和窗光。色彩：60:30:10——主色/辅色/点缀色。镜头：物理电影镜头。180°快门运动模糊。皮肤：毛孔级写实——汗毛、不对称痣、毛细血管潮红、毛孔阴影匹配现场光源。表演：好莱坞级——反应前微停顿、精准视线、湿润活眼带眼神光、可见呼吸和胸腔起伏。物理：重力惯性真实——质量有真实重量、正确接触阴影。禁漂浮道具。构图：三分法+黄金比例。每人从第一帧开始运动。连续性：角色、道具、环境每个镜头完全一致。禁身份漂移。技术：24fps流畅运动。8K细节。禁抖动。音频：仅环境SFX。禁音乐。禁字幕。色彩：60:30:10——60%室内深黑冷调（废弃夜间空间） · 30%极微弱冷蓝窗光在桌布格纹·卡座·人物左侧轮廓上的隐约轮廓 · 10%脏污玻璃门表面的漫射冷蓝点缀。多镜头序列：[SHOT 1] [连续镜头不剪切·室内视角·透过脏污玻璃门→金属卷帘门→<<<image_5>>>居中·<<<image_3>>>左后·<<<image_4>>>右后·<<<image_2>>>更右后·冷蓝极暗·<<<image_5>>>单手推起卷帘（卷帘保持开启）→推开玻璃门入内→其余三人短暂停顿→<<<image_2>>>率先入内→<<<image_3>>>→<<<image_4>>>依次跟入·全程一个镜头·禁止任何车辆入画] 中近景定机，摄影机固定在<<<image_1>>>室内，镜头轴线垂直对准入口两层障碍——前景为脏污厚重玻璃门（关闭，玻璃表面有污渍水渍积层，产生轻微漫射和前景模糊感），玻璃门后约50厘米处为金属卷帘门（关闭，铁锈磨损，无任何文字或告示），再往外是室外深夜黑暗。连续镜头过程（全程不剪切，不更换角度）：
①静默段（约1–2秒）：室内极暗，两层门面遮挡，窗外暴雨声透墙渗入，一切静止。画面内外均无任何车辆。
②卷帘门被推起并保持开启：<<<image_5>>>的左手从卷帘门底端金属把手处向上施力——门板从中景开始向上卷收，金属滚轴高频摩擦声，铁锈碎屑从缝隙崩落，室外暗夜冷湿空气透过开口渗入。卷帘门完全收起后保持在上方开启状态，不再落下。中景障碍消失——透过脏污玻璃门可见完整的室外队形：<<<image_5>>>居中直视室内，<<<image_3>>>站于<<<image_5>>>左后侧，<<<image_4>>>站于<<<image_5>>>右后侧，<<<image_2>>>站于<<<image_4>>>更右后侧。<<<image_5>>>：铂金色波浪中发被暴雨打湿贴脸颊，冰灰色眼睛直视镜头方向，唇线紧绷，面部零度表情。
③走近玻璃门：<<<image_5>>>向玻璃门靠近——她的面部在脏玻璃的前景模糊中逐渐变大，透过污渍与水渍的玻璃看她的面部有轻微的视觉扭曲与纹理叠加，但面部特征仍清晰可辨。这个过程约1–2秒，她靠近玻璃门时不减速。
④<<<image_5>>>推开玻璃门入内：<<<image_5>>>的双手出现在玻璃门两侧金属把手处，施力向内推——门体重量明显（铰链低沉摩擦声，需要持续施力），门缓慢打开，她迈入室内，继续向室内行进，不为任何人撑门，门在她进入后缓慢回弹。
⑤三人在门口短暂停顿——犹豫：<<<image_5>>>进入后，门外三人在原位做出短暂的停顿（约1–1.5秒），没有人立刻跟入——这是一个无声的集体迟疑，是「我们真的要相信那个女人吗」的短暂犹豫时刻。三人身体语言：<<<image_2>>>：面部绷紧，视线穿过脏玻璃短暂追踪<<<image_5>>>入室的方向，眼球做一次快速的左右扫视评估，随即做出决定；<<<image_3>>>：头部仍低垂，停顿期间几乎没有任何附加反应，只是在等待某个信号；<<<image_4>>>：眼眶泛红充血的双眼在停顿期间向左快速瞥一眼<<<image_2>>>的方向，她在等别人先动。
⑥<<<image_2>>>率先入内，<<<image_3>>>与<<<image_4>>>依次跟进：停顿后，<<<image_2>>>最先做出决定——他推开玻璃门（门被再次推开），率先踏入室内，动作干净直接，面部侧影咬肌绷紧，结膜暗红充血，眼球做最小幅度横向扫视（头部不转）——他迈进去不是因为信任，而是他不会让别人的决定先于他。<<<image_3>>>紧接其后跟入，头部持续低垂，脚步自动化，进门时几乎没有抬头——身体在执行动作，人在别处。<<<image_4>>>最后进入，在门口有极短的半步停顿——恐惧性大眼快速扫视门内黑暗空间，确认可以进入——随即迈入。玻璃门在<<<image_4>>>身后缓慢关闭（约2秒，低沉轻响合上），暴雨声随之减弱。卷帘门始终保持在上方开启状态。[SHOT 2] [室内深夜·冷蓝窗光自左向右·摄影机在右侧木质服务台内侧·轨道横移·四人从右侧入口方向向左侧厨房金属门方向profile行进·左侧落地大玻璃窗暴雨水流连续倾泻在人物背后·<<<image_5>>>步速明显快于其余三人·三人各自环视四周·最终到达厨房金属门] 广角轨道跟拍（rails）——摄影机架于<<<image_1>>>右侧木质服务台内侧（阴影区域），轨道与四人行进方向平行，摄影机匀速向左横滑，始终以侧面（profile）角度对准行进队列。空间关系（参照实景参考图）：人物从画面右侧（入口区域，玻璃门位置）入画，向画面左侧（厨房金属门方向）行进；左侧落地大玻璃窗在人物背后全程可见，暴雨将窗玻璃整面打湿，水流如水幕连续从上向下倾泻——不是雨点击打，是连续的整面水幕，窗外街景在水流中扭曲成模糊冷蓝色块；冷蓝散射窗光自左向右渗透，从背后勾勒出人物左侧轮廓与侧脸左半侧，右侧均为深阴影，人物以剪影与轮廓的形态穿越这个废弃的黑暗空间。队列顺序（由先至后）：<<<image_5>>> → <<<image_2>>> → <<<image_3>>> → <<<image_4>>>。间距因步速差异逐渐拉开——<<<image_5>>>步速明显快于其余三人：步幅大，步伐沉稳有力，手杖节律击地，从不放慢，仿佛这里对她来说只是一段走廊；身后三人的步速则带着明显的克制与谨慎——在陌生的、黑暗的、未知的空间中，身体自动降低速度以扫描感知环境。三人行进中的环视行为——各以自身情绪呈现：<<<image_2>>>：宽肩轮廓在冷蓝窗光边缘可辨，面部侧影咬肌紧绷；行进中眼球做最小幅度快速横向扫视——先扫左侧（卡座区域）再扫右侧（服务台暗处），头部完全不转，只有眼球移动，是戒备性扫描而非好奇；他不信任这个地方，他的扫视是在寻找威胁。<<<image_3>>>：头部最低，在队列中是一个塌陷的轮廓；行进中有一次极慢的头部侧转——头在重力牵引下缓慢向左偏（看向左侧玻璃窗方向），停顿约1秒，再以同样缓慢的速度回到低垂位，整个动作像是被动触发的，而非主动观察。<<<image_4>>>：稍微偏向窗侧，冷蓝窗光在她侧脸上略多，可见湿润充血眼眶与泪痕；行进中有两次明显的环视动作——第一次：快速向左转头（看向左侧大玻璃窗与窗外），停一拍，嘴唇微微分开做一次急促吸气；第二次：快速向右转头（看向右侧深暗服务台区域），停一拍，眉头皱起，随即转回正前方继续行进——她在确认这个陌生黑暗的空间里有没有威胁，每次转头都带着可见的恐惧与不安。四人穿越餐厅走向纵深——镜头跟随直到他们在纵深处停步：<<<image_5>>>率先到达厨房金属门前，停步，面对金属门（背对镜头）；其余三人依次在她身后停下——<<<image_2>>>最后停下时仍做一次快速的左右眼球扫视，<<<image_4>>>停下时做一次向后的快速回望（看向走过的餐厅空间），随即转回正面。15秒。16:9。整段视频锁定不变：室内深夜·无任何人工光源·左侧落地大玻璃窗冷蓝夜间散射为唯一光源·左侧大玻璃窗暴雨水流连续倾泻（全程可见）·卷帘门全程保持在上方开启状态·<<<image_5>>>超长黑色大衣（雨水打透）+铂金波浪中发贴脸颊+手杖·<<<image_2>>>浅灰背心（湿透）+鲜红色鼻梁绷带+结膜暗红充血·<<<image_3>>>米黄工装夹克（湿透）+头部低垂·<<<image_4>>>紫色卫衣（湿透）+眼眶泛红+泪痕——完全一致。禁止时刻漂移，禁止任何人工光源，禁止橙黄路灯，禁止画面中出现任何车辆，禁止雨声完全消失，禁止玻璃窗雨水流动停止，禁止卷帘门上出现任何文字或告示，禁止玻璃门上出现清晰标识，禁止<<<image_4>>>出现哭泣动作，禁反射成像，禁年龄标签。SFX only：卷帘门金属滚轴摩擦声+铁锈碎屑崩落·玻璃门铰链低沉摩擦·玻璃门缓慢关闭2秒轻响·<<<image_5>>>手杖击地（餐厅木地板回响）·暴雨声透墙渗入·暴雨沿玻璃倾流水声（微弱）·玻璃门关闭后室外雨声减弱。禁音乐。禁字幕。禁CGI粒子。禁正面光。禁人造影视灯光。禁反射。禁年龄标签。

title: Scene_15-16 #26
prompt_text:
Duration: 15 seconds total. Aspect ratio: 16:9. FOUR timed shots joined by THREE hard montage cuts (no dissolves, no morphs, no wipes). Mode: R2V.

Genre: DRAMA. Mood: loneliness, lostness, fear, dramatic tension. Cinematography reference: Emmanuel Lubezki x Roger Deakins language — only natural light and on-set practicals, contre-jour from streetlamps, camera on shadow side, full atmospheric haze. NOT 3D render, NOT game engine, NOT CGI gloss, NOT game-cutscene aesthetic. 8K IMAX hyper-realism, shot on physical cinema cameras with physical anamorphic cine glass, 180-degree shutter motion blur, fine real photographic film grain, organic edge vignette, natural chromatic edge aberration. 24fps fluid motion.

UNIVERSAL COMPOSITION RULE — all 4 shots:
Avoid central/symmetric framing in every shot. Use rule-of-thirds and asymmetric placement. Subjects are off-center, never aligned to the dead-center vertical or horizontal axis of the frame. Negative space is intentional, placed on the opposite side of the subject. NO Hollywood symmetric centered framing.

Reference plan — STRICT ROLE LOCK:
Use as the LOCATION + ENVIRONMENT + LIGHTING reference: corner pizzeria with red-and-white checkered "PIZZA SOUL" awning wrapping the corner, sloped tile roof at corner, closed rusted leftmost (corner) roller shutters with FOR RENT placards across the storefront facade, large concrete overpass crossing directly above the corner with dense overhead electric cables hanging from the piers. Streetlamp orange-amber practical above, red "PIZZA SOUL" neon as red secondary sidelight, low cool-white building-eaves point lights. The reference image does NOT control camera angle, framing, composition, lens, shot size or camera height.
Use <<<76c847f2-eb01-4e09-a629-723425cfbba3>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Gandelfina (woman): tall slim build, sharp contours, prominent cheekbones and clear jawline, platinum wavy shoulder-to-collar-length mid-length hair STYLED IN VOLUMIZED PLATINUM WAVES — DRY, NOT WET, NOT clinging to cheeks (her umbrella protects her from the rain throughout her time outside; her hair remains styled and intact across all shots), ice-gray eyes with cool intelligent gaze, wears an extra-long black structured stiff coat past the knee (color darker when wet on shoulders and sleeves), inside a black leather bustier vest with deep V-neck, dark olive wide-leg pants, black laced leather heeled ankle boots, right hand holds a black decorative cane with carved head and slim shaft. Her face is LIVING and PRESENT — she blinks naturally (2-3 blinks per visible moment), makes small micro-eye-movements, takes faint visible breaths at her shoulders, has a slight throat micro-swallow before any small action — she is alive and present, NEVER doll-like, NEVER statuesque-frozen, NEVER mannequin-stillness.
Use <<<e92f3ea2-1332-4d0f-b95b-b99280a663f5>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Roko (man): compact strong build, olive-dark skin, very short upper-lip mustache, mid-length wet black messy hair clinging to face, bright red horizontal bandage strip across nose bridge, light gray sleeveless vest (wet, clinging to skin), black tactical crossbody bag, red cotton wrist wraps on BOTH wrists, dark crimson super-loose distressed jeans (wet), white-gray low-top sneakers.
Use <<<35498cb4-72e0-4a8f-940e-1c56c88d354f>>> as the IDENTITY/APPEARANCE reference for Jax (man): dark skin, lean build, BRIGHT YELLOW very-short buzz cut (wet, clinging to scalp), beige/khaki patterned work jacket (wet), black gloves, single-shoulder tactical backpack, loose light-gray work pants (wet), gray-white sneakers.

节拍①——<<<image_2>>>出框：他是第一个出来的，动作有力且直接，带着一种被愤怒驱动的动能——他推开<<<image_6>>>车门，踏步出来，根本不犹豫，没有任何停顿或环顾的意图。他走得比正常速度略快，肩膀前倾，整个身体朝向目标（<<<image_1>>>卷帘门方向）。摄影机必须迅速摆动追上他——在他穿越画面中央的那一拍里，镜头在震动中锁定他的面部：结膜重度充血，整个眼白暗红色，红血丝如密网，眼眶下方明显肿胀——这双眼睛刚刚哭过，红得无法掩盖；同时咬肌双侧达到最高强度收缩，颧骨因张力清晰突出，颞肌将太阳穴深深凹陷，四到五道深竖纹刻在眉间，嘴唇压成一条绷紧的水平硬线，颈部胸锁乳突肌如粗绳隆起——愤怒和刚刚的剧烈哭泣同时铸在这张脸上。他的头部完全不转动，但他的眼球在那一拍里做了两次极快的横向扫视（左→右→归位），是唯一移动的部分——如同一个石铸面具里有两颗充血的眼球在独立运作。随即他已经走出画面右侧，摄影机没能完全追上他。 节拍②——<<<image_3>>>出框：他出来得慢，但不是因为小心——是因为他的身体在自动运作，他本人已经不在这里了。他从<<<image_6>>>侧滑门走出，脚步拖沓，头部在出门的瞬间就已经低垂向下，看不见他在看哪里，因为他什么都没在看。摄影机从他出现的瞬间就开始追他，但他的低头让镜头只能以低角度仰拍才能勉强捕捉到他的面部：额肌完全放松——前额光滑如放弃了所有意志后的空洞；提上睑肌无力，眼皮如铅块沉重半覆眼球；颧大肌与提口角肌全部失活，嘴角被重力无声下坠；颏肌有不自主的0.3秒节律细微间歇收缩——下颌皮肤轻微起伏，身体在压制某种向外冲的东西。他在走出画面的过程中有一次极其微弱、几乎察觉不到的眼球侧移——不是主动扫视，是某个残存的自动化本能在问「我该去哪」，随即消失。整个过程中他从未抬头，摄影机抓到的是一张彻底放弃抵抗重力的面孔。 节拍③——<<<image_4>>>出框：她是最后一个出来的，但她在出来之前就已经在动了——她还没完全离开<<<image_6>>>车门，头部就已经开始转动，用恐惧撑大的双眼在开门的瞬间就向四周扫去。她踏出车门的姿态是犹豫的——左脚先探出，右手仍短暂抓着<<<image_6>>>车门框，像一个人踩在未知地面上的试探动作。摄影机跟随她的出框过程摆动，在她完全站定的那一刻捕捉到面部：提上睑肌最大强度上提，眼白在虹膜上下三面近乎完全暴露，眼球几乎要从眼眶中突出；结膜重度充血，大面积暗红，泪液已经溢出并正在沿脸颊双侧流淌（ECU下可见清晰的泪痕轨迹），同时下睑边缘新的泪液持续积聚——「一边流，一边继续积」；额肌与皱眉肌同时以最大力量激活，形成「绝望恐惧眉」极端角度（外眉高扬，内眉极度聚拢）；鼻翼深度充血呈暗红，鼻头红润；颏肌剧烈间歇性抽搐，下颌有明显0.2秒节律颤动；嘴唇完全分开，上唇颤抖明显，呼吸急促，胸腔起伏可见。她站定后立即做完整的高速环视扫描：右（<<<image_6>>>车门方向）→左（<<<image_1>>>卷帘门）→上（<<<image_1>>>高架桥）→前方，每次转向都带着急迫感，泪水随每次头部转动甩出细小水珠，雨水与泪液混合在脸颊上——泪液更粘稠，留下更慢的痕迹；雨水更快地从发际冲下——ECU下两者清晰可辨。环视完成后，头部停在正前方，恐惧和迷失叠加，没有答案。 15秒。16:9。整段视频锁定不变：深夜·暴雨极强·四层电影薄雾·路灯橙黄逆光+<<<image_1>>>红色招牌副光·低位乳白蒸汽气团无源持续漫延·<<<image_5>>>超长黑色大衣（雨水打透）+铂金波浪中发贴脸颊+黑色皮革束胸马甲+手杖·<<<image_2>>>浅灰背心（雨水打湿）+鲜红色鼻梁绷带+红色双腕绑带+暗红破洞牛仔裤·<<<image_3>>>米黄工装夹克（雨水打湿）+亮黄buzz
